reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063867/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90773) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy responded to US President Donald Trump calling Vladimir Putin a friend by stating that for Ukraine, Putin is an enemy and a killer.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/putin-a-killer-zelenskyy-says-after-trump-calls-russian-leader-his-friend) reported that Russian forces launched a major wave of strikes against Ukraine from Thursday night into Friday morning, killing at least seven people in Kyiv.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187030-to-us-he-is-enemy-and-murderer-zelensky-on-putin-whom-trump-called-friend.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he considers Russian dictator Vladimir Putin a murderer and an enemy of Ukraine.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqevrddp91z8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting called Vladimir Putin a cold-blooded killer during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/ckvg2nxgjjdgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky called Vladimir Putin a killer after Donald Trump called the Russian leader a friend.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-defends-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-xi-putin-after-backlash), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/HL5T2OOGENAYPFU2IWYOSA5X6U/) reported that Trump defended his summit with Xi Jinping and Putin despite backlash from critics.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-road-borders-with-russia-in-response-to-sustained-aggression-against-europe/) reported that Estonia plans to close road borders with Russia in response to sustained aggression against Europe.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222601) reported that Maria Zakharova emphasized that Russia would take all necessary political and diplomatic response measures to secure its national interests.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222361), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Russian diplomat stated the Ukrainian army is intensifying terrorist activities and striking civilian infrastructure with drones.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/trump-plans-to-meet-separately-with-putin-on-his-china-trip-in-addition-to-their-3-way-talks-with-xi) reported that Donald Trump plans to meet separately with Putin on his China trip in addition to their three-way talks with Xi.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220795), a state-media outlet, reported that Belarusian Foreign Minister Maxim Ryzhenkov stated Belarus's relations with Russia are not a bargaining chip in talks with the West.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-issues-concerning-global-peace-china-says-3725740) reported that China's Foreign Ministry stated the American, Russian, and Chinese presidents will discuss issues concerning global peace at a trilateral summit.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-putin-xi-meet-in-china-to-discuss-global-issues/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping discussed ending Russia's war against Ukraine during talks in Shenzhen.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219937), a state-run outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova stated Europe is ready to talk about peace only while ignoring Russia's interests.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/ukraine-russia-europe-trump.html) reported that President Trump's envoys are attempting to craft a postwar security agreement in Europe to end the war.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-scold-ukraine-strikes-russia-peace-talks-elbridge-colby/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius criticized U.S. remarks regarding deep strikes as stupid.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219803) reported that Russian diplomat Rodion Miroshnik stated Kyiv maintained a high level of terrorist activity and fired at least 8,334 munitions on civilian facilities on Russian soil over seven days.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/russia-plays-for-time-as-europe-and-us-push-for-direct-peace-talks) reported that Russia continues to play down the possibility of face-to-face talks with Europe despite pressure.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-says-he-is-willing-to-hold-separate-talks-with-putin-in-china/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90379) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would be willing to hold a separate meeting with Vladimir Putin during his China visit.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063252/) reported that following the adoption of new EU sanctions against Russian entities, Moscow officials including Sergei Ryabkov and Dmitry Peskov stated Russia stands against European participation in peace talks.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNVmhPQUFLblhESV9CWnFmX2ZONzdHOTFMQkhHMW9hUzNoYlp6ZU5BUnE5b1pJZ05TbjFOODNDa2VKTW9UMzRETE5hdVBhSzVmLTJjalRFUjA2RERZdW5GS0lXOUdMM0RLRmIyWndqWUFrUjA3VFZISUMtTHdVMjQzYUJreWdKaGFnSV8xbkR5NWs4b2VBTE1BMVJlZlNvdGl3?oc=5), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87335196) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated that progress has been made toward signing a peace agreement in Ukraine, though difficult decisions lie ahead.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063172/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated preparations are underway for a multilateral meeting on the war in Ukraine and that he discussed next steps with Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063176/) reported that Jared Kushner stated any final peace agreement must be agreed by both Russia and Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063174/) reported that Dmitry Peskov backed Donald Trump's remarks about Russia's military actions in Ukraine and confirmed the main topics for an upcoming meeting.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukraine-holds-peace-talks-with-us-europe-as-conflict-escalates?traffic_source=rss) reported that Ukraine held peace talks with the US and Europe as the conflict escalates, with Kushner reporting progress towards a deal while Moscow stated it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/kremlin-aide-denies-russia-agreed-to-include-europe-in-ukraine-peace-talks-a94279), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/kremlin-says-the-next-u-s-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-will-be-trilateral-without-europe), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648921-putin-aide-reveals-moscow-stance-europe-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Moscow has not agreed to include a European delegation in upcoming Ukraine peace talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063169/) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov stated Russia was not consulted on Europe's involvement in peace talks and wants Europe to present constructive proposals.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-ukraine-europeans-discuss-how-to-draw-russia-into-peace-talks) reported that European officials joined talks with Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators to discuss ways to bring Russia into direct engagement on ending the war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ukraine-kaja-kallas-brussels-europe-b3085569.html) reported that European Union countries accused Russia of delaying peace talks in Ukraine while continuing attacks on civilian infrastructure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8063001/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185002-europe-to-engage-in-ukraine-peace-talks-and-ensure-maximum-pressure-on-russia-von-der-leyen.html) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated Europe will participate in negotiations to end the war through the E5 + EU format while maintaining pressure on Russia.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86782146) reported that Moldova news noted Russia laid out conditions for signing a peace agreement in Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86745418) reported that European leaders meeting in Dublin agreed that Germany, France, Italy, Poland, the United Kingdom, and EU institutions would represent them in Ukraine peace talks.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648894-us-europe-worlds-apart-ukraine-diplomacy/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Lavrov stated the US and Europe are worlds apart on Ukraine peace talks and that European leaders dismiss Russia's security concerns.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062909/), [Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/15/382477/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron stated that limiting aid and forcing Ukraine into an unjust peace would make Europe vulnerable and described the Ukrainian army as Europe's army.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/europe-will-closely-engage-in-peace-negotiations-between-russia-ukraine-von-der-leyen-says/) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that Europe will closely engage in peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine following an agreement by European leaders.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90150) reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner announced that Washington is working to establish direct engagement between Moscow and European partners.

[TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218309) reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov stated that European nations want to join Ukraine talks at the last minute and do not know what role they could play.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218239) reported that the Kremlin stated European negotiators have not yet contacted Russia regarding peace talks.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/EU-institutions-E5-to-represent-Europe-in-Ukraine-peace-talks-1S3x46aI1Ko/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that EU leaders agreed Europe's team for Ukraine peace talks will comprise EU institutions and five major military powers consisting of Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and E5.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-envoy-kushner-says-he-aims-to-broker-europe-russia-talks-on-ukraine?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jared-kushner-says-us-preparing-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-with-european-partners-directly-involved-101794696615177.html) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated he aims to broker Europe-Russia talks on Ukraine with European partners directly involved.

reports.text: [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/hungary-magyar-orban-corruption-cash.html) reported that Hungary's new government uncovered $20 million worth of bank notes hidden in farmhouses and woods in corruption investigations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPTWYtR2ZRc1RDTm1IX3Q2eGZMRVBaMGZyT2Y4b0pobEUxR2ZvS083aFhtNXF0ZGNvcEtfUVlzM19iZlFaTXhwTElHTExvS3d2cG83NUkyUWE4SlNuRC1TbVhhcmJsblNNZG42UmxZS2ZyT0hSME5yRHZHdTdxZlNBelJkWXBnTzFFUGU3U1RwNWMyZDc0Q0ZsbXdhYXFUbEFhU0ZkUlJjVjlKbG1nMXhIZnRTY2g?oc=5) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Magyar urged Fidesz lawmakers to quit following a cash haul in a graft probe.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/hungarian-investigators-found-19-5-million-in-cash-buried-in-forests-and-hidden-in-buildings-while-probing-allegations-against-a-former-minister-treasury-staff-needed-eight-hours-and-five-machines-to-count-it/articleshow/135847472.cms) reported that Hungarian investigators found $19.5 million in cash buried in forests and hidden in buildings while probing allegations against a former minister.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86180999), a Moldovan news outlet, reported that Hungarian authorities recovered cash worth nearly €17.7 million in an investigation involving former National Development Minister Miklós Seszták.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/hungary-finds-30-million-cash-some-buried-in-forests-in-bribery-probe-20261115-p61e7e.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Hungary found $30 million in cash, some buried in forests, in a bribery probe.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cash-found-in-hungary-in-anti-graft-probe-20261115-p61e8r.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported on footage released from Hungary’s National Asset Recovery and Protection Office showing cash found in an anti-graft probe.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/hungary-seizes-195-million-cash-hidden-forests-graft-probe.1137115) reported that Miklos Sesztak, two other ministers from Viktor Orban's cabinet, and his brother have been taken into custody in different cases.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/hungary-seizes-millions-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-corruption-investigation) reported that investigators uncovered large amounts of cash buried in forests, concealed in agricultural buildings, and stashed inside safes.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90112) reported that Hungary's National Asset Recovery and Protection Agency seized over 5 billion forints, €2.7 million, and $1.3 million in physical cash.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/hungarian-investigators-uncover-19-5m-hidden-in-forests-and-buildings?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly $20 million was found in Hungary's forests and buildings amid a corruption probe into an ex-minister.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914852) reported that it took a dozen State Treasury workers eight hours to count the cash as part of Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s Operation Purgatory anti-corruption drive.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/hungary-seizes-195m-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-graft-inquiry), [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/billions-in-buried-cash-found-in-forests-and-safes-in-ex-ministers-bribery-case/) reported that Hungary's anti-corruption agency seized $19.5 million in cash found buried in forests and safes as part of a bribery inquiry into an Orbán-era minister.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/hungarian-authorities-uncover-millions-hidden-by-former-orban-officials-in-forests-warehouses/) reported that Hungarian authorities seized more than 6 billion forints in cash found hidden or buried in forests and warehouses by the National Asset Recovery and Protection Directorate.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Bratu-Viktora-Orbana-odredjen-pritvor/992017) reported that a Hungarian court ordered a one-month detention for Aron Orban, the brother of former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, due to suspected human smuggling.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/12/4978901_bratut_na_orban_e_zadurjan_zaradi_vizi_za_vietnamski/?ref=rss) reported that Aron Orban was detained on Monday due to suspicions regarding visas for Vietnamese migrants.

[Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/viktor-orbans-brother-jailed-pending-trial-over-people-smuggling-ring/) reported that Viktor Orbán's brother was jailed pending trial over a people-smuggling ring.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Orbanovog-brata-u-lisicama-doveli-pred-sud-FOTO/991883) reported that Aron Orban was brought before a court in Budapest to decide on his detention.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNRWRHb01HTTFuYmlwb1F5Z1k1YVBYYlVHRGVaSFhFbk9nMzk3MjF0cWZEUE1JOVVwclppT0x1YmVlMGFjMGpnOEI4WWZTN1B3MVRCN2JscHFKeWdIX3JkRXB0U2twcEtZRzktbkc5ZHdHRWlVbTA3a0EtS0tsY0Eyc01HTVRBYkVVUlhmMHlLR0pDTUFnNUZ4T3VCNA?oc=5) reported that a judge jailed Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, after he cut off his ankle monitor.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9j3433zy4vro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Thomas Markle is back in federal custody after allegedly removing his ankle monitor.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/thomas-markle-sent-back-to-jail-after-cutting-off-his-ankle-bracelet/article71688238.ece) reported that U.S. Magistrate Judge Lindsay Griffin found Thomas Markle had violated the terms of his pretrial release and ordered him returned to federal custody.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648650-orban-hungary-brother-arrest/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) (state-media) reported that former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban slammed his brother's detention as a government attempt to eliminate the opposition.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/viktor-orban-aron-brother-human-trafficking-b3082359.html) reported that Viktor Orbán stated the target is him after his brother Áron Orbán was detained for suspected human trafficking and corruption.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQcjZsUDI4UUNSUXdGOEhPQTZBLTFMRmxzalB0VDhqYXYtZmpJUzlvVlI2c3R3dkZoM21lUENZQzVNUjlGU2dqOG1QbDc1Q0RIZkNtRWROcWZTc3FvVXBDZkkxNmVfV1FwMm9zdDU3aGR1anRsUE1wZVp1bWs0OE1ZUUk0RGVvNnJrNnV2R1ptY2pJc3A3LWhsbG9XTTExcmcyT18yNXhOSWxRNHZSZklOamozOE8tUQ?oc=5) reported that Hungarian authorities detained Viktor Orbán's younger brother for suspected human trafficking.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/irmao-de-viktor-orban-e-preso-sob-suspeita-de-envolvimento-em-trafico-de-pessoas.shtml) reported that Hungarian authorities arrested the brother of former prime minister Viktor Orbán during an investigation into a human trafficking case.

reports.text: [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/ukraine-trump-s-etonne-du-niveau-de-haine-entre-zelensky-et-poutine-mais-affirme-que-le-president-russe-veut-une-issue-diplomatique-a-la-guerre-20261120) reported that US President Donald Trump expressed astonishment at the level of hatred between Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin while stating the Russian president wants a diplomatic outcome to the war.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-les-europeens-iront-a-moscou-s-ils-ont-bien-desormais-toute-leur-place-dans-les-negociations-indique-l-elysee-20261120) reported that the Elysee stated European participation in negotiations regarding Ukraine is required if they go to Moscow, and providing Ukraine with Article 5-type protection amounts to bringing Kyiv into NATO.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leak-confidential-information-le-pen-far-right-party) reported that French authorities are investigating whether a former senior interior ministry official leaked confidential judicial investigation details regarding the National Rally party.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/candidats/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-devance-jean-luc-melenchon-s-il-devient-candidat-unique-du-centre-et-de-la-droite-selon-un-sondage-20261120) reported that Edouard Philippe stated he is ready to participate in a meeting allowing four declared candidates to find a single candidate for the center and right.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-refuser-enverrait-un-signal-inapproprie-boris-pistorius-estime-que-l-invitation-de-vladimir-poutine-aux-europeens-est-acceptable-20261120) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius stated that Vladimir Putin's invitation to Europeans is acceptable and refusing it would send an inappropriate signal.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/marine-le-pen-national-rally-party-alleged-interior-ministry-leaks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that France opened an investigation into suspicions that a senior civil servant at the interior ministry leaked confidential judicial information to the far-right National Rally party.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-ca-devrait-pouvoir-se-faire-melenchon-salue-l-offre-faite-par-tondelier-de-discuter-d-une-coalition-20261120) reported that Jean-Luc Melenchon welcomed Marine Tondelier's call to form a coalition.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/guerre-en-ukraine-a-berlin-la-reunion-des-allies-de-kiev-miroir-inverse-de-la-rencontre-de-shenzhen-entre-xi-trump-et-poutine_6813557_3210.html) reported that allies of Kyiv met in Berlin to maintain support and honor promised aid for 2026.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/article/2026/11/19/yannick-jadot-et-jeremie-iordanoff-quittent-les-ecologistes-apres-l-approche-de-marine-tondelier-vers-jean-luc-melenchon-pour-la-presidentielle_6813385_6205049.html) reported that Yannick Jadot and Jérémie Iordanoff left Les Écolos after Marine Tondelier's overture to Jean-Luc Mélenchon for the presidential election, with Jadot calling the move a betrayal.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-yannick-jadot-annonce-quitter-les-ecologistes-apres-la-main-tendue-de-tondelier-a-melenchon-20261119) reported that Yannick Jadot announced he is leaving Les Écologists following Marine Tondelier's overture to Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/19/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-vladimir-poutine-previent-que-toute-forme-de-cooperation-militaire-entre-kiev-et-l-europe-dans-un-eventuel-accord-de-paix-pose-evidemment-un-probleme_6810982_3210.html) reported that Vladimir Putin warned that any form of military cooperation between Kyiv and Europe during a potential peace agreement poses a problem.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/c-est-la-fin-des-ecologistes-marine-tondelier-tend-la-main-a-jean-luc-melenchon-20261119) reported that Ecologists leader Marine Tondelier stated she is ready to build a coalition around Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-clementine-autain-qui-avait-quitte-lfi-apres-les-purges-de-2024-appelle-a-soutenir-jean-luc-melenchon-20261119) reported that Clémentine Autain called for support for Jean-Luc Mélenchon following Marine Tondelier opening the door to supporting the candidate.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/19/presidentielle-2027-marine-tondelier-tente-de-forcer-la-main-des-ecologistes-en-se-disant-prete-a-rallier-jean-luc-melenchon_6813213_823448.html) reported that on France 2, Ecologists national secretary Marine Tondelier opened the way to her withdrawal from the presidential race.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-c-est-une-bonne-nouvelle-faisons-le-manuel-bompard-salue-le-rapprochement-de-marine-tondelier-avec-lfi-20261119) reported that Manuel Bompard saluted the rapprochement with LFI while Tondelier is credited with 2 to 4 percent of voting intentions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/programmes/presidentielle-2027-pour-reduire-la-dette-david-lisnard-veut-supprimer-400-000-postes-de-fonctionnaires-20261118) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard proposed eliminating 400,000 civil servant posts to reduce debt.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/polityka/art45511031-marine-le-pen-i-jean-luc-melenchon-w-drugiej-turze-co-trzeci-francuz-zostalby-w-domu) reported that an Ifop poll found 38 percent of voters would not go to the polls if Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Melenchon faced each other in the second round of the French presidential election.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/sondages/presidentielle-2027-lisnard-et-attal-se-demarquent-dans-une-hypothetique-primaire-decouvrez-le-sondage-du-figaro-20261118) reported that an Ifop poll for Le Figaro found that nearly four out of ten voters consider participating in a hypothetical primary if it were to take place.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-met-en-musique-une-partie-de-son-programme-pour-s-extirper-du-debat-sur-la-primaire-et-de-l-etau-rn-lfi_6813202_823448.html) reported that Edouard Philippe staged part of his program to move away from the primary debate and the National Rally-LFI pressure.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/de-lfi-a-lr-en-passant-par-le-medef-le-projet-de-reforme-des-retraites-de-marine-le-pen-critique-de-tous-bords_6813010_823449.html) reported that Marine Le Pen's pension reform project was criticized across political boards from LFI to LR and Medef.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-presente-une-partie-de-son-programme-pour-retablir-l-ordre-et-remettre-la-france-sur-le-chemin-du-progres_6813122_823448.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-promet-une-rupture-de-fond-pour-relancer-sa-campagne-face-a-david-lisnard-20261118) reported that Horizons presidential candidate Edouard Philippe detailed measures and promised a radical rupture to launch his campaign.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/presidentielle-2027-face-a-marine-le-pen-jean-luc-melenchon-gagnera-l-election-assure-darmanin-20261118) reported that Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin stated that Jean-Luc Mélenchon will win the 2027 presidential election against Marine Le Pen, and called on Bruno Retailleau and Gabriel Attal to withdraw in favor of Horizons candidate Edouard Philippe without a primary.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-jean-philippe-tanguy-propose-un-debat-avec-david-lisnard-20261118) reported that Jean-Philippe Tanguy proposed a debate with David Lisnard regarding pensions.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-sans-attendre-edouard-philippe-ses-adversaires-posent-la-premiere-pierre-d-une-primaire-de-la-droite-et-du-centre-incertaine_6813083_823448.html) reported that teams for Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau, and David Lisnard held a meeting regarding a potential primary for the right and center.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-on-doit-lui-mettre-la-pression-lisnard-fait-de-la-participation-de-philippe-une-condition-pour-une-primaire-20261118) reported that David Lisnard stated Edouard Philippe's participation is a condition for a primary.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-gerald-darmanin-appelle-bruno-retailleau-et-gabriel-attal-a-s-effacer-derriere-edouard-philippe-pour-barrer-la-route-a-jean-luc-melenchon_6813056_823448.html) reported that Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin called on Bruno Retailleau and Gabriel Attal to step aside behind Edouard Philippe to block Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/17/la-ligue-des-droits-de-l-homme-qualifiee-par-marine-le-pen-de-ramassis-de-gauchistes-accuse-la-candidate-rn-de-vouloir-supprimer-tous-les-contre-pouvoirs_6813037_3224.html) reported that the Human Rights League accused National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen of wanting to eliminate all checks and balances after she called the organization a gathering of leftists during a poverty debate.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-les-camps-attal-retailleau-et-lisnard-actent-leurs-premieres-convergences-en-l-absence-d-edouard-philippe-20261117) reported that representatives of Renaissance, Les Républicains, and Nouvelle Énergie parties laid the groundwork for a primary at the end of January in the absence of Édouard Philippe to foster the emergence of a single candidate for the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/la-droite-et-le-centre-attaquent-le-projet-de-reforme-des-retraites-de-marine-le-pen_6813010_823448.html) reported that political opponents including Bruno Retailleau and Édouard Philippe criticized Marine Le Pen's pension reform project.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-presente-sa-reforme-des-retraites-et-promet-que-des-centaines-de-milliers-de-travailleurs-partiront-plus-tot-qu-avec-la-reforme-borne_6812963_823448.html) reported that National Rally presidential candidate Marine Le Pen presented her pension reform project based on progressivity and capitalization.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-en-cas-de-defaite-a-la-primaire-gabriel-attal-retirera-sa-candidature-20261117) reported that Renaissance candidate Gabriel Attal's campaign director stated that Attal will withdraw his candidacy if he loses the primary.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-detaille-ce-mardi-son-projet-de-reforme-des-retraites-20261117) reported that National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen presented her pension reform project.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/impots-logement-smic-ce-qu-il-faut-retenir-du-debat-entre-candidats-a-la-presidentielle_6812895_823448.html) reported that presidential candidates Gabriel Attal, Raphaël Glucksmann, Marine Le Pen, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, and Bruno Retailleau debated taxes, salaries, housing, and pensions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-impots-logement-associations-ce-qu-il-faut-retenir-du-grand-debat-entre-cinq-candidats-sur-la-vie-chere-20261116) reported that presidential candidates Jean-Luc Melenchon, Raphael Glucksmann, Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau, and Marine Le Pen debated taxes, housing, and the cost of living on LCI and TF1.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/programmes/presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-veut-supprimer-parcoursup-le-controle-continu-et-avancer-le-bac-en-mai-20261116) reported that National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen detailed proposals regarding high school and the baccalaureate, including abolishing Parcoursup.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-debat-de-la-presidentielle-2027-les-cinq-candidats-s-affrontent-sur-les-retraites-marine-le-pen-cible-la-ligue-des-droits-de-l-homme-un-ramassis-de-gauchistes_6811633_6205049.html) reported that five presidential candidates debated on pensions while Marine Le Pen targeted the Human Rights League.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-pouvoir-d-achat-posez-vos-questions-a-l-economiste-mathieu-plane_6811633_6205049.html) reported that economist Mathieu Plane answered questions on inflation and purchasing power regarding the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-suivez-dans-notre-live-le-debat-entre-gabriel-attal-raphael-glucksmann-marine-le-pen-jean-luc-melenchon-et-bruno-retailleau-sur-la-vie-chere_6811633_6205049.html) reported that Le Monde hosted a debate on purchasing power and precarity featuring Gabriel Attal, Raphaël Glucksmann, Marine Le Pen, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, and Bruno Retailleau.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-edouard-philippe-emmanuel-macron-ukraine-teddy-riner-20261116) reported that Marine Le Pen remains far ahead in voting intentions for the first round of the presidential election, ahead of Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

reports.text: [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/gadi-eisenkot-invites-benjamin-netanyahu-israeli-coalition-talks/107413714), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261121-eisenkot-invites-netanyahu-s-party-for-marathon-israeli-coalition-talks), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1121/1600152-israeli-coalition-talks/), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/566b53a9a3ec), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/eisenkot-invites-netanyahus-party-for-israeli-coalition-talks-3013421), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-government-formation-eisenkots-yashar-party-reaches-out-to-netanyahus-camp-for-coalition-talks-101795295951548.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party has invited Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party to coalition talks.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915647) reported that Naftali Bennett confirmed ongoing talks with Likud, ruled out joining Benjamin Netanyahu, and set three conditions for a coalition while urging Eisenkot's bloc to seek a Zionist unity government.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915581) reported that Yashar is preparing for the possibility that both coalition negotiation tracks will fail.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-19/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-plans-knesset-vote-on-govt-led-by-him-even-if-coalition-talks-fail/000001a1-f454-d287-adbb-f65e3bfb0000) reported that Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to hold a Knesset vote on a government led by him even if coalition talks fail.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915505) reported that the Eisenkot-led bloc and Likud are scheduled to meet on Sunday for continued talks on a potential unity government.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahus-surprise-meeting-with-bennett-stirs-anger-in-eisenkot-bloc-3725753) reported that figures in Gadi Eisenkot's bloc accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of trying to break up their alliance after meeting Naftali Bennett.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045571/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-reverse-netanyahu-legacy-under-new-speaker) reported that Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc as opponents of the caretaker prime minister began their moves.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/bennett-meets-netanyahu-eisenkot-unaware-coalition-talks/) reported that B'Yachad chief Naftali Bennett held a long Knesset meeting with Benjamin Netanyahu on November 18 while Gadi Eisenkot's spokesperson stated he was unaware of it.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-rattled-bennett-holds-talks-netanyahu) reported that members of Israel's opposition bloc insisted they remain unified after a meeting between Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/bennett-meets-netanyahu-ahead-of-talks-with-eisenkot-bloc-leaders/000001a1-ee32-d24f-a1e5-efbfec8b0000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915298) reported that Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu held a secret meeting without informing Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Lapid in advance, which delayed planned opposition bloc talks.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-915097) reported that an Eisenkot-led bloc is weighing a unity government and coalition talks with haredi parties following the October election, while Golan and Liberman warned against a Netanyahu-led unity government.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/this-likud-mks-protest-tent-is-well-intentioned-but-it-serves-netanyahu/000001a1-e38c-db97-a1e1-e39ebbf50000) reported that Likud and Smotrich representatives appeared at a protest tent calling for unity.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/whats-behind-netanyahus-frantic-push-for-a-unity-government/000001a1-e027-d59b-a1f3-f8b72d260000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Gadi Eisenkot to share power after losing his majority.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/can-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-form-a-unity-government-in-israel?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-again-urges-rival-to-join-him-in-forming-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urged rival Gadi Eisenkot to join him in forming a unity government.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-rejects-netanyahus-unity-government-call-as-media-stunt-3725584) reported that Gadi Eisenkot described the call as a media stunt and noted that negotiating teams from his Yashar party and Likud are due to meet.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-israel-vows-gaza-offensive-policy-despite-caretaker-status?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has pledged to continue its offensive policy on Gaza.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261114-netanyahu-renews-call-for-israeli-government-unity-as-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/netanyahu-calls-for-israeli-unity-government-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks-3011919), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1114/1599234-netanyahu-renews-call-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renewed his call for a national unity government with Gadi Eisenkot, who dismissed the appeal as tricks.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914874) reported that Netanyahu invoked the Hatikvah walkout and warned of Iran's nuclear threat.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/netanyahu-pushes-trump-iran-strikes-amid-mossad-us-visit) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Donald Trump to renew attacks on Iran while Mossad chief Roman Gofman visits Washington.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/after-briefing-eisenkot-netanyahu-urges-unity-government-without-preconditions/000001a1-db08-ddc9-abb7-dfca699e0000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu invoked the threat from Iran and the need for national reconciliation in his appeal to Eisenkot.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914878) reported that Eisenkot accused Netanyahu of political spin over his unity government appeal and demanded a break with extremists.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-calls-netanyahus-unity-plea-a-bluff/000001a1-db48-d59b-a1f3-dbdcd9bd0000) reported that Eisenkot called Netanyahu's unity plea a bluff and urged backing for Yashar's Knesset speaker pick.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup-through-knesset-committees/000001a1-d12f-da30-a7fb-d9bf1ba40000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc seeks to control key Knesset committees to undo Netanyahu's judicial coup.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177688) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz responded to Eisenkot by stating that Tel Aviv does not need the opposition's approval to continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and the West Bank.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-leaders-were-unaware-of-yashars-planned-talks-with-likud/000001a1-ca01-d1f4-a7f9-cac3d5240000) reported that Lieberman, Bennett and Golan learned of the planned Yashar-Likud talks only after they were canceled following Netanyahu's speech attacking Arab parties.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/unfit-to-remain-in-office-eisenkot-attacks-netanyahu-after-hateful-knesset-speech/articleshow/135722286.cms) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after a hateful Knesset speech.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

reports.text: [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/west-bank/2026-11-22/ty-article/.premium/hebrew-graffiti-found-alongside-arson-in-five-west-bank-palestinian-villages/000001a2-0183-dad7-a9ff-43cb7ce60000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915667) reported that suspected settler attacks involving arson and Hebrew graffiti were reported across West Bank villages and sites.

reports.text: [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a2cfb441d751), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/middle-east/endurance-swimmer-tackles-strait-of-hormuz-20261122-p61g8h.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swam parts of the Strait of Hormuz to highlight the environmental impact of the conflict with Iran.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/endurance-athlete-lewis-pugh-swims-in-strait-of-hormuz-to-highlight-iran-wars-impact-on-wildlife-3013343) reported that endurance athlete Lewis Pugh swam across the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to environmental threats and the impact of regional conflict on wildlife.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/maritime-agency-says-2-tankers-struck-in-hormuz-as-iran-says-ship-on-fire-3013341) reported that two tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, with one hit by an unknown projectile and another struck in the engine room.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/uk-man-swims-strait-hormuz-highlight-environmental-damage) reported that a British endurance swimmer swam in the Strait of Hormuz and called for the waterway to be reopened and cleaned up.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249562/Non-compliant-tanker-blasts-after-hitting-mine-near-Oman-port) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy Force stated an oil tanker attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz exploded after hitting a mine.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584814/another-oil-tanker-strikes-naval-mine-as-tensions-persist-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that an oil tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz according to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249573/A-tanker-transiting-Hormuz-Strait-hit-by-a-projectile-UKMTO) reported that the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations received a report of an incident 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915628) reported that one tanker was hit on its stern 11 nautical miles north of Khasab and another in its engine room 17 nautical miles east about 50 minutes later.
[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584935/gold-and-silver-prices-decline-further/) reported that gold and silver prices recorded further declines in local and international markets.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNSXBvSnRkak5uYmtzMFNqMmE5Q25TMzBWeFh1ZmRhUHlMemIySllSU0FKcXZRQ2FjalhyMWhOZ3k2UWNXN3FjLTZiaUNvRk95S2FzeUlGeVJBQWNnQ19XYTAxd2NxNXNDN01TSWhYNXo0ellDaDBwZ0szdkR6azU5SkdFNWF4SWxiSF80Mi1ZdENoS1RuTWZkUVpCMHk0V0JpcDdz?oc=5), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that the British maritime agency UKMTO reported two tanker incidents near Oman and the Strait of Hormuz.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that Iran stated a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine, while Reuters could not verify the account.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/43dcf720e699), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's army stated a ship was on fire after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222883), a state-media outlet, reported that an oil tanker hit a mine in the east of the Strait of Hormuz according to the Iranian Navy, which warned shipowners of serious dangers in prohibited areas.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/21/strait-of-hormuz-athlete-swims-through-war-zone-to-expose-wars-environmental-toll/) reported that British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh completed a 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz over three days.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/uk-endurance-swimmer-lewis-pugh-strait-of-hormuz-b3089066.html) reported that British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swam in the Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental threats during the ongoing conflict.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPUFlEbXRhcG1QdzdPMU5DZTludFpwQllURVktV0I4cC1pX2g4V1k1dEhTWFVibXk4Wm9IUWFNYjZLRTlCZHBnM044cGo3amFOdTQ2SWdZWkVBUG9LaERYQ3pUQTdvd1loNVlxN0VPTUJTS29tcWsxWlIydFcxRGp4N2xlTUUyMDk1Y1VfLTVfXzYxZGZnVVFEUWpxaW05bS1MTlNQRGZpYUMwQ2xMY3MyMDRFUm1PM1JjaXc?oc=5) reported that a tanker caught fire following a projectile strike near the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UKMTO.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Crude-Oil/Tankers-Are-Being-Hit-Daily-So-Why-Is-Oil-Falling.html) reported that Brent tumbled 5% to $91 as recovering Gulf oil flows outweighed tanker attacks and geopolitical tensions.
[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Steps-Up-Hormuz-Tanker-Attacks-as-Oil-Prices-Slide.html) reported that Iran intensified attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNcUFnMEZJMTN2enVQd2QycGtKbnhaY1RmUVF1c0pBVFQ4Qkw1aWlkdnM1Y1JDdjZYTmdUSmllejZmSktVWjUycEktTExXWG5kU0lsWVpiMy03dUU4Um5GMFZiMEJreHhhSC1vWDB4Nk0tY0x4S2lzQ1dZM1N2eWFad2VOcmM?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584297/gold-and-silver-prices-plunge-to-14-month-lows-amid-steep-global-market-decline/) reported that gold and silver prices hit 14-month lows in global markets.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/business/general/3357924/gold-prices-hit-14month-low-on-fed-hike-expectations) reported that gold prices plunged to a 14-month low, dropping more than 30% from their peak, due to expectations of further US interest rate hikes.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/2-oil-tankers-catch-fire-after-hitting-mines-east-of-hormuz-iranian-army-3725789) reported that the Iranian army stated two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines east of Hormuz.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/tanker-struck-by-projectile-near-omans-khasab-as-attacks-in-hormuz-continue-3012815), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220835) reported that a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in its engine room near Oman's Khasab, causing a fire.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/19/nx-s1-6044206/irans-attacks-on-ships-in-the-strait-of-hormuz-escalate) reported that Iran launched attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes around the Persian Gulf.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915531) reported that a US source told the Post that Iran is using deadlier missiles to target ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2221997), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi stated Iran knows the size and deployment locations of adversary forces in the region.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326732/Two-more-violating-supertankers-catch-fire-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Navy announced two supertankers violating maritime regulations caught fire and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249538/Two-violating-supertankers-explode-in-Strait-of-Hormuz), a state-media outlet, reported that two supertankers exploded after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/The-Middle-East-War-Has-Wiped-28-Billion-Barrels-Off-Global-Oil-Supply.html) reported that the International Energy Agency stated the war in the Middle East caused global oil supply losses of a total of 2.8 billion barrels plus 60 billion cubic meters of natural gas.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Small-Vessel-Trade-Thrives-in-Hormuz-as-Iran-Targets-Supertankers.html) reported that smaller oil tankers moved high volumes of crude oil out of the Strait of Hormuz in October as Iran targets supertankers.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375023/talks-xi-get-under-way-trump-asks-china-do-more-us-farmers) reported that US President Donald Trump stated the United States and China have a mutual interest in the flow of oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326369/Three-violating-vessels-catch-fire-after-striking-naval-mines), an IRNA state-media report, stated that three oil tankers caught fire in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz after striking naval mines and violating maritime regulations.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641133/oil-prices-steady-as-middle-east-shipping-attacks-counter-supply-surplus-outlook) reported that Brent crude futures are trading up 5 cents, or 0.05%, at $92 a barrel as Middle East shipping attacks counter the supply surplus outlook.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/iraq-pumps-oil-to-turkey-again-after-12-years-to-bypass-hormuz-disruption) reported that Iraq resumed oil pumping to Turkey through a pipeline shut in 2014 after attacks by the Islamic State.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/ships-risk-hormuz-strait-due-to-limited-us-protection?traffic_source=rss) reported that Atlantic Council analyst Elisabeth Braw stated the US navy cannot provide protection to every vessel passing the Hormuz Strait.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraq-and-turkey-resume-oil-flows-pipeline-damaged-isis-what-know) reported that Iraq and Turkey resumed oil flows via a pipeline damaged by ISIS.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/oil-tanker-fire-strait-of-hormuz-one-missing-b3086972.html) reported that an oil tanker erupted into a huge inferno in the Strait of Hormuz following US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219935), a state-run outlet, reported that Oman evacuated 24 crew members from the Tara Gas tanker after a fire broke out onboard.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQYW55RnRFY2o3QVQ5M0ZRRElNUGhWUlhPaDkyODFYbEprTWw5NHhyTUFKSDQ5RE1TOWZWaElmSkY0UnZZeGUyMnFRbXpaOHo2SkxyaTFDUEowd3ZVUS1VaG9TRF9aTmNldHJyUGZtNnFuc2E2NGd0c0NNeDB5ai1rUTVQXzhZNzA5QUlUcTFINUJBZEYzMVRtREg5TTdCWjA2aEFXdWoydENMbTJyTlo3MDJxSHJTTnhlSm53YjJaTmFrRHV3ZEE?oc=5) reported that the UKMTO said the crew of a tanker was unaccounted for following a second attack north of Khasab, Oman.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-17-crew-abandons-gas-tanker-off-oman-after-being-hit-by-projectile-sources-say/) reported that sources said the crew abandoned a liquefied petroleum gas tanker off Oman after it was struck by a projectile.

[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219823), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Iraq resumed oil pumping to Turkey through the old pipeline with an initial export capacity of 120,000 barrels per day.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOZEM0V09PMzNwMW5Eck5aSWVqWU02QzZsOHlJdHZrUHh1VDNOUFZIc1ZBbWJWOG9RX0ljdlpoMUhfX3o3QzQwNlJSUzRIbXhDbTBtZ0VEV0VtUWZCOUlwczJCQXVEN3hDN0x5TVVVZ1NaWm9LT3BPWTNsTHZicmpGOEM3bHhNa0VvQTJ0UzQ1NERFR1diOXdvYXlnUk9QeHMtaEw4MHFGR0VHTV9KZHpsT0hjZTQ?oc=5) reported that Saudi Arabia intercepted three Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-saudi-led-coalition-repels-houthi-missiles?traffic_source=rss) reported that Saudi Arabia issued emergency alerts for Riyadh as the Saudi coalition downed three missiles.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584369/saudi-defences-destroy-missile-launched-by-houthis/) reported that Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Yemen's Houthi movement towards the kingdom's southern region.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/one-a-night-houthi-missile-tactic-stretches-saudi-defences/) reported that a one-a-night Houthi missile tactic stretches Saudi defences.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/houthi-attacks-add-worries-over-trump-saudi-nuclear-power-pact), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthi-attacks-adds-concerns-over-trump-saudi-nuclear-power-pact) reported that Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure are adding security concerns over Donald Trump's proposed nuclear deal with Riyadh ahead of a US Senate vote.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPb3pQREZDSHE2RmNHdDdGdExDUXhYeWljc2VualVoQ09oQV90WnFQQlZkYW1rWnl5ODJ6N2haaVBDVUY4VmFvRmtLSlZKbU5kR1lHNklrUUR3X3JGc181OHZCUHpXalZFUllBZXVEczJPUUdZZUt1MmpsTEN0MkJGSDNCVHhoa25pZFBSb1lldS1US0VJNVNBWWN1U2VwQmd0WmlQR1RKWmgyS2lyUDVfNHdWeWhzaFhmZ1E?oc=5), [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Rebound-as-Houthi-Attacks-Reignite-Middle-East-Supply-Fears.html) reported that crude oil prices gained following fresh Houthi attacks on Saudi targets.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220811), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a cruise missile strike achieved direct and accurate hits on an airport and financial center in Riyadh.

reports.text: [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/financieel/jim-tehupuring-duidt-de-val-van-het-aandeel-nvidia-na-affaire-jensen-huang-een-koopkans/164869745.html) reported on market reactions and the drop in Nvidia's share price following the Jensen Huang affair.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/world/asia/china-nvidia-spy-chips-state-security.html) reported that China's espionage agency ran a campaign to help companies acquire advanced AI chips and gather intelligence on the sector years before recent scandals.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/chips-h200-de-nvidia-son-el-limite-que-eu-puede-enviar-a-china-bessent-empresa-dejo-de-exportar-procesadores-de-ia-al-pais-asiatico/) reported that Bessent stated Nvidia H200 chips are the limit the U.S. can send to China, while the company stopped exporting AI processors to the Asian country.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649186-trump-second-chance-nvidia-huang/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Donald Trump stated Jensen Huang deserves a second chance while Nvidia faces a congressional inquiry, an SEC investigation, and a share price drop.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1089686/tramp-huang-zasluzuje-drugu-sansu-volio-bih-da-se-iskreno-izvini-i-vrati-na-posao) reported that Donald Trump stated that Huang deserves a second chance and that he would like him to apologize and return to work.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/dzensen-huang-nece-se-vratiti-u-nvidiu-iako-tramp-trazi-oprostaj/wcwgn3b) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang deserves a second chance, while Nvidia stated there is no return to his position.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/nvidia-donald-trump-scott-bessent-amd-chinese-b3089013.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/no-further-restrictions-on-nvidias-chip-exports-to-china-after-block-on-remote-access-scott-bessent-101795216575430.html) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated no further restrictions on older Nvidia chips exported to China are needed.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3375287/nvidia-faces-further-blow-after-shock-us-export-permit-data-release-analysts) reported that US lawmakers released confidential licensing records showing Washington approved semiconductor trade with Chinese firms.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-war/article/3375249/after-nvidia-will-amd-be-target-chinas-second-choice-ai-chips) reported that short sellers targeted Advanced Micro Devices over alleged connections to Chinese firms blacklisted by Washington.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641359/california-subpoenas-nvidia-over-possible-china-chip-transfers-investor-claims) reported that California subpoenaed Nvidia over possible China chip transfers and investor claims regarding risks linked to Jensen Huang's ties to a woman suspected of Chinese espionage.

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/awami-league-leaders-houses-set-on-fire-clashes-with-bnp-sheikh-hasina-likely-return-bangladesh-dhaka-violence-tensions-101795313367961.html) reported that nearly 30 houses of Awami League party leaders were set ablaze in Bangladesh amid tensions over the likely return of Sheikh Hasina.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/world/asia/bangladesh-protests-sheikh-hasina-what-to-know.html) reported that supporters of deposed prime minister Sheikh Hasina, who was sentenced to death in absentia, have waged a small-scale insurgency.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-reports-101795247826142.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister vowed action against those behind arson and blamed Awami League-linked groups.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-says-reports/article71727826.ece) reported that Humaiun Kobir stated law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-hit-by-fresh-arson-attacks-in-political-unrest/article71725621.ece) reported that police stated 124 people linked to the Awami League had been arrested in Dhaka over the previous 24 hours.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/3-killed-as-violence-grips-bangladesh-amid-hasinas-return-buzz-120-linked-to-her-party-arrested-101795182684277.html) reported that three people were killed in violence as hundreds of paramilitary troops were deployed amid unrest and over 120 people linked to Hasina's party were arrested.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-bangladesh-hasina-supporters-vandalise-ruling-party-office) reported that hundreds of supporters of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina staged street protests and engaged in arson attacks.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3375123/violence-rises-bangladesh-ex-pm-hasinas-supporters-escalate-protests) reported that fresh violence erupted in Bangladesh as supporters of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina tried to bring businesses and public transport to a halt.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/bangladesh-violent-protest-sheikh-hasina-planned-return) reported that the Awami League party called for nationwide protests and parts of Bangladesh were shut down following the government's rejection of Hasina's passport request.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/bangladesh-tightens-security-amid-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return/) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security measures amid tensions surrounding former prime minister Sheikh Hasina's possible return.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045579/paramilitary-units-deployed-in-bangladesh-amid-hasina-unrest) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security, deployed paramilitary units, and reported a petrol bomb killing an activist in the former prime minister's hometown alongside arson attacks targeting Grameen Bank branches.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583366/hasinas-planned-return-sparks-violence-across-bangladesh/) reported that Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops as violence and tensions spread over the planned return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-deploys-paramilitary-as-unrest-grows-overhasinas-return/article71717353.ece) reported that police recorded dozens of crude bomb blasts and torched vehicles across at least 28 districts over 10 days.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/police-in-bangladesh-clash-with-garment-workers-demanding-higher-minimum-wages) reported that police in Bangladesh clashed with garment workers demanding a minimum monthly wage increase to 30,000 takas.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/india-cannot-dictate-terms-on-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-pms-adviser/article71712874.ece) reported that an adviser to the Prime Minister of Bangladesh stated that India cannot dictate terms regarding Sheikh Hasina's return.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-with-police-in-fresh-protests-over-wages?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladeshi police clashed with garment workers who hurled bricks, torched vehicles, and blocked the highway between Dhaka and Mymensingh.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/fresh-protests-erupt-in-bangladesh-amid-garment-workers-wage-strike-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return-101794908401544.html) reported that workers demanded a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka, representing a 140 per cent increase over their current wage of 12,500 taka.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3374768/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-police-fresh-wage-protest) reported that police fired tear gas and stun grenades during clashes with thousands of garment workers protesting after a key wage board meeting.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fresh-unrest-in-bangladesh-as-garment-workers-protest-block-highway-for-higher-wages-101794900759373.html), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045168/bangladesh-garment-workers-police-clash-in-fresh-wage-protest) reported that Bangladeshi police used tear gas and stun grenades against garment workers protesting on highways for higher wages.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-dismisses-reports-of-india-setting-conditions-for-sheikh-hasinas-return-she-ll-return-under-extradition-treaty-101794840686924.html) reported that Bangladesh minister Shama Obaed Islam stated Bangladesh will consider any formal conditions India may put forward regarding Hasina's return.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/ex-bangladesh-pm-hasina-return-home-despite-death-threat-6554771) reported that former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated no threat of death will keep her away from her country as she plans a December return.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/ex-primeira-ministra-de-bangladesh-sheikh-hasina-diz-que-pretende-voltar-ao-pais-em-dezembro-apesar-de-condenacao-a-morte.ghtml) reported that 79-year-old former prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated she intends to return to Bangladesh in December despite her death sentence.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/sheikh-hasina-to-return-through-legal-means-what-india-does-is-up-to-them-bangladesh-minister-101794715954956.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister stated Sheikh Hasina will return through legal means and that Dhaka has completed its part of the legal process.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/sheikh-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-india-wants-dhaka-to-fulfil-two-conditions-says-report/articleshow/135824475.cms) reported that India is seeking Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile and has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uk-parliamentarians-appeal-to-foreign-secretary-for-sheikh-hasina-death-penalty-safeguards-101794387141548.html) reported that UK parliamentarians appealed to the Foreign Secretary for safeguards regarding Sheikh Hasina and the death penalty.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/10/bangladesh-prosecutor-warns-hasina-faces-execution-if-she-returns?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal said ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/10/disgraced-former-leader-sheikh-hasina-plans-return-to-bangladesh-after-two-years-in-exile) reported that disgraced former leader Sheikh Hasina plans a return to Bangladesh from exile and is confident she will return despite facing the death penalty.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043510/bangladesh-prosecutor-says-ex-pm-sheikh-hasina-will-be-executed-if-she-returns) reported that a Bangladeshi prosecutor said ousted leader Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladeshs-ousted-leader-sheikh-hasina-appeals-for-a-new-passport-to-return-from-exile/article71681436.ece) reported that Dhaka wants Sheikh Hasina extradited under a prisoner exchange, while Minister Humayun Kabir called her a terrorist and dismissed her request for a fresh passport.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914675) reported that immediately after laughter from the group, the sentinel moved toward them and shouted that all visitors must maintain an atmosphere of silence.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/politics/massie-trump-difficult-republican-votes.html) reported that Representative Thomas Massie stated he would use his remaining time in office to push his party toward votes for sanity.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-defends-hegseth-labels-impeachment-push-ridiculous-show-3725437) reported that US Vice President JD Vance defended Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and dismissed an impeachment resolution as a ridiculous show.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-house-votes-derail-impeachment-hegseth) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives banded together to derail an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cxly4y5jzl0qo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the US House blocked a bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth for now.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/hegseth-impeachment-vote-news-house-b3082802.html) reported that Donald Trump took a victory lap after the House GOP shelved the Pete Hegseth impeachment articles.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-republicans-derail-bid-to-impeach-hegseth/article71687959.ece) reported that the U.S. House voted 211 to 204 to send the impeachment resolution to the Judiciary Committee.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/embattled-pentagon-chief-slams-impeachment-farce/W7JRTBI6NZAKZNPDSPUIEQWPFI/) reported that the articles accused Pete Hegseth of misconduct over Iran, Yemen and boat strikes.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegset-preziveo-pokusaj-opoziva/lgp5w4q) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an initiative to impeach Pete Hegseth.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/congresistas-republicanos-bloquean-juicio-politico-hegseth_202611116af42580ea8d89799781613d.html) reported that the impeachment was pushed by Representative Thomas Massie.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-republicans-block-efforts-to-impeach-us-defence-secretary-pete-hegseth-over-iran-war) reported that Hegseth defended operations he led in Yemen, Iran, and against alleged drug smugglers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/house-hegseth-impeachment-vote.html) reported that Republicans turned back an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, sparing him from potential ouster.

reports.text: [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374928/malaysias-pardons-board-minutes-expose-legal-rift-over-najibs-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's attorney general objected to former prime minister Najib Razak's house arrest on the grounds that it had no legal basis, though the king approved the arrangement.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/najib-razak-house-arrest-declassified-minutes-attorney-general-hannah-yeoh-6561556) reported that Pardons Board minutes showed Malaysia's AG warned that Najib's house arrest could affect political stability and the country's image, and that Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh also opposed the move.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-poll-results-analysis-malaysia-general-election-challenges-6552746) reported that a BN-PN alliance achieved a landslide victory in Melaka.
[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-election-2026-bn-landslide-anwar-ph-pn-6551571) reported that the Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional alliance won 24 seats in the Melaka polls.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374416/malaysias-melaka-election-begins-anwars-ph-seeks-counter-resurgent-umno) reported that voters began casting ballots on Saturday morning to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka over the next five years.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-melaka-state-election-bn-pn-najib-razak-6545381) reported that former Prime Minister Najib Razak's conditional pardon sparked concerns over preferential treatment among some voters.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/former-malaysia-pm-najib-razak-house-arrest-sentence-6545056) reported that Najib Razak had submitted a written request for a second residence to be included in his house arrest arrangements, but this was not approved.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/malaysias-ex-pm-transferred-to-house-arrest-for-1mdb-graft-sentence?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak was transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home for house arrest.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-house-arrest-anwar-ibrahim-umno-6542426) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's anti-corruption agenda has taken a perceived hit despite him not having the final say in former premier Najib Razak's house arrest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374042/taiwan-pauses-malaysia-investment-talks-after-anwar-remarks-spark-fury-taipei) reported that Malaysia is seeking to reassure Taiwanese investors that it remains a reliable destination for hi-tech manufacturing after Taipei suspended bilateral investment talks.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/malaysian-court-clears-former-pm-najib-razak-for-house-arrest-transfer?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxORXB4UWVtZXBzZXM1eGhQa0tGX21hamxBcVpnR2lfMUUxV1dyc0RvdXZGQk9KSGxNQ2ZrNjJZSmJrcjNJSjVlZXRkZkVSUjk0NERGWTZSN3RzWFNYWENwdERHZDlQS1lRaF9PaG0tRmNfMW5yeGYyYzI3ZEx0d3Mxb25jeWlMQXF5SzNkdDNLZEl4N05JdmlGVjNBSWxLUms5OWNkYkUyUkNXVEl3cm9iOV84eG0wQlVodHhabkVLR0s0TFdsTTRMeFJR?oc=5) reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/malaysian-court-clears-final-hurdle-for-former-pm-najib-razaks-transfer-to-house-arrest/article71686082.ece) reported that a Malaysian court cleared the final hurdle for former Prime Minister Najib Razak's transfer to house arrest.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3373950/malaysia-court-clears-najib-begin-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's former prime minister Najib Razak arrived home after the High Court cleared the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison term under house arrest.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-ex-pm-najib-razak-released-prison-house-arrest-royal-pardon-6538231) reported that Najib Razak arrived home in Kuala Lumpur to serve the remainder of his jail term under house arrest after being released from Kajang Prison.
