reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/22/bessent-confirms-hes-living-on-us-military-base-over-iran-fears?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated he is still living at a US military base two weeks after an Israeli warning.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/treasury-secretary-bessent-insists-us-will-continue-squeezing-irans-economy-3013189) reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the United States will continue to squeeze Iran's economy until Tehran adheres to a deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/two-men-stand-trial-uk-next-year-over-raf-fairford-incident-allegedly-linked-iran), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/islamic-terrorism/article-915588) reported that two men charged over the September security incident at the RAF Fairford military base, which British and US prosecutors say was linked to Iran, are to stand trial next year.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915234) reported that British counterterrorism police arrested a US Army officer near Gloucester under investigation over espionage allegations.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90415) reported that British authorities transferred a US Army officer suspected of spying for Russia to American military custody.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/uk-hands-nato-assigned-us-soldier-accused-of-russia-spying-to-us-military?traffic_source=rss) reported that UK authorities transferred the investigation in line with existing international protocols.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/scott-bessent-confirms-relocating-from-washington-home-to-military-base-amid-iranian-threats-101794581505450.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914821) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed relocating from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-charges-3-alleged-iran-operatives-for-targeting-raf-fairford-in-uk-20-other-terror-plots-101794384900293.html) reported that US prosecutors charged three alleged operatives for targeting RAF Fairford in the UK and other terror plots.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/us-charges-three-men-for-allegedly-plotting-attack-on-uk-base?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US charged three men for allegedly plotting an attack on a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-charges-3-alleged-iranian-operatives-over-plots-targeting-jewish-communities-and-a-uk-airbase/a-79913543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US prosecutors claimed three alleged Iranian operatives were planning a campaign of terror against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261110-us-iranian-operatives-raf-fairford-terror-plot) reported that the US Justice Department charged three men described as Iranian operatives over an alleged September terrorist plot at Britain's RAF Fairford airbase.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374046/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-military-base-after-iran-threats) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved from his Washington DC residence to a US military base after Iranian threats against his life.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-to-military-base-after-iranian-threats-reports-say/article71688103.ece) reported that Iran has previously denied plotting to attend officials and people on U.S. soil.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/ministar-finansija-sad-a-se-preselio-u-vojnu-bazu-zbog-straha-od-irana/) reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base due to threats from Iran.

[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/xJR66p/wsj-usa-evakuerte-fly-fra-britisk-militaerbase?utm_medium=rss) reported that the US moved several military aircraft from a base in the UK following threats from Iran.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/us-soldier-arrested-in-great-britain-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia-9czbdwu) reported that British police detained an American soldier accused of passing sensitive information to foreign intelligence services.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-soldier-arrested-in-england-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia) reported that the FBI stated the case is of the utmost concern.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bessent-moved-base-iran-threats.html) reported that Treasury Secretary Bessent was moved from his D.C.-area home to a military base amid Iranian threats.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPcnM2ZmY3ZXBGMkQwN09vMkxoZTNNd3MxSjRnZnFnN3RrUDVNeTk3LUYxVHNWQ2RnMkQ4OVF5RDNlSUlLbzcxUFJvaGFCU3pscExIbVZ1VldROUl3X1pvSktwVDJGcTlYMzNmY3FwRFhJeVJmZHpHd1F4UnpmeHlNOFUxb0ZnRlFiY2oyZA?oc=5) reported that a U.S. soldier was arrested in England on suspicion of espionage related to Russia.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOTWFjbHBKUTJzdVgtMEpEdktjTk16NWFQVkJncFJTV3UxcFJET2Ixc0d2M2lwdjZyYk0xY1RSd0pDbzF4ZFdJeXRORS1TQlItU21NdmRDRVBoRUZhUTQwYnNCWmZ2VE9lenMtdDJ1MXotZ1pxNkNQN09OMlhuWWJvX3QxZWZsWnJMbTJreDQ5YzRnQ0ZwTVB3?oc=5) reported that three individuals were charged in the U.S. with planning terror attacks, including an alleged assault on a British airbase.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-pulls-tankers-special-ops-planes-from-raf-mildenhall-over-iran-threat) reported that air refueling tankers and special operations aircraft dispersed from RAF Mildenhall as force protection levels were elevated.

[Gazeta Wyborcza](https://wyborcza.pl/7,75399,33125223,amerykanie-zabieraja-samoloty-z-kolejnej-brytyjskiej-bazy-boja.html) reported that American tankers were evacuated from a second base in Britain because of an Iran threat.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-military-aircraft-pulled-from-second-uk-base-after-iran-threat/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that bombers were withdrawn from RAF Fairford in October after an Iran-linked security incident.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579406/us-withdraws-aircraft-from-second-uk-military-base/) reported that the United States moved at least 10 military aircraft from RAF Mildenhall following an alleged threat linked to Iran.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-relocates-military-aircraft-from-british-base-amid-iran-threats-101794324495306.html) reported that the U.S. Air Force relocated 13 aircraft from RAF Mildenhall to bases in Scotland, Spain, and Germany after identifying a threat.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189962/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-12-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that the US military withdrew at least 12 refueling aircraft from a British military base due to an Iranian threat.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/us-evacuates-aircraft-from-british-military-base-after-threat-from-iran-wsj-reports/) reported that the United States evacuated American military aircraft from a base in England following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-withdraws-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase) reported that Sky News stated 12 aircraft left Mildenhall on Monday based on flight tracking sources.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%82%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%af%d8%a9-%d8%b9%d8%b3%d9%83%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%ae%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%ac%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d9%85%d8%aa%d9%82%d8%af%d9%91%d9%85%d8%a9-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%83%d9%88%d9%8a%d8%aa/) reported that the Gulf Cooperation Council approved opening a forward headquarters for the Unified Military Command in Kuwait during a defense meeting in Manama.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202526/%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AC-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%AF%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA/) reported that GCC Secretary General Jassim Al-Budaiwi stated defense ministers approved opening the forward command and allocating suitable forces.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202527/%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D9%82%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9/) reported that Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman stated the meeting in Bahrain emphasizes enhancing military capabilities.

reports.text: [VG](https://www.vg.no/rampelys/i/pMLEQo/brand-video-utloeser-politisk-strid?utm_medium=rss) reported that British authorities asked Google to shut down Russell Brand's YouTube account.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/burnham-urges-google-to-remove-russell-brand-youtube-statement/107407936) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham told Google to remove a Russell Brand video, stating victims have heard enough from the convicted rapist.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/19/google-youtube-russell-brand-youtube-prison-message-jess-phillips-new-law) reported that ex-minister Jess Phillips stated a new law may be needed after Google rejected the call to remove Russell Brand's YouTube prison message.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/youtube-urged-to-take-down-russell-brands-account/NZQIYYLKY5D4ZJSVP44HFTQK3M/) reported that the Ministry of Justice is investigating whether Russell Brand broke prison rules.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1118/1599771-russell-brand-youtube-uk/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/uk-government-urges-google-to-take-down-branded-youtube-message/) reported that the UK government asked Google to remove a YouTube video featuring convicted rapist Russell Brand declaring his innocence.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/19/prison-authorities-consider-russell-brand-youtube-message-rules-victim-distress) reported that prison authorities are weighing up comments issued through the rapist's wife.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQMy1kYm1oemdYd3hLSUI3cktJbkpTY3Y1SWJJY0xHbFQ3blBMRS1MRnZCWWlDUW15ZkczTHBoTzVzckFnaXJ3Y183R0tnWmp5R3BaaWp0d3NNZ09YbW8tcVEtTENCNllMWkMyU1NoTXpYN0dXYXFrcEFsVEhELURjX0hTQ1dLZGJmZEd5d3EyOA?oc=5) reported that a woman is waiving her anonymity to state that Russell Brand sexually assaulted her when she was 16.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/18/uk-government-russell-brand-youtube-deactivated-google), [BILD](https://www.bild.de/unterhaltung/stars-und-leute/russell-brand-schickte-botschafts-aus-dem-gefaengnis-regierung-will-seinen-youtube-kanal-sperren-lassen-6afe009b82b53b7db9d8f289) reported that UK ministers asked Google to deactivate Russell Brand's YouTube account following a message sent from prison.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/2026/11/18/russell-brand-case-prompts-uk-to-rethink-the-age-of-consent/) reported that Labour sources suggest tightening the UK age of consent law from 16 to prevent age-related power imbalances following the Russell Brand case.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russell-brand-to-be-punished-as-prison-bosses-reportedly-furious-he-sent-message-out-via-his-wife/Q5YY73F5L5A7XKZOIUTYY45CUI/) reported that Russell Brand will face punishment after prison bosses were angered by a message he sent out via his wife.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQZDNZZE9hdnNBMmR6RlVGZllpWFdoNEZzanNmSXlxSUpUVVJCazBUOXZoVmxFTk1VYXlUWjN5SjJkLVlPRDlFTThfbTRlb2lwcUNUbGlsZS0zOU9IdFhYbnpycEZSMWpLMG9naDRJMk5WN3poLXN2LVZiNmpuT3UtS3FuWDRJTkpu?oc=5) reported that convicted rapist Russell Brand is under investigation for claiming innocence from behind bars.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/russell-brand-and-noel-fielding-joke-about-rape-on-the-2007-big-fat-quiz-of-the-year-20261117-p61ewv.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Noel Fielding stated he is appalled at jokes made in the past and horrified to learn of Russell Brand's crimes.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2026/nov/16/ed-miliband-russell-brand-andy-burnham-brexit-eu-milburn-review-young-people-employment-uk-politics-latest-news) reported that Ed Miliband defended conducting a 2015 election interview with Russell Brand, stating he was taking him on rather than endorsing him.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1116/1599470-russell-brand-message/) reported that comedian Russell Brand could face disciplinary action, including having phone calls restricted, after sharing a message from prison.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/jailed-russell-brands-wife-breaks-her-silence-on-his-incarceration/S5IXT4S2WBBAXANHU4UO2NE5HI/) reported that Russell Brand's wife broke her silence on his incarceration after he was sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape and sexual assault.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/16/ministry-of-justice-investigating-russell-brand-message) reported that the UK Ministry of Justice launched an investigation into a message from Russell Brand from prison.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/russell-brand-under-investigation-over-appalling-prison-statement-20261117-p61eok.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the convicted rapist's comments could breach rules against causing distress to victims.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/russell-brand-wife-issues-statement-saying-he-is-not-guilty/107389440) reported that Russell Brand issued a statement from prison maintaining his innocence after being moved to a facility for sex offenders.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2026/nov/16/woman-accusing-david-walliams-grooming-backs-staggered-age-of-consent-call) reported that a woman who accused David Walliams of grooming her expressed support for calls to change the age of consent law following allegations involving Russell Brand.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/russell-brand-rape-accuser-age-of-consent-law-change/) reported that a woman alleging comedian Russell Brand raped her at age 16 called for changes to the UK age of consent law.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/14/woman-who-alleges-russell-brand-raped-her-when-she-was-16-waives-anonymity/) reported that Mia Latter waived her anonymity regarding allegations that Russell Brand raped her when she was 16.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russell-brand-secretly-moved-to-softer-prison-for-his-own-safety/4D5ZSWVOYBH3NNSKHBKV4WAL5E/), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/russell-brand-moved-to-new-prison-20261116-p61ecw.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Russell Brand was moved to a softer British prison following his rape conviction.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/uk-tv-star-jeremy-edwards-says-david-walliams-sexually-humiliated-him-during-sketch-on-stage/IDUUVNUX4FD67ET7FX5AEYQKOA/) reported that UK TV star Jeremy Edwards stated David Walliams sexually humiliated him during a stage sketch.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/uk-to-consider-changing-age-of-consent-after-brand-case-walliams-claims-20261116-p61ec9.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the UK will consider changing the age of consent following a case involving Russell Brand and claims regarding David Walliams.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/15/uk-government-to-consider-changing-age-of-consent-after-allegations-against-russell-brand) reported that the UK government will consider changing the age of consent following allegations against Russell Brand.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/uk-police-investigating-comedian-david-walliams-over-serious-allegations-20261114-p61e67.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that British police are investigating comedian and author David Walliams over reports of alleged serious sexual offenses.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQczlhMFFEcjA0WHlFTW10cmZFdE9PYkpNemV2WV9pRHhxbTJMaE83akxtVnM4MVV0M3hWMkZTaFdSR0hBckU2NlgwcHB3SDVROUU4U0huVGJxc0pRSEVXWjVBM2h6X0RIaTl2V1BBOU5EeGZjQlpiSzlhTWRIb0x5QnhuOXd6ZHNnTHhUMklUczRRLWV5OXFoZXFHZEFwMUU?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/uk-police-open-sex-offence-probe-into-comedian-and-author-david-walliams?traffic_source=rss) reported that British police launched a sex offense investigation into children's author and TV personality David Walliams.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/david-walliams-investigated-by-police-over-serious-sexual-offences/W6ULC66545D6RCOODEOSQMALAM/) reported that the Metropolitan Police's complaints regarding David Walliams are separate from claims reported by ITN and the Guardian.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/british-childrens-author-david-walliams-investigated-over-grooming-assault-allegations-involving-minors/articleshow/135812274.cms) reported that a British children's author is being investigated over grooming and assault allegations involving minors.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-14/six-more-women-accuse-russell-brand-of-sexual-offences/107385408), [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNS1dvX1hiNzRzS09VWFU2UmFCNzVUZ290Tkx0QzRoTl9la3RseTNUWVNXZHhCUThYWDdTd25RNmpWTGJBVDl1ZUZQcHgxTjBaNTFWUUtmbVdyMkxFYXBLdlpiTjgxMFdFQ2NnZUpGTlY5ZXpKYVUtcUdwd1VjNlZsaXZpWU9vbVFEd3NVX1pKYTFiazhodE9BUA?oc=5) reported that six more women came forward with allegations of sexual offences against Russell Brand.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/families-clear-homes-of-david-walliams-books-after-sexual-offence-allegations) reported that families cleared their homes of David Walliams books following sexual offense allegations.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/david-walliams-allegations-met-police-investigation), [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-14/uk-police-launch-investigation-into-david-walliams/107385506), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/uk/2026/1113/1599155-met-walliams/) reported that London's Metropolitan Police launched an investigation into actor and comedian David Walliams following allegations of sexual offenses.
[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/brand-accused-of-sexual-misconduct-by-six-more-women/DS6N6PMGSZDALLOC4LDHW6S57M/) reported that Brand was accused of sexual misconduct by six more women.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2026/nov/11/jonathan-ross-david-walliams-russell-brand-revelations) reported that TV presenter Jonathan Ross said he was genuinely unaware of David Walliams and Russell Brand's conduct.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/britain-david-walliams-court-accused_n_6af38776e4b0a8468d8bf053) reported that British comedian and children's author David Walliams was accused of sexual misconduct and unsuccessfully sought a court injunction to bar two news outlets from identifying him.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/europe/jemima-goldsmith-russell-brand-assault.html) reported that Jemima Goldsmith accused Russell Brand of violence and coercive control during their relationship.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/sexual-predator-russell-brand-jailed-for-10-years-for-rape-assault) reported that British comedian and TV star Russell Brand was jailed for more than 10 years for a string of sex offences including rape.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/09/arts/russell-brand-prison-sentence-rape.html) reported that a London judge said the former comedy star had shown a casual, arrogant disregard for women's wishes.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3373989/uk-childrens-author-david-walliams-accused-sexual-misconduct) reported that British children's author and comedian David Walliams was accused by two news outlets of grooming girls and young women for sex.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/david-walliams-speaks-out-amid-sexual-misconduct-allegations-as-high-court-rejects-injunction-i-am-devastated-101794320603554.html) reported that the High Court dismissed an injunction bid over sexual misconduct allegations against David Walliams, with two women accusing him of misconduct.

reports.text: [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-contra-el-exfiscal-general-de-paraguay-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33238340) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against former Attorney General Emiliano Rolón.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-exfiscal-general-paraguay-ueno-bank_1795221891) reported that the Paraguayan Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against the former attorney general regarding Ueno Bank, alongside the resignation and preventative detention of former Central Bank head Carlos Carvallo and three board directors.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/19/ueno-bank-collapse-claims-paraguay-s-attorney-general-and-the-head-of-itaipu?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General Emiliano Rolón resigned and the Paraguayan director of the binational Itaipú dam departed following the Ueno Bank collapse.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-attorney-general-rolon-resigns/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay’s Attorney General Emiliano Rolon Fernandez resigned to stop an impeachment trial in the Chamber of Deputies.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063370/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185843-russia-loses-1970-troops-over-past-day-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff updated Russian combat losses by 1,970 soldiers over the past day.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23956425) reported that the phone of Serbian Justice Minister Nenad Vujic was seized by prosecutors over suspicions he directed an organized criminal group involved in buying votes from prisoners.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/bivsi-ministar-kulture-u-pristini-uhapsen-zbog-trgovine-drogom/9hn2rye) reported that police seized cocaine, marijuana, ecstasy, luxury cars, watches, and jewelry.

Klix reported that former Serbian Minister of Economy Rade Basta was arrested in Belgrade on suspicion of corruption related to questionable donations to sports clubs ([Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/uhapsen-bivsi-ministar-privrede-srbije-rade-basta-osumnjicen-za-korupciju-sporne-donacije-sportskim-klubovima/261111071)).

Nezavisne Novine reported that Rade Basta was detained early in the morning at the Nikola Tesla Airport in Belgrade while allegedly attempting to leave Serbia ([Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Detalji-hapsenja-Radeta-Baste-Priveden-na-aerodromu-pokusao-da-napusti-Srbiju/991831)).

narratives.label: Italy School Bomb Threats

reports.text: [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/8703d9468de5), a state-media outlet, reported that Italian authorities stated school bomb threats were aimed at destabilising institutions and posed no concrete danger.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPbjZhbFk0amM2UzJvb1FIRXRrMjhhLWJmUVBUTkZXUExtLXp1VExsR0tKZmQzbFQxT2VpWDk5MDh3TElwdC03bmlZVjktcThjMEs2eWRRbWxWZ0cyRVd5c3lMLXFBSUVEUmMxaGRhcWtRb19YR2tLb01Dem5mX3ROSWpMMXZCY2hOYU5fdXMxajl6aDNNWVdxaW5R?oc=5) reported that Italy received fake bomb threats targeting nearly 7,500 schools.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/speciali/ansa-newsroom/2026/11/18/ansa-newsroom-fuori-tutti-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-caos-e-evacuazioni_732f890a-dda9-4cbc-9dca-a464e6d7c70b.html) reported that bomb alarms caused chaos and evacuations at schools.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/italian-schools-hit-by-new-wave-of-bomb-and-poison-threats) reported that under new security guidelines, Italian schools are no longer automatically evacuated for vague mass threats, leaving the decision to schools.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/europe-scrambles-to-respond-to-wave-of-bomb-threats-disrupting-transport-media-and-schools/) reported that an unprecedented wave of bomb threats disrupted transport, media, and schools across Europe.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187254-three-people-injured-in-russian-attack-on-zaporizhzhia-including-two-children.html) reported that three people, including two children, were injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%8a%d9%88%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b7%d9%81%d9%84-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%8a-%d8%a8%d8%b9%d9%8a%d9%88%d9%86-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d9%91%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b4%d9%87%d9%8a/) reported that on Universal Children's Day, Syrian state media noted the anniversary through the cases of Hamza al-Khateeb and Tamer al-Sharai.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190662/%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A-350-%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%B3%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84) reported that the Palestine Prisoners Studies Center stated that 350 Palestinian children in Israeli occupation prisons face various forms of torture, abuse, starvation, and medical neglect.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187086-injury-toll-in-russian-attacks-on-kryvyi-rih-rises-to-60.html) reported that the number of people injured in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih rose to 60, with 28 people remaining in hospital.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063901/) reported that a jet-powered Russian drone struck an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih overnight, causing a fire.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063913/) reported that the number of people injured in strikes on central Kryvyi Rih rose to 58, including six children, with a paramedic and a boy killed.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063909/) reported that Russian forces carried out hundreds of attacks on settlements across Zaporizhzhia Oblast over the past 24 hours.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90783) reported that a Russian strike drone hit a five-story residential apartment building in Solonytsivka, injuring 11 people including children.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187050-injury-toll-after-russian-attacks-in-kharkiv-region-rises-to-11-including-two-children.html) reported that the injury toll from Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region rose to 11, including two children.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186904-injury-toll-from-russian-attack-on-zaporizhzhia-rises-to-ten.html) reported that the injury toll from Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district rose to ten.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187003-two-killed-including-child-in-russian-strike-on-kryvyi-rih-injury-toll-rises-to-42.html) reported that a Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih killed two people, including a child, and raised the injury toll to 42.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063928/) reported that firefighters in Chernihiv Oblast extinguished a fire at a business following a Russian attack.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90795), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187078-kyiv-reports-damage-in-three-districts-after-morning-russian-attack-two-people-injured.html) reported that a morning aerial attack on Kyiv injured two men and damaged residential buildings across three districts.
[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/3-killed-in-bridge-strikes-on-kyiv-mayor-says-a94324) reported that 8 people were killed across Ukraine as Russia struck bridges in Kyiv.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-at-least-2-injure-83-across-ukraine-as-strikes-devastate-kryvyi-rih/) reported that overnight on November 21 Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones according to Ukraine's Air Force.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/kyiv-russian-attacks-bridges) reported that Kyiv residents remained unbothered by Russian attacks on the city's bridges.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063879/) reported that Russian forces launched a drone attack on the outskirts of Kharkiv injuring two people.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186994-nine-people-injured-in-russian-strikes-in-kharkiv-region-on-friday.html) reported that nine people were injured in Russian strikes in Kharkiv and the surrounding region.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/russian-ballistic-missile-strike-on-ukraine-s-kryvyi-rih-injures-20-including-three-children), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186988-russian-forces-attack-kryvyi-rih-injuring-20-people.html) reported that a Russian ballistic missile strike on Kryvyi Rih injured 20 people and damaged a restaurant, garages, and cars.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90770), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063886/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-ballistic-missile-strikes-on-kryvyi-rih-kill-7-year-old-paramedic-injure-42-others-in-double-tap-attack/) reported that the strike killed a 7-year-old boy and a paramedic, and injured 42 people.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186680-russian-attack-damages-railway-infrastructure-several-trains-delayed.html) reported that railway infrastructure was damaged and several trains were delayed following a Russian attack.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-3-airspace-violations-a94331) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after three airspace violations.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/unidentified-object-falls-in-eastern-poland-amid-major-russian-attack-on-ukraine), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063740/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90676), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9f4712724be0), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186756-poland-investigating-crash-of-unidentified-object-near-border-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Poland is investigating a possible airspace violation or falling unidentified object during a Russian attack on Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89297987) reported that an unidentified drone entered Moldovan airspace from Ukraine, traveling for nine minutes from the Vinnytsia region.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88193791) reported that fragments of a Gerbera-2 drone were discovered near the village of Cuhureștii de Sus following a November 17 incursion.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185880-debris-of-russian-gerbera2-drone-found-in-moldova.html) reported that drone debris was also found near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

[Hungary Today](https://hungarytoday.hu/hungarian-conservatives-condemn-russian-drone-attack-on-ukraines-transcarpathia/) reported that several Russian drones struck Ukraine’s Transcarpathian region, targeting areas around Mukachevo.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88197893) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha condemned the incursion of Russian drones into Moldovan airspace.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88020919) reported that police located aircraft fragments near the village of Pohrebeni in the Orhei district following airspace violations.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87567475) reported that Moldovan Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Mihai Popsoi condemned the violation of national airspace by a Shahed-type drone.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/84002601) reported that the Moldovan Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the violation of national airspace by two Banderol cruise missiles.

reports.text: [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/bukele-lleva-guerra-pandillas-haiti_202611226b027809c0d5c85b96c4490e.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele sent 2,500 soldiers to Haiti following the disappearance of four soldiers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/22/operacao-militar-de-el-salvador-no-haiti-ignora-mandato-da-onu-e-exporta-modelo-bukele-sob-temor-de-excessos.ghtml) reported that thousands of Haitians marched in Port-au-Prince while El Salvador's military operation in Haiti ignores a UN mandate.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-for-third-consecutive-term-office/) reported that Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to seek a third consecutive term as president of El Salvador in February 2027 following constitutional reform.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/salvadoran-military-is-teaching-haitis-gangs-a-lesson-bukele/), a Salvadoran state-media outlet, reported that approximately 2,500 Salvadoran soldiers are participating in a mission in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/20/nayib-bukele-third-term-el-salvador-haiti-troops/) reported that El Salvador President Nayib Bukele's deployment of 2,500 troops to Haiti draws scrutiny over security and democracy.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-va-por-un-tercer-mandato-en-el-salvador-asi-fue-el-camino-de-reformas-que-permitio-su-nueva-candidatura-necesitamos-seis-anos-mas-3602666) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy for the February 2027 elections to seek a third presidential term.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/salvador-le-president-bukele-profite-de-sa-reforme-constitutionnelle-pour-se-presenter-a-un-troisieme-mandat_6813581_3210.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele formalized his candidacy for a third presidential term after constitutional modifications in 2025.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/el-salvadors-bukele-expected-to-formalise-bid-for-third-presidential-term?traffic_source=rss), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPOFQyR3VjRGNVUmZDV3lMOGdubmRvbU1tbTZsMTNLQ2x2QkUwSzVSLUE3RThET0xBQ3RmVEVWZS10b1JKZGxZNUVNNUMzZjROUVN5Yk4xc2ZlbTdhZDlCVUxKX1FFYmctY1huMG9yejFxT3ZxbE92cno3V1RnYWJKUXVPZjRxZmZJRVBkVTNBU0hxNUFzNUJuWmY2d3VYSWlqRnFudXNvcVR6UmhURGRFNw?oc=5) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele seeks a third presidential term while his forces fight gangs in Haiti.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/nayib-bukele-inscribe-su-candidatura-para-las-elecciones-de-2027-en-el-salvador-33223136), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/apos-retirar-limites-de-mandatos-bukele-registra-candidatura-para-se-manter-no-poder-em-el-salvador.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to run for a third term in the February 28 elections.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/19/haitians-brooklyn-rally-bukele-haiti-gangs/) reported that Haitian demonstrators gathered in Brooklyn to support Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele as his forces continued military operations against gangs in Haiti.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-haiti-salvador-s-bukele-publishes-video-of-attack-on-gang-leader-s-house) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele stated his troops demolished the lavish home of a prominent gang leader in Haiti known as Jeff Gwo Lwa.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-reacciona-a-las-multitudinarias-marchas-de-apoyo-en-haiti-y-promete-una-victoria-contra-las-pandillas-nunca-espere-algo-asi-3602255) El Tiempo reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele reacted to large-scale marches of support in Haiti, promising victory against armed gangs.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/bukele-confirms-airstrike-on-haitian-gang-leader-jeffs-luxury-mansion) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele confirmed an airstrike destroying the luxury mansion of Haitian gang leader Jeff Larose.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/bukele-anuncia-que-militares-salvadorenos-destruyeron-la-casa-de-un-jefe-pandillero-en-haiti-33197904) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele published a video showing military helicopters attacking the house of gang leader Jeff Gwo Lwa in Haiti.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/haiti-formaliza-acordo-com-el-salvador-enquanto-tropas-de-bukele-atacam-gangues.shtml) reported that Haiti formalized a cooperation agreement with El Salvador on the same day thousands marched in Port-au-Prince.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/miles-de-personas-marchan-en-haiti-en-respaldo-a-operaciones-de-tropas-militares-de-el-salvador-en-el-pais-presidente-nayib-bukele-reacciono-3601946) reported that thousands of people marched in Haiti in support of military troop operations by El Salvador.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPMVp1by1yclVIYnJfVnZTOEo0LWk2TFE4ampJMlFTdGVudVRMM2FROVpOUFp3WkZfTU5FVWZYMGx5OUE5d2M1TGU3UEMtUUk4Wk90cGdNeFA5dVJFT3BSSFhUeXM3azg2N1VYUEozVGRMNGw4ZlphRE9xZXRhZjlPZmJnbGx1V2c5WXZOV0pQcnktSGVHc0QtQXhzVkVGaFVURkhFdA?oc=5), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374964/el-salvadors-bukele-says-his-troops-destroyed-gang-leaders-mansion-haiti) reported that El Salvador’s President Nayib J. Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/18/bukele-strikes-gang-leader-home-vertieres-day/) reported that the operation marks the second reported strike on a gang leader’s residence by Salvadoran forces, following a previous attack on the home of Wilson “Lanmò San Jou”.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-que-militares-salvadorenhos-destruiram-casa-de-chefe-de-gangue-no-haiti.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the destruction of a Haitian gang leader's house during an offensive.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/haitians-rally-in-celebration-of-el-salvadors-anti-gang-troop-deployment?traffic_source=rss), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/17/haitians-take-streets-support-el-salvador-troops/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/haitians-demonstrate-in-support-of-el-salvadors-bukele-and-anti-gang-troops/) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets in Port-au-Prince to celebrate and thank El Salvador's anti-gang military troop deployment.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/haiti-formalises-security-pact-with-el-salvador-as-thousands-march-in-support-of-bukele) reported that Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador as thousands marched in support of Bukele, and noted the UN recorded 4,595 deaths and 2,050 injuries due to armed violence in Haiti in the first 10 months of 2026.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-haitians-rally-behind-bukele-as-salvadoran-troops-battle-gangs) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to continue fighting gangs as Salvadoran troops bolstered security forces.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/policias-militares-y-soldados-de-bukele-haiti-suma-fuerzas-contra-las-pandillas-pero-sigue-sin-saber-como-recuperar-el-control-3601736) reported that a Crisis Group report warned that a lack of coordination exposes the civilian population and called for strengthening Haitian institutions.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/17/haitians-rally-bukele-salvadoran-troops-haiti/) reported that thousands of people in Port-au-Prince demonstrated to praise Nayib Bukele and Salvadoran troops, as a new report warned that Haiti lacks a long-term plan to confront gangs.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/haiti-praises-salvadoran-troop-deployment-ahead-of-bukele-talks-101794861044668.html) reported that Haiti praised the deployment of Salvadoran troops ahead of talks with President Nayib Bukele.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/haiti-weighs-future-of-salvadoran-troops/) reported that Haiti's prime minister is due in El Salvador on November 16 and 17 to discuss Salvadoran troops, while a gang leader asks the UN for talks.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/bukele-sera-el-salvador-de-haiti-los-riesgos-y-las-alertas-alrededor-de-su-ultima-gran-apuesta-nid14112026/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele launched a mission with more than 2,000 soldiers in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/14/el-salvador-bukele-model-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador deployed roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele exports his hard-line security model.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-security-model-haiti/) reported that 2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed to Haiti outside UN command.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/14/mundo/018n2mun?partner=rss), a state-media outlet, reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that his soldiers, in coordination with Haitian police and military, took control.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/una-operacion-incomoda-para-trump-el-papel-de-estados-unidos-en-la-intervencion-militar-de-nayib-bukele-en-haiti-3600839) reported that the United States has found itself in an awkward position regarding Nayib Bukele's military intervention in Haiti due to a lack of operational coordination.
[Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/13/el-salvador-uses-armed-robot-dogs-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador uses armed robot dogs in a Haiti gang offensive.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/why-does-el-salvador-s-bukele-have-troops-in-haiti/a-79940771?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Haiti's Prime Minister congratulated El Salvador's President for a gang crackdown in Haiti.

[Haiti Libre](https://www.haitilibre.com/article-48884-haiti-flash-l-armee-du-salvador-utilise-des-chiens-robots-de-combat-equipes-de-fusil-d-assaut-video.html) Haiti Libre reported that the Salvadoran army uses assault rifle-equipped combat robot dogs during joint operations in Haiti.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/bukele-anuncia-que-encontraron-craneos-humanos-en-el-estadio-sylvio-cator-de-haiti-durante-ofensiva-contra-las-pandillas-sera-centro-de-operaciones-3600731) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that human skulls were found at Haiti's Sylvio Cator stadium during an offensive against gangs.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-haitian-police-retake-national-stadium-after-two-years-of-gang-control) reported that Haitian security forces regained control of the country's main football stadium after two years of gang control, with Salvadoran troops taking positions.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/13/el-salvador-deploys-armed-robots-to-fight-gangs-in-haiti?traffic_source=rss) reported that El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele released a video showing armed robots deployed during a gang operation in Haiti.

[Haiti Libre](https://www.haitilibre.com/article-48884-haiti-flash-l-armee-du-salvador-utilise-des-chiens-robots-de-combat-equipes-de-fusil-d-assaut.html) reported that a joint operation under a bilateral agreement allowed authorities to regain control using combat robot dogs equipped with assault rifles.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-ter-destruido-quartel-general-de-gangue-no-haiti-veja-video.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that Salvadoran military personnel in Haiti destroyed the headquarters of the 400 Mawozo gang.

reports.text: [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-18/cc-oo-acudira-a-los-tribunales-por-la-actuacion-policial-en-la-huelga-general-buena-parte-de-las-personas-golpeadas-son-de-nuestro-sindicato.html) reported that the Workers' Commissions union will go to court over police actions during the general strike, stating a good portion of the people beaten belonged to their union.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/spain-workers-1-general-strike-14-years/) reported that Spain's unions and tenant groups united across more than 50 cities in a general strike to demand rent caps, higher wages, and price controls.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/spain/2026-11-12/spains-general-strike-draws-uneven-participation-and-large-street-protests.html) reported that demonstrations during Spain's general strike were overwhelmingly peaceful, although clashes were recorded in Madrid and Barcelona.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-housing-protests-madrid-barcelona-b3083749.html) reported that more than 3 million people took to the streets in Spain for housing protests, resulting in at least 115 arrests nationwide.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/marlaska-ordena-ahora-investigar-actuacion-policial-huelga-general_202611126af5837403bbf30bb049669c.html) reported that the Interior Minister ordered an investigation into police actions during the general strike and instructed agents not to use tear gas in demonstrations.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/ofensiva-marlaska-dentro-fuera-gobierno-cargas-policiales-huelga_202611126af589d09a31a65adcd96693.html) reported that Frente Amplio and Podemos demanded the dismissal of the Interior Minister after the police actions on 11-N, while Bolanos discarded his dismissal.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/world/europe/spain-general-strike.html) reported that workers in Spain staged a general strike to protest rising rents and stagnant wages.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-general-strike-protesters-riot-police-clash-b3083461.html) reported that millions of workers took to the streets during the general strike in Spain over housing costs.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/spain-housing-crisis-prompts-general-strike-mass-nighttime-protests/a-79915208?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that hundreds of thousands of citizens hit the streets to protest Spain's housing crisis after millions of union workers staged a general strike.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/spain-holds-its-first-general-strike-in-14-years-amid-mass-protests-and-police-charges) reported that riot police clashed with masked protesters in Madrid and Barcelona during Spain's first general strike in 14 years, leaving more than 70 people arrested.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648726-barcelona-protests-clashes-rally/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that masked rioters smashed windows, looted shops, and set fires after tens of thousands marched in Barcelona demanding affordable housing.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/11/police-clash-with-protesters-during-spains-general-strike-video) reported that clashes erupted in the streets of Barcelona and Madrid as millions of Spanish workers took part in the general strike.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/spain-general-strike-over-housing-costs-before-national-election) reported that millions of Spanish workers shut down businesses and public transportation in a protest over housing costs.

reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641658/three-terrorists-killed-in-joint-ctd-pakistan-army-operation-in-peshawar) reported that three terrorists were killed in a joint operation by the CTD and Pakistan Army in Peshawar.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742526-gunmen-kill-plateau-state-university-security-guard-fresh-attack/) reported that gunmen killed 55-year-old Plateau State University security guard Sati Kalbas in an ambush in the Darwat community.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742536-forest-guard-killed-gun-battle-bandits/) reported that a National Forest Guard, Tuesday Michael Obamuroh, was killed in a suspected bandits' attack along the Iluke-Ofere axis in Kogi State.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045941/ctd-says-3-terrorists-including-mastermind-of-kohat-police-lines-attack-killed-in-ibo) reported that the Counter Terrorism Department killed three terrorists of the banned Ittehadul Mujahideen Pakistan, including the mastermind of the Kohat police lines attack.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/troops-rescue-21-kidnap-victims-nab-suspected-terrorist-in-kogi/) reported that Nigerian Army troops rescued 21 kidnapped victims from hideouts in Kogi State and arrested a suspected terrorist.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/field-marshal-asim-munir-reaffirms-resolve-to-eliminate-terrorism-from-kp/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045881/on-north-waziristan-visit-cdf-munir-vows-to-eliminate-terrorism-preserve-peace-in-kp) reported that Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir reaffirmed the security forces' resolve to eliminate terrorism during a visit to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-abduct-six-rustle-livestock-in-fresh-sokoto-attack/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that police confirmed bandits abducted six people and rustled goats and sheep in Dukkuma, Sabon Birni, Sokoto State, while dismissing an earlier report of 14 victims.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045649/cdf-munir-briefed-on-ongoing-operations-during-balochistan-visit-ispr) reported that Chief of Defence Forces and Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir was briefed on counterterrorism operations during a visit to Turbat, Balochistan.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/zamfara-suspected-bandits-kill-guard-abduct-family-members-in-fresh-attack/) reported that suspected bandits killed a security guard and abducted family members during an attack in Zamfara State.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/troops-repel-terrorist-attacks-in-zamfara-kill-one-in-kaduna/) reported that troops repelled successive attacks on Wuya and Yarzabia communities in Anka Local Government Area of Zamfara State.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/soldiers-repel-zamfara-attacks-kill-scores-of-terrorists/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/troops-repel-terrorists-attacks-in-zamfara-neutralise-terrorist/) reported that troops of the Joint Task Force repelled successive terrorist attacks in Anka Local Government Area of Zamfara State and neutralized terrorists.

reports.text: [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-20/the-collapse-of-building-1321-the-tragedy-that-exposed-new-yorks-cracks.html) reported that the collapse of building 1321 in New York led families to seek justice for eight victims and residents to denounce negligent landlords.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/18/remains-ecuadorian-killed-new-york-city-building-collapse-arrive/) reported that the remains of one of two Ecuadorian construction workers killed in a New York City building collapse were returned to Quito.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/brooklyn-building-collapse-lawsuit) reported that Dengane Omari Jack filed a lawsuit against his landlord and multiple construction companies following a fatal building collapse in Brooklyn.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/isaac-cat-found-brooklyn-building-collapse-b3085862.html) reported that workers found a missing cat named Isaac alive four days after the deadly Brooklyn building collapse.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cm3wgeqnppljo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/brooklyn-building-collapse-cat-reunited-b3085420.html) reported that a pet cat named Isaac was reunited with its 13-year-old owner Zariah Coleman one week after the deadly Brooklyn building collapse.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOMjI1ZmhJQVcyOGtfNHFaWDBBTVJkWGF4NFZxaGprVmNieXFfOEFQSXV1RVZQRzF3c0xabzhsVTlEQ2dGU3k4blUxeW5jY0RVbU1RSDNWU3BSc1ViaFBoa3B4ajBkVnB4aXVqVGMyTjM5TmNoX29fMjg0Y3ZiNnlqWmdERS13aGZ6a3NDR0hDdGw4VFhXeW1pY2FvNXJpYkNFN3I3N2ZpdXI0QQ?oc=5) reported that Isaac, a cat missing since the Brooklyn building collapse, was reunited with its young owner.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/isaac-the-cat-feared-lost-in-deadly-brooklyn-building-collapse-that-killed-8-found-alive-after-childs-emotional-plea-to-be-reunited-with-family-101794793752482.html) reported that the cat belonged to 13-year-old Zariah Coleman, who lives next to the collapsed building in Flatbush.

reports.text: [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585157/ihc-schedules-appeals-in-190m-pounds-case-for-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by PTI founder Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi in the 190 million pounds case for November 25.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-bushra-bibi-190-million-al-qadir-trust-case-fixed-for-hearing-on-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi in the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case for hearing on Nov 25.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641245/un-rights-chief-calls-for-imran-khans-release-urges-political-de-escalation) reported that the UN rights chief called for Imran Khan's release and urged political de-escalation while Amnesty stated Imran faces solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583656/ihc-orders-medical-examination-improved-facilities-for-bushra-bibi/) reported that the Islamabad High Court took serious notice of complaints by Bushra Bibi regarding medical difficulties.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640983/ihc-orders-medical-care-for-bushra-bibi-in-jail-amid-eyesight-concerns), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045411/ps190m-corruption-case-ihc-directs-proper-medical-care-hygienic-living-conditions-for-bushra-bibi) reported that the Islamabad High Court directed prison authorities to ensure proper medical care and hygienic living conditions for Bushra Bibi.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045191/8-pakistan-bar-council-members-call-on-judiciary-to-take-note-of-imrans-plea-for-medical-treatment) reported that eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council called upon the judiciary to ensure implementation of the Supreme Court's order regarding Imran Khan's medical treatment.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUm9CVHJndDZlZ0dWQk9mbGJyNmNRcmpsVHRmM3IwYkxtUjl0UFlkUXhyVHNMTjhMSGNnQ0Z1NEd5UmlselRYUUxvQ2ctTV81SEhEMEtWcFU4eDh2NDZxNDZDZXJxOEJKbW5CZnZPME1vUlRKakhiNXNsZ05JV09Ial9ybEl6VDUxOHNHNFVld1JEaGZoWEdVcVY5NkxRQ19yQ1JCMXJ6MXpHcUVYdFdRU1VmT3MxNTZBbEtscW5zVnJVLVQz?oc=5) reported that Azma Bokhari called Imran Khan's medical concerns propaganda.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/imran-khan-sons-accuse-pakistan-govt-of-torturing-former-pm-health-risks-imprisonment-latest-updates-101794892907522.html) reported that Sulaiman Isa Khan and Kasim Khan stated that former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan's health has deteriorated after over three years in solitary confinement and accused the government of torturing him.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/jailed-pakistan-ex-pm-imran-khan-writes-to-judges-seeks-vital-medical-care?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-khan-asks-courts-for-treatment-says-22-hour-isolation-is-killing-him/articleshow/135893352.cms) reported that jailed former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan wrote to judges stating he may not return alive and seeking medical care for himself and his wife.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640599/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-urges-top-judges-to-enforce-court-orders-ensure-medical-treatment), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582222/imran-khan-writes-to-top-judges-detailing-severe-health-risks-and-isolation-in-prison/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044922/i-may-not-return-alive-in-open-letter-to-top-judges-imran-pleads-for-medical-treatment-for-him-and-bushra-bibi) reported that Imran Khan wrote an open letter to top judges detailing severe health risks and appealing for medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-seeks-medical-treatment-for-himself-and-bushra-bibi-in-open-letter-to-top-judges/) reported that Imran Khan sought medical treatment in an open letter to the chief justice of Pakistan.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582310/imran-khan-expected-to-meet-lawyers-on-tuesday/) reported that Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf submitted a list of six lawyers to jail authorities for an expected meeting with party founder Imran Khan.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044913/lawyers-submit-affidavits-detailing-nov-11-meeting-with-imran-bushra-at-adiala-jail) reported that lawyers for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi submitted affidavits detailing a jail meeting to the Islamabad High Court.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/imran-khan-asim-munir-deal-sisters-release-from-jail-hospital-visit-spark-buzz-in-pakistan/articleshow/135801979.cms) reported that the release of Imran Khan's sisters from jail and a hospital visit sparked buzz regarding a potential deal in Pakistan.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640124/fact-check-viral-video-of-noreen-and-uzma-is-old-not-of-release-from-kot-lakhpat-jail) reported that a viral video claiming to show Noreen and Uzma's release from Kot Lakhpat jail is old and originated from an August 10, 2026 TikTok clip.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQa2Q2R3V4NmxCVC01TnNYZDUzUzVqNEpOUEphazdhbUlyRHFsQkhlRHFST05tQ2ZhcWtmSGNfYW02SE91RVVwV0d4OHY0WG1PTGcwcXdUYUoxOWh6TUhMY0VfZzdVSmN0eTZMWXN5QXl5MWJoLW1BczlZZ2ZCLWU0MkNXbmFFNmV4VzNyZHZqRi0?oc=5) reported that Imran Khan's two sisters were released after weeks in detention.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580849/imran-khans-sisters-released-from-jail-following-backchannel-political-understandings/) reported that the release followed backchannel political understandings.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/pakistan-releases-two-sisters-of-ex-pm-imran-khan-from-jail?traffic_source=rss) reported that Aleema Khan remains detained nearly two months after their arrest.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639924/uzma-khan-noreen-niazi-released-after-50-days-in-detention) reported that Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released after 50 days in detention, while PTI founder's sister Aleema Khan remains incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat Jail.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044037/imrans-sisters-uzma-noreen-released-from-jail-after-extended-detention-orders-withdrawn-says-lawyer) reported that Dr Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released from Kot Lakhpat jail following the withdrawal of their extended detention orders.
