reports.text: [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90830) reported that Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced Poland will receive strong support from NATO allies to strengthen border security.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/swedish-gripen-pilot-unable-to-shoot-down-suspected-russian-missile-over-poland-due-to-poor-weather-commander-says/) reported that a Swedish Gripen pilot participating in a NATO air defense deployment was unable to shoot down a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nato-pledges-to-defend-poland-after-russian-missile-incursion/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend Poland after two Russian missiles hit its southeast during a meeting of the alliance's council in Brussels.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/russian-missiles-hit-poland-what-happened-and-could-nato-respond?traffic_source=rss) reported that Warsaw accused Moscow of intentional provocation after Russian missiles hit Poland, while the bar for triggering NATO's collective defense clause remains high.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063930/) reported that the pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorized to shoot down a Russian missile but unable to identify it.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90803) reported that a Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian Kh-101 cruise missile during Friday’s airspace violation over southern Poland, but held fire due to weather.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90785) reported that European Union, British, and NATO leaders condemned Russia's overnight violation of Polish airspace.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641478/russian-missiles-land-in-poland-amid-nato-drills), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375302/russian-missiles-land-poland-europe-holds-military-drills-nearby) reported that two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland during European military drills, prompting the Polish prime minister to call it an intentional provocation.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russia-fires-cruise-missile-into-poland-during-british-troop-drills/3IBFJX7GAZGOLJUZRDPA2ND3PY/) reported that Russia fired a cruise missile into Poland during British troop drills 100 kilometers from the exercise.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPb2dKNkEyLW5VNkNqNmI3U2lRMGcwUzZxUEUzb2FqTmVPYmFSZVhWYXM3Z0VfN3JfVi1FbkZydE5UWkRmNlhSZTFOa1pBLUpMaG5lRzZKbmJRYjdkcHZRYXlwWVlSQ3hoSUxwSzdtZDRld1FCSzVUUThhR1dicE5XbjNiSnc5VThLSGdpUkhrM2xueDRmR19DYg?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missile-incursion-into-poland-seems-intentional-tusk-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Polish prime minister stated a Russian missile's crash in Poland was likely an intentional provocation.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063854/) reported that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVGl6dU85bExfQlhuODY0Rkh6a3M2UVhRTlV1QmRsclI5ZHpRbWo5M3JIbUdydkRzOFNrZkZ6RDBIMHJVNGhqeklnRl9UVVAzRFpFUUk0OTVDVnU3RVh2VjdWZ2ktMUhMNmZZMUZkVDE5RFAtTjJ4UEZjUDlKZWd4YlhSaFBoYXdnYVI1ajFaRkdnTkpyMExkU0U4YjBHMTNSblZkRWt6aUVtTGJ5UWU1RVdrNA?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/european-troops-from-11-countries-hold-a-drill-in-poland-for-a-potential-postwar-ukraine-mission) reported that European troops from 11 countries began a two-week military exercise in Poland on November 9 to test the coalition's ability to deploy in Ukraine once the war ends.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2x9dklxnro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/warsaw-says-russian-missiles-hit-poland-intentional-provocation.1137425), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/poland-says-russian-missile-that-crashed-in-its-territory-was-a-provocation-20261121-p61g3a.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident in which objects hit Poland as an intentional provocation from Moscow.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744) reported that Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Russian drones and missiles had previously entered Poland by mistake.

[The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/washington-should-allow-ukraine-to-hit-russia-s-ballistic-missile-launchers) reported that a traveler to Ukraine visited soldiers and leaders in Kyiv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kharkiv, arguing that Washington should allow Ukraine to hit Russia's ballistic missile launchers.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-missile-attacks-hit-major-bridges-across-kyiv/) reported that Russian ballistic missiles struck three bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing six people.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-russia-crimea-strikes-bridge-kyiv-power-outage-poland/107411538), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/russia-pummels-ukraine-putin-vowed-painful-attack.1137390) reported that Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, killing eight people, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90708) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine destroyed one of three Russian ballistic missile launchers and downed 79 cruise missiles.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346957) reported that Russia proposed that European representatives travel to Moscow to clarify their position on peace talks concerning Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063766/) reported that the Ukrainian Prime Minister stated energy sites, businesses, and houses in nine oblasts and a wastewater facility in Kyiv were damaged, with the Kyiv death toll rising to six and 28 injured across Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186726-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-six-15-injured.html) reported that the death toll from the overnight attack on Kyiv rose to six, with 15 injured.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-targeted-by-missile-strikes-bridges-hit/live-79999822?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that at least three deaths were reported in Kyiv following missile strikes.
[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/3-killed-in-bridge-strikes-on-kyiv-mayor-says-a94324) reported that eight people were killed across Ukraine in the strikes.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/20/putin-invites-european-leaders-to-moscow-for-peace-talks-as-russia-pounds-kyiv/) reported that Vladimir Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for peace talks.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-crimean-bridge-destruction-significance-explained/107408488) reported that an expert stated Ukraine's destruction of the Crimean Bridge marked a huge blow to Vladimir Putin's credibility.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-live-deadly-russian-attacks-damage-two-bridges-in-kyiv-mayor-says), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063728/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186643-kyivs-podilskyi-and-darnytskyi-bridges-damaged-in-russian-ballistic-attack-mayor.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/russian-missile-and-drone-attack-on-kyiv-kills-three-and-damages-three-dnipro-bridges-mayor-says) reported that Russian attacks damaged bridges in Kyiv.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1120/1599948-ukraine-russia/) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack hit three bridges on Kyiv's Dnipro River and killed three people, according to the city's mayor.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-launches-mass-missile-attack-against-ukraine-after-putin-vows-revenge/) reported that Russia launched a mass missile attack against Ukraine after explosions rocked Kyiv following Putin's vows of retaliation.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/ukraine-war-briefing-russia-embassy-netherlands-destinus-missiles-kerch-crimea-bridge-strike) reported that the Russian embassy questioned whether the Netherlands joined the conflict after missiles made by a Dutch-based company were used in the Kerch bridge attack.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/20/world/putin-ukraine-crimea-bridge/) reported that Vladimir Putin stated there will be no sea or energy truce following the strike on the Crimea Bridge.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186437-putin-sets-condition-for-european-involvement-in-talks-on-war-in-ukraine.html) reported that Russian ruler Vladimir Putin stated the Kremlin is ready to include European representatives in negotiations on Ukraine after they come to Moscow.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/russia-invites-european-representatives-to-moscow-for-talks-putin-says) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin stated the United States has been pushing Russia to accept European participation in talks to end the war.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90624) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin stated Moscow has invited European representatives to discuss their position on Ukraine and European security.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063631/), [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221855) reported that Vladimir Putin stated during his visit to Shenzhen that Moscow invited European Union representatives to Moscow via diplomatic channels to clarify Europe's position on settling the war in Ukraine.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-forces-once-more-hit-russias-crimean-bridge-days-after-devastating-strike/) reported that Sergey Aksyonov confirmed the Crimean Bridge was hit again just after midnight.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-ukrainian-strike-in-4-days-halts-rail-traffic-on-russias-kerch-bridge-to-crimea/article71721511.ece) reported that a third Ukrainian strike in 4 days halted rail traffic on Russia's Kerch Bridge to Crimea hours before talks in Berlin.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/putin-vows-to-retaliate-as-ukraine-hits-prized-crimea-bridge-for-third-time-in-four-days-13613963) reported that Vladimir Putin vowed to retaliate after Ukraine hit the Crimea bridge for the third time in four days.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fuel-restrictions-reportedly-cause-gas-station-queues-in-occupied-sevastopol-after-crimean-bridge-strikes/) reported that panic buying prompted Russian-installed authorities to impose fuel purchase limits at two major gas station chains in Sevastopol following Crimean Bridge strikes.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221993), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian OSCE Permanent Representative Dmitry Polyansky described Ukrainian attacks on the Crimean Bridge as a PR stunt that will not impact the battlefield.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063662/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/satellite-images-show-a-collapsed-span-of-the-crimean-bridge-after-ukraine-s-third-strike-in-a-week) reported that open-source analysts and Ukrainian OSINT channels published satellite images showing impact points and a collapsed span of the Kerch Bridge following overnight strikes.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-se-despide-de-peru-con-misa-multitudinaria-pide-no-olvidar-a-los-pobres-en-una-misa-multitudinaria/) reported that the Vatican stated about 1.5 million people attended the mass.

reports.text: [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/geography-violence-distrust-hitting-dr-congo-ebola-fight-handicap-international-3013396) reported that Handicap International stated geography, violence, and distrust are three major challenges hampering efforts to quell the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/scientists-are-learning-more-about-the-rare-ebola-virus-in-congo-outbreak-3013248) reported that researchers gained insights into the rare Bundibugyo strain during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-ebola-outbreak-africa-chidlren-b3088643.html) reported that more than 1,200 children under five contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261118-strain-specific-ebola-vaccines-to-be-trialled-in-drc-who-announces) reported that two vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain are set to enter trials in the outbreak's epicentre next week.

[Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/18/congo-ebola-outbreak-budnibugyo-constitution-conflict-m23/) reported that six months in, the out of control Ebola outbreak shows no sign of slowing down.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/a-hunger-crisis-is-making-ebola-even-deadlier-101794971716235.html) reported that an Ebola outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that increases the chances of death for infected individuals.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168827) reported that the UN announced the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ebola-congo-six-months-radio-children-b3086362.html) reported that children in DR Congo are sharing information on the airwaves to fight myths as the Ebola outbreak passes the six-month mark.

[Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Barrick is furloughing some personnel at its Congo mine due to Ebola concerns.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/africa/congo-ebola-community-transmission.html) reported that health teams in eastern Congo struggle against fear and mistrust that drive fatal delays in seeking medical care during the Ebola outbreak.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170097.html) reported that Africa's top public health agency warned that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Africa-CDC-warns-of-immense-challenges-over-fragile-Ebola-gains-1S7pjUCAWQ0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the Africa CDC warned of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces in the DR Congo with over 11,100 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ebola-who-declares-major-success-as-3000-recover-in-drc-early-outbreak-hotspots-contained/) reported that the World Health Organisation announced that 3,000 people recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and that early outbreak hotspots were contained.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/congo-ebola-outbreak-biggest-in-history-crisis-armed-violence-hunger-healthcare-system-101794807183530.html) reported that over 11,000 people were infected and 5,500 died in Congo's Ebola outbreak, while hunger, armed violence and mistrust hamper control efforts.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/science-health/africa-ebola-outbreak-six-months/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak remains out of control due to problems including deadly attacks on health workers, unpaid staff, and a lack of resources.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/african-union-warns-drc-ebola-could-cause-a-large-continental-outbreak/) reported that Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the humanitarian crisis and insecurity could cause a large continental Ebola outbreak.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-africa-cdc-says-ebola-outbreak-still-out-of-control-six-months-since-it-was/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control six months after being declared.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-outbreak-kills-over-5400-in-dr-congo-as-conflict-hampers-response/) reported that over 5,400 people died in an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/health-news/925381-ebola-drc-cases-surpass-11000-insecurity-hampers-response.html) reported that according to the WHO, an armed attack in Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians including three health workers and looted three health facilities.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-international/20261115-ebola-l-absence-de-vaccin-explique-l-ampleur-de-cette-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-dit-jean-kaseya-africa-cdc) reported that Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya stated the lack of vaccines explains the scale of the epidemic.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648807-drc-ebola-attacks-health-workers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Africa CDC stated deadly attacks on medical teams and facilities are disrupting efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/attacks-on-health-workers-hamper-congo-ebola-fight-africa-cdc-warns-5669136) reported that the Africa CDC warned attacks on health workers are hampering the Ebola fight in Congo following an armed group attack in North Kivu that killed 66 people.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx98757ymm6zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training, and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies according to MSF.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261112-funds-for-dr-congo-ebola-fight-not-reaching-front-french-medical-charity-msf-says) reported that six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, the virus is still spreading out of control and large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line.

reports.text: [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/nigeria-on-path-to-prosperity-president-tinubu-assures-nigerians/) reported that President Bola Tinubu assured Nigerians that the country is on the path to prosperity.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/oyo-govt-accuses-apc-supporters-of-destroying-apm-campaign-posters-at-presidential-rally/) reported that the Oyo State Government accused All Progressives Congress supporters of destroying Allied Peoples Movement campaign posters during a presidential rally.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/makinde-campaign-alleges-flopped-apc-ibadan-rally-mocks-ruling-party/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/927034-makindes-campaign-organisation-criticises-tinubu-over-turnout-at-ibadan-rally.html) reported that the Makinde campaign organization described the APC rally in Ibadan as a failure with low turnout and alleged that President Tinubu failed to fulfill campaign promises.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/927036-tinubu-campaigns-in-ibadan-says-nigeria-on-path-to-prosperity.html) reported that during the Ibadan campaign, President Tinubu called for a moment of silence for victims of a boat accident in Bayelsa State and stated Nigeria is on the path to prosperity.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927010-tinubu-arrives-lagos-after-ibadan-rally.html) reported that President Tinubu arrived in Lagos to attend a special prayer session organised by his family members.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/927025-many-die-in-bayelsa-boat-mishap-tinubu-orders-federal-agencies-to-join-rescue-effort.html) reported that President Tinubu ordered federal agencies to join rescue efforts following a boat accident in Bayelsa that killed at least four people.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/at-ibadan-apc-rally-tinubu-announces-plan-to-reopen-leyland-auto-plant/) reported that at the Ibadan APC rally, President Tinubu announced a plan to reopen the Leyland Auto Plant.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/makindes-image-on-campaign-balloon-stirs-controversy-at-tinubus-ibadan-rally/) reported that the image of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde displayed on a balloon at the rally stirred controversy.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-arrives-lagos-after-ibadan-apc-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Tinubu arrived in Lagos after the APC presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, where he promised better power supply in Oyo State.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/tinubu-mourns-bayelsa-boat-victims/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-orders-low-key-ibadan-rally-after-bayelsa-boat-accident/) reported that President Bola Tinubu directed that the All Progressives Congress presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, be held without much fanfare following a boat accident in Bayelsa.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/video-shettima-arrives-in-ibadan-ahead-of-apc-presidential-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Vice President Kashim Shettima arrived in Ibadan ahead of the presidential campaign rally at Mapo Hall.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-tinubu-orders-low-key-oyo-apc-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu ordered federal rescue agencies into action following a boat tragedy in Southern Ijaw and directed that the Ibadan APC rally be low-key.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-court-dismisses-suits-against-adc-guber-ndc-assembly-candidates/) reported that a Federal High Court in Kano dismissed separate legal challenges against the governorship nomination of ADC and Assembly candidates.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-leaders-mobilise-support-for-tinubus-re-election-in-oyo/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-apc-leaders-rally-south-west-support-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that APC leaders and support group officials held an Ibadan town hall to mobilize South-West voters for President Tinubu's 2027 re-election bid.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/its-too-late-to-make-amends-baba-ahmed-speaks-on-tinubus-2027-chances/) reported that former presidential adviser Hakeem Baba-Ahmed expressed doubts about President Bola Tinubu's chances of recovering lost political support for 2027.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/allowing-tinubu-complete-eight-years-better-for-national-unity-apcs-kwankwaso/) reported that APC chief Dr Musa Illiyasu Kwankwaso stated that allowing President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to complete eight years is the best option for national unity.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063487/) reported that German media stated bilateral negotiations could take place on 19 November, while the Kremlin denied full-scale talks.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter went skiing at a resort being redeveloped near the China border.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118001300315) reported that Russia plans to unveil a monument in Kursk honoring North Korean troops' contribution.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063298/) reported that local authorities in Kursk installed a sculpture dedicated to North Korean military personnel participating in the war against Ukraine.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374794/trade-deal-rare-earths-and-quad-revival-day-1-trumps-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in Manila to start a three-day Asian swing.

[El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-17/un-sillon-de-orejas-en-la-pista-de-esqui-el-lider-norcoreano-kim-jong-un-se-deja-ver-con-su-hija-en-la-frontera-con-china.html) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un was seen with his daughter at a tourist complex under construction in Samjiyon near the Chinese border.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-trump-arrives-in-philippines-to-kick-off-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines for a Southeast Asian summit.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261117-trump-asia-nuclear-talks-china-russia), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/trump-to-hold-nuclear-talks-with-xi-and-putin-with-kim-jong-un-possibly-joining/) reported that US President Donald Trump headed to Asia for economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002300315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un inspected a tourism development site near China ahead of Trump's Asia trip.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915071), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044961/trump-says-he-might-meet-with-north-koreas-kim-jong-un-in-china), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/trump-hints-at-meeting-kim-jong-un-in-china-says-xi-could-play-role/articleshow/135896438.cms) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he may meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China and plans to discuss Iran with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374622/groundbreaking-no-yalta-20-what-expect-when-xi-putin-and-trump-meet) reported that the upcoming trilateral meeting between the Chinese, Russian, and US leaders in Shenzhen has drawn comparisons to the 1945 Yalta Conference.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/china-says-xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-world-peace/a-79959570?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/xi-trump-putin-trilateral-summit-to-discuss-world-peace-beijing) reported that China stated Presidents Xi, Trump, and Putin will discuss world peace at a trilateral summit in Shenzhen.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-shares-agenda-for-trilateral-meet-with-xi-jinping-vladimir-putin-china-us-russia-ukraine-iran-world-peace-101794841031257.html) reported that Donald Trump stated the November 19 meeting will cover denuclearisation and conflicts involving Iran and Ukraine.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/trump-says-he-could-meet-with-north-korean-leader-kim-jong-un-in-china), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/article/3374640/trump-floats-kim-meeting-china-says-hell-discuss-ukraine-xi-and-putin) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he could meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his trip to China.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261122-live-finland-says-war-spilling-over-after-baltic-sea-drone-strike-on-russian-cargo-ship) reported that Finland warned the war in Ukraine was spilling over after a drone set ablaze a Russian cargo ship on the eastern Baltic Sea.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063993/) reported that Telegram channels noted explosions and Russian air defence activity in Baltiysk.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222887) reported that Finnish border guard assets are en route to the drone-hit cargo ship.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/drones-hit-russian-cargo-ship-in-baltic-finland-tightens-security/articleshow/136065032.cms) reported that drones hit a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea and Finnish forces indicated Ukraine was likely behind the attack.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187239-airport-in-russias-kaliningrad-region-temporarily-closed-amid-drone-threat-social-media.html) reported that Khrabrovo Airport in Russia’s Kaliningrad region temporarily suspended arrivals and departures amid a drone threat.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPaUFLdlZmeWprX3A2YllLMmlQSXZrYTRIazVMOEExREZuTXFCYThyVUlnR3U0TDg3dGpUeHE5SHJyanJWQUZTRHdwUG5YYTFxVXMtUU5rY1pOVzZkRUxhQ29oUEVUS0NJTWFxcUJmLW9lRE52cGs3N2FLbXZzNmVFNFpXTmZNZnI4S1pWNDB5RWV0UFhUUGlCTVUwNjlWZDMxcXhxS0FvZUdNNWN4UU9jMEw4bWVaOVB0TlE?oc=5), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/russian-cargo-ship-catches-fire-after-ukrainian-strike-in-baltic-3013392), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1121/1600153-finland-russia-ukraine/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-vessel-ablaze-in-baltic-sea-after-ukrainian-strike/) reported that a Russian cargo ship caught fire in the Baltic Sea after a Ukrainian drone strike, forcing the crew to evacuate.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cargo-ship-bound-for-russias-kaliningrad-hit-by-drones-finland-tightens-security/article71729285.ece) reported that Finland's Defence Ministry said the military reintroduced temporary aviation and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland after a cargo ship bound for Kaliningrad was hit by drones.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/finland-says-russian-helicopter-possibly-breached-its-airspace-hours-after-drone-hit-on-cargo-ship-101795283257708.html) reported that Finland stated a Russian helicopter possibly breached its airspace hours after a drone hit a cargo ship.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/explosions-reported-near-russian-baltic-fleet-base-in-kaliningrad-oblast-amid-drone-alerts/) reported that Ukrainian monitoring channel WarTranslated cited Russian accounts claiming drones were attacking the Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/se-incendia-un-carguero-ruso-en-el-golfo-de-finlandia-fue-atacado-por-drones-ucranianos/) reported that a Russian cargo ship was attacked by Ukrainian drones in the Gulf of Finland, leading to suspicions of a violation of Finnish airspace.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/finlandia-sospecha-que-helicoptero-ruso-habria-violado-espacio-aereo_202611216b01b77c5cb1082f89b18a30.html) reported that Finland suspected a Russian helicopter violated its airspace in connection with the vessel attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063961/) reported that Finland reported a drone strike that damaged a Russian merchant vessel in the Gulf of Finland, prompting temporary airspace and maritime restrictions.

[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222907) reported that Russian forces struck an electrical substation in Vinnitsa supplying power to Ukrainian defense enterprises, as well as a dry cargo ship used by the Ukrainian military.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/21/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-la-finlande-soupconne-un-helicoptere-russe-d-etre-entre-dans-son-espace-aerien-quelques-heures-apres-une-attaque-de-drone-sur-un-cargo-russe-en-mer-baltique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Finland suspected a Russian helicopter entered its airspace following the drone attack on the Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261121-drone-attack-sets-russian-cargo-ship-ablaze-in-gulf-of-finland) reported that a Russian cargo ship caught fire after a drone strike in international waters in the Gulf of Finland.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/21/russia-says-cargo-vessel-struck-by-drones-in-gulf-of-finland-a94342) reported that Finland stated the damaged vessel was on fire and drifted from international waters into its territorial waters.

[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2219409) reported that Russia's Federal Security Service thwarted major Ukrainian drone attacks in southern Russia involving over 700 kilograms of Western-made explosives.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648928-ukraine-drone-caspian-sea/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russia's Federal Security Service prevented a major Ukrainian naval drone attack against vessels in the Caspian Sea.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/Ukraine-Braces-for-Pivotal-Week-of-Defense-Talks-Amid-Fresh-Russian-Attacks.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's government is preparing for two important defense gatherings amid ongoing airstrikes and peace process challenges.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062839/) reported that Estonian Division Deputy Commander Colonel Aron Kalmus outlined details of the Ukrainian attack on a Russian missile ship in the Baltic Sea.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/ukrainian-drone-strikes-russian-warship-in-the-gulf-of-finland-7pb9k3z) reported that a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland was struck by a Ukrainian drone, forcing it to return to Saint Petersburg.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/why-is-ukraine-attacking-russian-warships-in-the-baltic-sea-amid-talks?traffic_source=rss) reported that Finland stated Ukraine struck a Russian warship near its coast as Kyiv and Moscow held US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmn0d33zz34zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/finland-says-it-detected-strike-on-russian-warship-in-baltic-sea-a94245), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/finland-says-it-detects-strike-on-russian-warship-in-baltic-sea/) reported that Finland's military stated it detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/vance-trump-iran-nuclear-weapon) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stopped short of endorsing Donald Trump's claim that Iran was close to a nuclear weapon.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532390/Lula-says-Iran-has-no-intention-of-developing-nuclear-weapons), a state-media outlet, reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva challenged Washington's justification for war against Iran, calling US claims fabricated.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to back Donald Trump's Iran strikes despite the president's demand for public endorsement.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584922/vance-avoids-endorsing-trumps-iran-strike-decision/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered military strikes against Iran as President Donald Trump urged him.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/20/us-vice-president-jd-vance-declines-to-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered strikes on Iran and called for the US to exit the conflict.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/cd9e5cc2714e) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated the decision to attack Iran was Donald Trump's call and his role is to support the president.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-vice-president-vance-declines-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes) reported that JD Vance avoided directly endorsing US strikes on Iran.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/uss-george-washington-carrier-iran-b3087975.html) reported that the U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers supporting Iran war operations after the USS George Washington departed the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641168/us-carrier-uss-george-washington-leaves-middle-east-after-3-months-report) reported that the US carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after three months, while the USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS George HW Bush carrier strike groups remain in the region.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/donald-trump-calls-jd-vances-iran-ceasefire-memorandum-a-waste-of-time-after-midterm-losses-101795076049336.html) reported that Donald Trump criticized a June memorandum negotiated by Vice President JD Vance regarding an Iran ceasefire, saying he preferred a formal agreement.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/americki-nosac-aviona-uss-george-washington-nakon-tri-mjeseca-napustio-bliski-istok/261119009) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after a three-month deployment in the region.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPZnlZbjhYV1JEWk1EQ3dZVXZtWG14LW5RT3hwakkyeTZzMzJQcktfM19vZHFkZGc1blFHRFUzTkM0Nko1bVhQNWYwMms5UDVLb0p6NlFkZS1EX21WTjNmTXVQSTlsNDBLN0pvU3h4Y096N3VCMHEwbVZlQ2R2NHBoQ0FKY2xEZXpzakMyZU5hdkxsRk5jbzlUbnpvRHFSUUYxeVRhc0pvVjMtTEU?oc=5) reported that the US military returned to two aircraft carriers in the Middle East.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-may-have-just-two-aircraft-carriers-in-persian-gulf-as-uss-george-washington-heads-to-japan-101795033013797.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915382) reported that the USS George Washington aircraft carrier left the Middle East to return to the US 7th Fleet.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-angry-vance-iran-war-midterms-b3087494.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-915361) reported that President Trump has grown frustrated with Vice President Vance after Vance blamed the Iran war for Republican midterm losses.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640809/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-exceeds-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute) reported that an Israeli institute stated US air power stationed at land bases in the Middle East is below March levels despite the presence of more than 200 aerial refueling aircraft.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-deployment-uss-theodore-roosevelt-marks-third-carrier-in-middle-east-iran-war) reported that the Navy's USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group joined two other aircraft carriers enforcing a blockade of Iran.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-tops-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute-3725689) reported that an Israeli security institute stated the US naval presence in the Middle East exceeds the peak level of the war on Iran in early 2026.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640763/us-vice-president-vows-trump-will-not-let-iran-conflict-become-another-forever-war), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/jd-vance-says-us-will-not-fight-forever-war-with-iran-defends-donald-trumps-military-action/articleshow/135909834.cms), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045146/trump-is-not-going-to-let-iran-conflict-become-a-forever-war-asserts-vance) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will not allow the conflict with Iran to become a prolonged military commitment or forever war.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219269), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will get the country out of the conflict with great results.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-says-donald-trump-will-end-iran-war-before-2028-rules-out-forever-war-as-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-101794879757205.html) reported that JD Vance stated Trump will not let the Iran war become a forever war as a third US aircraft carrier reaches the Middle East.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374663/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-trump-weighs-iran-options) reported that US Central Command stated in a social media post that a third American aircraft carrier reached the Middle East.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iran-war-jd-vance-trump-aircraft-carrier-middle-east-b3085980.html) reported that Vice President JD Vance stated Iran will not be a 'forever war' as the USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike force arrived in the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640643/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-report), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-axios-reports-3725637) reported that US Vice President JD Vance is undecided about a 2028 presidential run.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uss-theodore-roosevelt-brings-us-carriers-in-middle-east-to-three-3725641), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-us-increases-carrier-presence-in-middle-east-to-3-as-uss-theodore-roosevelt-arrives-in-region-report/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the US Central Command area, increasing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNYmZiWEcxLU9Xck9JR2h3VDIwa1VETmRCam5zQm1BWmhNcGhZS0pBdi1BZGRZLXhZT3VmUG5wYld2N1gydV8teDVFc0UtNVljakJ5Q1JNRkRUb0dqRDRfX0p4QVBGdkZRaWd3Y1J6aFdZWlZhVGt5LWxzcG9mRHVPYnBXZFFrSXVqYXkxd081YzdlNTN1T05yVTgwZUIzSUhQQWc?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-american-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-iran-war/article71709128.ece) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East, bringing the total number of US aircraft carriers in the region to three.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-the-middle-east-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-the-iran-war) reported that the flotilla in the Arabian Sea includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers, and a littoral combat ship.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/uss-roosevelt-arrives-in-middle-east-is-the-us-iran-war-about-to-resume?traffic_source=rss) reported that the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt joined two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-iran-says-tankers-hit-mins) reported that a third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, arrived in the Middle East amid tensions with Iran.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/iran-escalates-threats-against-us-forces-and-gulf-states-as-third-american-carrier-arrives/) reported that Iran escalated threats against US forces and Gulf states as the carrier arrived.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/podcasts/trending-middle-east/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-death-sentences-over-jordan-attacks-and-lebanon-qatar-gas-talks/) reported that a third US aircraft carrier reached the Middle East alongside death sentences over Jordan attacks and Lebanon-Qatar gas talks.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-16/ty-article/reports-third-u-s-aircraft-carrier-deployed-to-middle-east/000001a1-e243-da30-a7fb-faff85dc0000) reported that the deployment of a third U.S. aircraft carrier would bring the American military presence in the Middle East to its highest level since April.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/16/iran-war-live-tehran-warns-it-may-strike-first-before-another-us-attack?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran warned it would not simply wait for an attack as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/still-in-state-of-war-says-iran-as-third-us-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-to-join-blockade-101794793624263.html) reported that three US aircraft carriers are part of a force of more than 20 US Navy ships enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports.
[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4411284) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt is preparing to join American forces deployed in the Middle East.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203212/%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%81%D9%84%D8%AA/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt returned to the Middle East to join the USS George HW Bush and USS George Washington already stationed in the region.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-bahrain-nationwide-threat-alert/) reported that Bahrain issued a nationwide threat alert amid Iran attack claims and a Saudi-led coalition intercepting missiles.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-embassy-in-bahrain-issues-security-alert-warns-americans-of-possible-houthi-attacks-101794779378382.html) reported that the US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert warning Americans of possible Houthi attacks and urging travelers to stay updated on airport and airline operations.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uss-theodore-roosevelt-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-iran-tensions-101794783044980.html) reported that a third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East amid heightened tensions with Iran following claims of strikes on US assets in Bahrain.

[Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/dunya/nyt-uss-theodore-roosevelt-ucak-gemisi-orta-dogu-daki-gorevine-basliyor/4126063), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/16/uss-theodore-roosevelt-middle-east-centcom/) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East to begin its mission.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218431) reported according to Axios correspondent Barak Ravid that the US military has three vessels of this type in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.

reports.text: [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-revuelve-apelar-voto-util-exige-respeto-vox_202611216b019868f6da642efef75848.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal criticized the People's Party over tactical voting and demanded respect for Vox.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced the government will extend the bank tax until 2027 and allocate the revenue to housing policies.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/sanchez-vuelve-al-ataque-para-dejar-atras-el-debate-mientras-feijoo-intenta-explotarlo-al-maximo.html) reported that Pedro Sánchez returned to the attack following the debate while Feijóo promised to deploy the Armed Forces against immigration.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/feijoo-gano-el-cara-a-cara-contra-sanchez-por-10-puntos-segun-el-sondeo-de-40db-para-el-pais-y-la-ser.html) reported that according to a 40dB poll for EL PAÍS and SER, 43% of respondents favored Feijóo as the winner of the head-to-head debate against Sánchez compared to 33.3% for the socialist candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that according to a 40dB poll for EL PAÍS and SER, Feijóo won the head-to-head debate against Sánchez with a 10-point lead.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/vuelve-contencion-euforia-cara-cara-sanchez-presidente-agotado-pero-importante-ganar-29n_202611206b004f2c50b7057c6d1241db.html) reported that Miguel Tellado stated Feijóo swept the debate and described Sánchez as an exhausted president.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/abascal-exige-a-feijoo-que-aclare-si-pactara-con-los-restos-del-psoe-despues-del-29-n.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-celebra-triunfo-feijoo-sanchez-lanza-advertencia-pacte-restos-psoe_202611206b004b665cb1082f89b0caeb.html) reported that Vox leader Abascal celebrated PP candidate Feijóo's performance against Pedro Sánchez in their debate and urged the Popular Party to rule out any agreements with the Socialists after the November 29 elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/cataluna/urtasun-cree-que-derrota-sanchez-feijoo-evidencia-que-frente-amplio-imprescindible_202611206b001ad35cb1082f89b09d5a.html) reported that Urtasun stated Pedro Sánchez's defeat against Alberto Núñez Feijóo shows the Frente Amplio is essential and that the PSOE cannot defeat the right alone.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/quien-ha-ganado-el-duelo-los-analistas-de-el-pais-dan-por-vencedor-a-feijoo-sobre-sanchez.html) reported that seven EL PAÍS experts gave Feijóo the victory over Sánchez in their head-to-head debate before the November 29 elections.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/el-cara-a-cara-entre-sanchez-y-feijoo-resumido-en-un-video-de-cinco-minutos.html) reported that the debate between Sánchez and Feijóo included Sánchez apologizing for train accidents and Feijóo making corruption accusations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-crisis-de-la-vivienda-en-espana-marca-el-debate-electoral-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-feijoo-33217772) reported that Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo debated the housing crisis in Spain, discussing evictions and rising prices.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/mi-gobierno-no-ha-sido-perfecto-pedro-sanchez-admite-errores-en-debate-con-alberto-nunez-feijoo-a-dias-de-las-elecciones-en-espana-3602569) reported that Pedro Sánchez admitted errors during the debate and stated his government has not been perfect.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/cataluna/rufian-mete-dedo-llaga-cara-cara-tengo-que-ser-sincero-feijoo-comio-sanchez_202611206b001936ff6fec292196a4c7.html) reported commentary on the election debate between Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo, with commentators stating Feijóo won and criticizing Sánchez's improvisation skills.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-29n-directo-reacciones-cara-cara-nunez-feijoo-pedro-sanchez-ultima-hora-campana-electoral_202611206afffa9450b7057c6d11f519.html) reported that opposition leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo imposed himself clearly over Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez in their debate.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/duro-ataque-de-feijoo-sanchez-por-alto-costo-de-vida-y-corrupcion) reported that Alberto Núñez Feijóo launched a harsh attack against Pedro Sánchez over the high cost of living and corruption.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-pm-s%C3%A1nchez-admits-mistakes-in-key-debate-ahead-of-spain-election) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez acknowledged shortcomings in his government during a debate against conservative rival Alberto Núñez Feijóo.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/1977d31189bf) reported that Pedro Sanchez and Alberto Nunez Feijoo clashed over the economy, housing, immigration, and corruption.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/carlos-herrera-destaca-reaccion-sanchez-feijoo-debate-equipo-sale-entusiasmado-sanchez-queda-solo-b50m_202611206afff65aff6fec29219688a3.html) reported journalist Carlos Herrera's comments on the reactions of the PP team and Sánchez following the debate.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-sanchez-gobierno-hecho-todo-tipo-guarradas-bochorno_202611206aff85f5f6b335433bb61a72.html) reported that during a political debate, PP leader Núñez Feijóo accused Pedro Sánchez's government of corruption, while Sánchez defended his administration as one of the cleanest in the history of democracy.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/somos-economia-que-mas-crece-europa-sanchez-baje-cohete-acabemos-infierno-fiscal-deje-usar-mayores-beneficio-feijoo_202611196aff707918c34d33accf3e63.html) reported that Feijóo announced he will create a State Secretariat for the Elderly if he governs, while Sánchez boasted about protecting pensions, the minimum wage, and civil servant salary increases.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/feijoo-pide-sanchez-que-deje-meter-miedo-pensionistas-pero-avisa-que-sistema-esta-punto-estallar_202611196aff76de103a0e0a475074f0.html) reported that Prime Minister Sánchez proposed to the PP leader to enshrine pensions in the Constitution to revalue them with the CPI, while Feijóo asked Sánchez to stop scaring pensioners but warned the system is near a breaking point.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/debate-electoral-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-nunez-feijoo-en-directo.html) reported that Feijóo arrived first at the studio for the face-to-face debate with Sánchez.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/que-significa-corbata-verde-feijoo-cara-cara-sanchez_202611196aff66d8a6f8072789ef1485.html) reported that Feijóo wore a blue suit, light blue shirt, and green tie for the debate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/90-minutos-cara-a-cara-sanchez-busca-remontar-los-dos-puntos-que-le-separan-del-pp-y-feijoo-repetir-el-exito-de-2023.html) reported that Spanish Socialist candidate Sánchez seeks to bridge a two-point gap against the PP ahead of their face-to-face debate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-18/video-analisis-en-directo-y-verificacion-a-tiempo-real-asi-podras-ver-el-cara-a-cara-entre-sanchez-y-feijoo-en-el-pais.html) reported that El País deployed an analysis team to cover the debate between Sánchez and Feijóo.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-plantea-cara-cara-como-mocion-censura-sanchez_202611196afe5fd018c34d33acce813f.html) reported that candidate Feijóo frames the debate as a motion of censure against Sánchez.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/nunez-feijoo-arranca-debate-ataque-espana-necesita-presidente-decente-sanchez_202611196aff66f918c34d33accf3877.html) reported that PP leader Núñez Feijóo launched attacks during the debate, accusing Sánchez, while recalling corruption cases, railway tragedies, and the Ceuta migration crisis.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/elecciones-espana-durisimos-cruces-corrupcion-economia-debate-pedro-sanchez-nunez-feijoo_0_jDDzYnkL3g.html) reported that candidates Pedro Sánchez and Núñez Feijóo clashed on corruption and the economy in a debate with polls placing the Partido Popular two points above the PSOE.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/madrid/2026-11-17/ayuso-critica-el-apoyo-de-lula-a-pedro-sanchez-en-la-campana-cada-vez-hay-mas-fuerzas-externas.html) reported that Madrid regional president Isabel Díaz Ayuso criticized Brazilian President Lula da Silva's support for Pedro Sánchez in the campaign.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/lula-da-silva-y-pedro-sanchez-se-reunen-de-cara-a-las-elecciones-de-espana-es-la-persona-indicada-para-seguir-defendiendo-la-democracia-en-europa-3601686) reported that Lula da Silva and Pedro Sánchez met ahead of Spain's general elections on November 29.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/lula-sanchez-eres-persona-indicada-defender-democracia-europa_202611166afb617e9a31a65adcde0e1d.html) reported that Brazilian President Lula da Silva told Pedro Sanchez that he is the right person to defend democracy in Europe and warned against the rise of the extreme right ahead of November 29.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/lula-viaja-a-madrid-para-respaldar-a-sanchez-y-reforzar-el-frente-progresista-ante-el-avance-de-la-nid16112026/) reported that the Brazilian president traveled to Madrid to support Sanchez in the final stretch of the election campaign ahead of November 29.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/will-spains-snap-election-in-november-bring-a-far-right-party-into-government) reported that Spaniards head to the polls on November 29 in the country's sixth general election in 11 years.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/lula-confirmo-manana-reunira-pedro-sanchez-madrid-cuenta-regresiva-elecciones-espana_0_Ca2SGEFcq6.html) reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva confirmed he will meet Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez in Madrid.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/spain-general-election-2026/), a state-media outlet, reported that Spain's general election campaign has begun with a 16-day period for parties competing for 350 Congress seats ahead of November 29.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/election/spain-housing-package-wins-backing-as-standoff-sparks-snap-election-3725542) reported that Spain secured parliamentary backing for a sweeping housing package after earlier measures triggered a snap election.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/lula-meet-sanchez-ahead-spain-election/), a state-media outlet, reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will meet Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez in Madrid on November 16.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/lula-to-visit-madrid-on-monday-to-meet-sanchez-two-weeks-before-spain-s-election?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will visit Madrid to meet Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/as-election-nears-spains-sanchez-struggles-to-rally-disillusioned-left/article71696797.ece) reported that Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is struggling to rally the disillusioned left as an election nears.

reports.text: [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926947-enugu-apc-suspends-campaigns-over-finance-directors-death.html) reported that the Enugu State APC suspended campaigns following the death of its finance director Festus Oshaba-Onuh.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/three-killed-13-injured-as-military-residents-clash-in-gombe/) reported that three people were killed and 13 others injured following a clash between the military and residents in Gombe.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/edu-assures-kebbi-women-of-better-days-mobilises-support-for-tinubu/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council Women Mobilisation Directorate, led by Dr Betta Edu, assured Kebbi women of better days and mobilised support for Tinubu.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926754-apc-campaign-finance-director-dies-in-road-crash.html) reported that Festus Onuh, chairman of Ferotex Construction Company Ltd and an APC campaign finance director, died in a road accident while travelling along Port Harcourt.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/several-injured-vehicles-damaged-as-suspected-thugs-attack-apc-campaign-convoy-in-gombe/) reported that five campaign buses conveying All Progressives Congress supporters were vandalised and several members sustained injuries after suspected thugs attacked an APC campaign convoy in Gombe.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-flown-to-abuja-after-accident/) reported that Gombe State APC Chairman Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the campaign director-general were flown to Abuja after an accident in which two persons died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-radda-warns-katsina-voters-against-irresponsible-politicians/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Katsina Governor Dikko Radda urged Kankia voters to back the APC, Tinubu, and party candidates in 2027.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/pdp-delegation-visits-injured-apc-leaders-at-gombe-hospital/) reported that a Gombe State Peoples Democratic Party delegation visited injured APC leaders at a Gombe hospital.

[The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/radda-warns-against-419-politicians-as-supporters-rally-for-apc/) reported that Katsina State Governor Malam Dikko Umaru Radda urged voters to reject 419 politicians in the 2027 general elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-establishment-of-inland-dry-port-in-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the establishment of an inland dry port in Kebbi State following a request by Governor Nasir Idris.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/tinubu-courts-kebbi-support-for-2nd-term-approves-inland-dry-port/) reported that President Bola Tinubu wooed Kebbi voters with development pledges, including approval for an inland dry port.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/1-killed-6-injured-in-road-crash-involving-gombe-apc-leaders/) reported that one person was killed and six others injured in a road accident involving Gombe State APC leaders.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/925953-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-in-borno.html), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741914-just-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-borno-details-emerge/) reported that suspected terrorists launched mortar bombs and IED attacks targeting the campaign team of Mohammed Mungono in Borno State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kebbi-apc-rally-tinubu-approves-dry-inland-port-for-kebbi-seeks-support-for-apc-in-2027/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-approves-kebbi-inland-dry-port-promises-completion-of-landmark-projects-improved-security/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/at-apc-presidential-rally-in-birnin-kebbi-tinubu-approves-inland-dry-port-for-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port in Kebbi State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/two-die-gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-injured-in-crash/) reported that Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the director-general of the party's 2027 governorship campaign were injured in a vehicle crash while two people died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-apc-supporters-throng-kebbi-stadium-for-tinubus-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu's presidential rally in Kebbi State attracted a massive crowd of APC supporters and party loyalists.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/kebbi-state-ready-to-receive-tinubu-for-presidential-campaign-launch-info-commissioner/) reported that the Kebbi State Government, the All Progressives Congress, and state residents declared readiness to receive President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for the presidential campaign launch.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stay-away-from-tomorrows-apc-campaign-rally-itsekiri-youths-warn-oborevwori/) reported that Itsekiri youths warned political leaders and state governor Sheriff Oborevwori to stay away from the upcoming APC campaign rally.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/aibom-gov-seeks-80000-lg-votes-for-tinubu-apc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno tasked voters in Mkpat Enin local government area to deliver 80,000 votes for President Tinubu and APC candidates in the 2027 polls.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-flags-off-2027-campaign-in-abia-kalu-targets-75-for-tinubu/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/abia-apc-kicks-off-presidential-campaign-promises-massive-votes-for-tinubu/) reported that the Abia State chapter of the All Progressives Congress formally kicked off its 2027 presidential campaign rally with assurances to secure massive votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-yoruba-community-endorses-tinubu-yusuf-for-2027-re-election/) reported that the Yoruba Community in Kano State endorsed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for re-election in 2027 and supported Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/gov-umo-endorses-wikes-coalition-says-hes-for-re-election-of-tinubu/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-umo-eno-backs-wikes-rainbow-coalition-for-tinubu/) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno declared support for the Rainbow Coalition led by Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike to support President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yilwatda-charges-north-central-apc-leaders-to-unite-for-tinubu/) reported that All Progressives Congress National Chairman Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda charged North-Central leaders, governors, and candidates to unite for Tinubu.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-jonathan-sanwo-olu-others-honoured-at-herbert-macaulay-colloquium/) reported that President Bola Tinubu, former President Goodluck Jonathan, and Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu were honoured at the Herbert Macaulay colloquium.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/at-apc-presidential-campaign-rally-in-jos-tinubu-orders-decisive-security-action-against-plateau-attackers/) reported that during the APC presidential campaign rally in Jos, President Bola Tinubu ordered decisive security action against attackers in Plateau and pledged to rebuild displaced communities.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-delta-apc-begins-grassroots-mobilisation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Delta State began grassroots mobilisation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/925054-zamfara-stands-still-as-gov-lawal-hosts-first-lady-remi-tinubu-for-mega-rally.html) reported that Zamfara State Governor Dauda Lawal hosted First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for a mega rally.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tight-security-as-tinubu-visits-jos-for-apc-presidential-rally/) reported that security has been beefed up in Jos ahead of the expected arrival of President Bola Tinubu for the All Progressives Congress presidential rally.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-we-need-unity-to-actualise-apc-victory-remi-tinubu-tells-party-chieftains/) reported that Nigerian First Lady Oluremi Tinubu urged party chieftains and women to use their votes to secure APC victory.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/lagos-east-mega-rally-sanwo-olu-others-seek-voters-support-for-tinubu-hamzat/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tompolo-zamfara-gov-rally-support-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that leaders including Babajide Sanwo-Olu, Tompolo, and Dauda Lawal urged voters to support President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

reports.text: [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-backs-code-for-independent-tabulation-of-2027-election-results/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission endorsed a voluntary Code of Conduct for independent tabulation and publication of election results.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926632-atiku-asks-inec-to-open-ai-system-for-independent-audit-ahead-of-2027-elections.html) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked INEC to open its AI system for an independent audit ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-must-open-ai-system-to-independent-audit-atiku/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar demanded an independent audit of INEC's artificial intelligence system.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/2027-independent-results-tabulation-cant-replace-statutory-collation-inec-declares/) reported that INEC declared independent results tabulation cannot replace statutory collation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-demands-scrutiny-of-inecs-ai-system-for-processing-election-results/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-demands-independent-audit-of-inecs-ai-system-ahead-of-2027-elections/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742321-2027-elections-atiku-challenges-inec-reveal-ai-technology-source-code/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded that INEC submit its proposed artificial intelligence system for processing election results to independent scrutiny.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/n11-2tr-opaque-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget-ndc/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of prioritising opaque spending on a pipeline security bill.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/ndc-raises-the-alarm-over-voter-register-demands-nationwide-audit-by-inec/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council raised concerns over the integrity of the Independent National Electoral Commission and demanded a nationwide audit.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndc-alleges-voter-register-inflation-demands-probe-of-n11-2trn-nnpcl-funds/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress raised concerns over the credibility of the 2027 general elections and the handling of public funds.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925913-2027-inec-proposes-code-to-regulate-independent-result-tabulation.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170671.html) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission proposed a code of conduct to regulate independent election result tabulation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-makinde-campaign-faults-tinubu-over-federal-recruitment-freeze/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/makinde-campaign-slams-tinubu-over-recruitment-embargo/) reported that Seyi Makinde's Allied Peoples Movement Presidential Campaign Organisation criticised President Bola Tinubu over a federal recruitment freeze.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925987-makinde-campaign-group-criticises-tinubu-over-federal-governments-recruitment-freeze.html) reported that Mr Makinde's campaign organisation stated that the employment restriction would worsen Nigeria's high unemployment rate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-alleges-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/ndc-tinubus-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-twice-defence-budget/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of presiding over an opaque N11.2 trillion pipeline security bill and demanded a forensic audit.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924782-makindes-campaign-group-demands-probe-of-tinubus-n11-2trn-crude-oil-backed-loans.html) reported that Makinde's campaign group demanded that the federal government disclose lenders, amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees, and repayment terms for Tinubu's N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/account-for-n11-2-trillion-crude-oil-advance-sale-mdpco-challenges-tinubu/) reported that the Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation challenged President Bola Tinubu's administration to account for the N11.2 trillion crude oil advance sale.
