narratives.label: Brazil fiscal adjustment bill approval

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/22/moretti-e-durigan-ganham-confianca-de-lula-com-pacote-fiscal-entenda-por-que-isso-nao-garante-que-continuarao-no-governo.ghtml) reported that Dario Durigan and another official gained Lula's confidence with the fiscal package.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/21/lula-critica-ala-da-esquerda-que-se-opos-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-faria-lima-nao-vai-ensina-lo-a-governar.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva criticized leftist factions opposing his government's fiscal adjustment package.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/em-busca-de-reeleicao-alcolumbre-e-motta-acenam-ao-planalto-por-ajuste-fiscal-e-a-oposicao-com-beneficio-a-bolsonaro.ghtml) reported that House President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre intensified gestures toward the Planalto and the opposition regarding fiscal adjustment.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/proposta-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-planalto-vira-estopim-e-psol-racha-sobre-relacao-com-governo-lula.ghtml) reported that the PSOL entered an internal dispute over how to react to the government's fiscal adjustment package ahead of the Chamber vote.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/os-dois-votos-do-pl-que-rogerio-marinho-ja-considera-perdidos-na-disputa-pela-presidencia-do-senado.ghtml) reported that Rogério Marinho already discounted two votes from his own party in the dispute for the presidency of the Senate.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/relator-na-camara-divulga-parecer-de-pacote-fiscal-e-nao-faz-alteracoes-no-texto-para-acelerar-aprovacao.ghtml) reported that Mauro Benevides Filho, the rapporteur of the fiscal adjustment project drafted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, released his opinion without making changes to the text in order to accelerate approval in the Chamber.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-senado-suaviza-corte-de-repasses-a-estados-e-texto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package with a gesture to states, softening cuts to transfers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/votacao-do-governo-em-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-expoe-disputa-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-pelo-comando-do-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate vote on the government's fiscal adjustment package exposed a dispute between Davi Alcolumbre and Rogério Marinho for control of the Senate.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-passa-no-senado-entenda-os-proximos-passos-antes-de-medida-entrar-em-vigor.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package, though the measures are not yet in force.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-aprova-projeto-que-estabelece-novas-regras-para-uso-de-postes-por-empresas-de-internet.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill establishing new rules for the sharing of electricity poles by internet companies.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323780-senado-rejeita-mudancas-no-texto-e-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/alcolumbre-ve-influencia-de-disputa-eleitoral-em-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-dialogo-prevaleceu-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate rejected changes to the text and approved the government's fiscal adjustment project, sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/11/18/pena-maior-para-quem-matar-dirigindo-sob-efeito-de-alcool-e-aprovada-no-senado-e-projeto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for homicide and serious bodily injury caused by drunk drivers, sending the project to the Chamber.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/chefe-da-articulacao-politica-diz-que-governo-acertou-com-motta-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-na-camara-ate-terca-feira.ghtml) reported that Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated he agreed with Chamber President Hugo Motta to vote on the fiscal package in the Chamber by Tuesday.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-teto-para-compensacao-previdenciaria-a-estados-e-municipios-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate maintained the provision in the fiscal adjustment project limiting social security compensation transfers to states and municipalities to 3 billion reals per year between 2027 and 2030.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-restricao-ao-uso-de-creditos-tributarios-por-empresas-em-projeto-do-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate kept the section of the fiscal adjustment package authorizing the government to restrict companies from using tax credits for settlements.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mudancas-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate resumed discussion of the government's fiscal adjustment project after it was postponed due to a lack of agreement.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/julgamento-dos-beneficios-fiscais-da-atem-volta-a-estaca-zero-no-stf-e-pressao-cresce.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Minister Luiz Fux requested a review of the direct unconstitutionality action regarding tax benefits for the Manaus Free Trade Zone benefiting Atem.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/ala-bolsonarista-do-pl-ve-gesto-eleitoreiro-de-motta-e-alcolumbre-ao-pedir-a-moraes-julgamento-sobre-lei-que-beneficia-bolsonaro.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323484-motta-e-alcolumbre-pedem-a-moraes-julgamento-da-lei-da-dosimetria.html) reported that Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre asked Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to judge the sentencing reduction law for January 8 prisoners this year.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/governo-conta-votos-e-aposta-em-articulacao-de-alcolumbre-para-concluir-votacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva government is working to secure votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote in the Senate with the backing of Davi Alcolumbre.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/sem-acordo-entenda-o-que-travou-a-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate postponed concluding the vote on President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal measures package due to a lack of agreement with the opposition and guaranteed votes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/alcolumbre-diz-que-tem-votos-para-concluir-votacao-do-ajuste-fiscal-nesta-quarta-feira.ghtml) reported that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated there are enough votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/janones-rebate-criticas-apos-defender-governo-se-alguns-se-acham-mais-inteligentes-que-lula-parabens-nao-e-meu-caso.ghtml) reported that federal deputy André Janones rebuffed criticism after defending the government.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-deve-divulgar-video-defendendo-pacote-fiscal-apos-criticas-da-esquerda.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is set to release a video defending the fiscal adjustment package proposed by his government.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323396-congresso-pede-que-stf-julgue-lei-que-beneficia-condenados-pelo-8-1.html) reported that the presidents of the Chamber and the Senate met with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to request judgment on a law benefiting those convicted for the January 8 events.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/ministros-do-stf-avaliam-que-moraes-deve-liberar-julgamento-de-acao-que-pode-reduzir-pena-de-bolsonaro-apos-reuniao-com-motta-e-alcolumbre.ghtml) reported that expectations in the Supreme Federal Court are that Minister Alexandre de Moraes will soon release for trial actions questioning the constitutionality regarding Bolsonaro's sentence following a meeting with Motta and Alcolumbre.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-se-reune-com-ministro-do-trabalho-para-acertar-detalhes-de-decreto-sobre-fim-da-escala-6x1.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Minister of Labor and Employment Luiz Marinho at the Alvorada Palace in Brasília to settle details on a decree regarding the end of the 6x1 work scale.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323312-dino-decide-que-escala-5x2-sera-julgada-de-forma-definitiva-pelo-stf.html) reported that Justice Dino decided that the 5x2 scale will be judged definitively by the Supreme Federal Court after the court's virtual plenary initiated evaluation to endorse the minister's injunction.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/dino-estabelece-prazos-em-acao-sobre-escala-6x1-e-julgamento-no-plenario-do-stfpode-ocorrer-em-duas-semanas.ghtml) reported that Justice Flávio Dino opened new deadlines for Congress, the Prosecutor General's Office, and the Attorney General's Office in a lawsuit regarding the 6x1 work scale.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lider-do-governo-no-congresso-apresenta-projeto-para-taxar-big-techs-meio-a-ajuste-fiscal.ghtml) reported that government leader in Congress Senator Randolfe Rodrigues presented a bill to tax big tech companies.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/atiku-cant-claim-25m-northern-votes-when-his-son-supports-tinubu-george/) reported that George questioned whether the African Democratic Congress could convince Nigerians it had a plan.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-anambra-apc-inaugurates-350-member-campaign-council/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra APC inaugurated a 350-member campaign council led by Azuka Okwusa to mobilise support for Tinubu and party candidates ahead of the 2027 elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-inaugurates-anambra-campaign-council-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that the Anambra State chapter of the All Progressives Congress inaugurated its campaign council for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's reelection bid.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741002-apc-support-group-targets-15-million-votes-tinubu-kano-2027/) reported that an APC support group inaugurated coordinators across Kano's 44 local government areas targeting votes for Tinubu and other candidates.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndc-campaign-council-fires-back-says-apc-spreading-agbero-politics-nationwide/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused the APC of exporting 'agbero' politics nationwide.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/december-15-for-hearing-in-kano-governors-divorce-suit/) reported that an Upper Area Court in Abuja fixed December 15 for a hearing in the divorce suit filed against Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf by his estranged wife.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741994-breaking-court-takes-action-gov-yusuf-kwankwasos-daughter/) reported that the Upper Area Court in Abuja issued a statement regarding the divorce saga of Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and his wife Zainab.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741945-atiku-campaign-aide-reacts-kano-governor-divorce-controversy/) reported that an Atiku campaign aide criticised Kano Governor Abba Yusuf over his public divorce announcement and dismissed claims linking Kwankwaso to the marriage crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/court-adjourns-kano-governors-divorce-case-to-december-15/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Upper Area Court in Gudu District, Abuja, adjourned the divorce case involving Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his second wife till December 15.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6zxvd27e9lvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-gov-confirms-divorce-from-kwankwasos-niece-hints-at-remarrying/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf confirmed his divorce from Zainab Musa Kwankwaso and thanked citizens for advice regarding marriage.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/governor-yusuf-divorces-wife-kwankwasos-daughter-declares-he-is-open-to-marriage/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925753-kano-governor-confirms-dissolution-of-20-year-marriage-with-kwankwasos-niece.html) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf confirmed the dissolution of his 20-year marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndc-condemns-attack-on-kwankwaso-demands-arrest-of-perpetrators/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/ndc-decries-attack-on-kwankwaso-demands-arrest-of-perpetrators-sponsors/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress condemned the attack on its vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso and demanded the arrest of perpetrators and sponsors.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kano-commissioner-dismisses-attack-on-kwankwasos-convoy/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Kano State Commissioner for Information dismissed reports of the attack as fictitious.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/democracy-is-not-warfare-peter-obi-condemns-kwankwaso-convoy-attack/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwankwasos-convoy-attack-peter-obi-calls-for-probe-arrest-of-perpetrators/) reported that Peter Obi condemned the attack and called for an investigation and arrest of the perpetrators.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741412-kano-state-governors-wife-divorce-saga-sparks-arrests/) reported that arrests followed the divorce saga involving Kano Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf's wife, Zainab.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kano-govs-wife-divorce-saga-sparks-arrests/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the divorce crisis between Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his wife Zainab led to the arrest of three security personnel.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kwankwasos-daughter-seeks-divorce-from-kano-gov-offers-to-refund-dowry/) reported that Zainab Kwankwaso sought a divorce from the Kano governor, citing a lack of emotional connection and offering to refund the dowry.

reports.text: [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089372/snazno-nevrijeme-poharalo-bih-voda-preplavila-saobracajnice-vjetar-rusio-stabla-odroni-ugrozili-vozace-vise-gradova-ostalo-bez-struje), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-izazvalo-probleme-sirom-BiH-Vjetar-odnio-krov-drvo-palo-na-vozilo/993372) reported that a severe storm with strong winds and heavy rain caused floods, downed trees, power outages, and damage across parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/olujni-vjetar-poharao-dijelove-bi-h-mjesta-ostala-bez-struje-stizu-prvi-detalji/) reported that a stormy wind battered parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina, leaving places without power.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/banjaluka/Jako-nevrijeme-u-Banjaluci-Kisa-pljusti-olujni-vjetar-polomio-drvo/993305) reported that a severe storm accompanied by strong wind gusts and heavy rain struck Banja Luka.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vremenska-prognoza/rhmz-se-oglasio-novim-upozorenjem-uskoro-stize-orkanski-vetar-jacine-110kmh/tm86eyx) reported that Serbia issued an urgent warning for severe weather expected during evening hours, with the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute forecasting hurricane-force winds up to 110 kilometers per hour.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089219/olujni-vjetar-zahvata-bih-u-narednim-satima-ocekuju-se-olujni-i-orkanski-udari-vjetra-do-90-kilometara-na-sat) reported that stormy and hurricane-force wind gusts reaching up to 90 kilometers per hour are affecting Bosnia and Herzegovina, with heavier rain expected in Herzegovina and the south.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Stizu-pljuskovi-i-olujni-vjetar-RHMZ-izdao-upozorenje-za-Republiku-Srpsku/993168) reported that the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute issued a warning for the Republika Srpska regarding strong to stormy winds with powerful gusts in certain areas.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088771/meteorolozi-upozorili-veceras-stizu-olujni-udari-juga-tokom-noci-ocekuje-se-kisa-sirom-bih) reported that meteorologists warned that stormy southern wind gusts will arrive, with rain expected across Bosnia and Herzegovina during the night.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/u-narednim-satima-u-bi-h-stizu-olujni-udari-vjetra-ocekuje-se-i-kisa/) reported that BH Meteo issued warnings for upcoming stormy wind gusts and rain in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/nauka-tehnologija/okolina/Toplo-ali-varljivo-Danas-u-BiH-udari-vjetra-do-70-kmh-uvece-stize-kisa/992743) reported that temperatures in Bosnia and Herzegovina would reach 19 degrees with southerly wind gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour, followed by evening rain.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/ekonomija/trziste/Ispunjeni-uslovi-da-gorivo-u-BiH-dodatno-pojeftini-Kada-stizu-nove-cijene/992635) reported that experts stated conditions are met for additional price drops for fuel in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088468/olujni-udari-juga-stizu-u-bih-poznato-kada-ce-vjetar-biti-najjaci) reported that stormy southerly wind gusts are arriving in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the strongest winds expected on Tuesday and Thursday.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/bi-h-ceka-velika-promjena-vremena-nakon-obilne-kise-i-olujnog-juga-stize-snijeg/) reported that Bosnia and Herzegovina is expecting a weather change from warm temperatures and stormy southerly winds to snow.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-stize-u-BiH-Olujni-vjetar-do-90-kmh-obilna-kisa-i-snijeg/992176) reported that meteoalarm issued warnings for winds up to 90 km/h, heavy rain in Herzegovina, and snow in higher elevations.

reports.text: [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3375298/trump-replaces-us-cyber-chief-after-outages-hit-flights-banks-and-nsa) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump appointed the Pentagon's chief information officer as the new cyber chief following major outages.

[Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/11/20/pentagon-cio-replaces-white-house-national-cyber-director-after-tech-outages/) reported that Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies will temporarily replace fired White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/20/trump-sean-cairncross-fired-resigned/) reported that Donald Trump did not think fired US cyber director Sean Cairncross was good enough.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k3nn5p5mo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the White House removed the cybersecurity chief after a series of tech outages.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/white-house-cyber-chief-kirsten-davies-b3088470.html) reported that the White House appointed Kirsten Davies as the new cyber chief following widespread outages that disrupted air travel, banking, and other critical services.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/20/us-national-cyber-director-ousted-following-wave-of-tech-outages/) reported that the US national cyber director was ousted following a wave of tech outages.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/who-is-kirsten-davies-white-house-names-new-us-cyber-chief-after-cairncross-exit/articleshow/136011523.cms) reported that the White House named Kirsten Davies as the new US cyber chief following the exit of Cairncross.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOR1gxYnBpX3A3aDBXNVlpS3dkeUVsZHdQYTdYMjFCMDc5R21mYnhvdEVUNWZxS0poMlAxSm5TbnRMeUg3dmQ4S1M0NnNwN25ocms4VzhqQnhKYnhYcFlod2doeGdTSHdTc1B5cmZTbmY5UTdZRzhHdEU0bTRlbkF2Z0NlMUR3UEpBaTRzTlpRVUVHT3BkWEZMcjFrLXAxdV93MERLdXNwVlI?oc=5) reported that the White House tapped Kirsten Davies as cyber chief following outages.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/white-house-national-cyber-director-fired-after-wave-of-tech-outages) reported that the national cyber director is tasked with advising the president on cybersecurity policy and strategy.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBsMjNHamI1VDZnYjRudmN1X2s5cHlQeGEwTDdMTTFpVUlrR2xzWm5DaTVheWNKQzZpTENJYjlKa2lEU3ZCR1pZd21sVVZHQnJGcDdVUHJTM2dNLUFUay1OUjZtbHpNVE5POEprYUxuMERrMk9URTJldGc2bHg?oc=5) reported that Kirsten A. Davies replaced Sean Cairncross as White House national cyber director.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/white-house-replaces-cyber-security-chief-after-tech-outages/a-79998531?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/white-house-fires-cybersecurity-chief-after-widespread-outages/article71722952.ece) reported that current Defense Department Chief Information Officer Kirsten Davies will fill the national cyber director role in an acting capacity.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/white-house-replaces-cybersecurity-official-after-tech-outages-101795143948994.html) reported that Sean Cairncross had helped spearhead the Trump administration's AI policy amid new cyber threats.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/us/politics/white-house-cyber-director-departs.html) reported that top White House cybersecurity official Sean Cairncross stepped down following a series of technological outages affecting U.S. companies and federal agencies.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cyber-director-sean-cairncross-quits-leaving-job-b3088339.html) reported that White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross was fired following a series of technical outages affecting airlines, banking, and national security.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/19/white-house-cyber-director-ousted) reported that Department of Defense official Kirsten Davies will take over the position.

[Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/policy/2026/11/pentagon-cio-replaces-white-house-cyber-director-sean-cairncross-major-shakeup/417359/) reported that Sean Cairncross is to be replaced by the Pentagon's CIO.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/markwayne-mullin-tech-outages-white-house-b3087329.html) reported that Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin's statement attributing technology outages to artificial intelligence met with incredulity in the West Wing.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/former-press-secretary-karoline-leavitt-tells-administration-upfront/), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/transparency-is-key-ex-white-house-press-secretary-karoline-leavitt-urges-trump-team-to-address-us-tech-outages/articleshow/135959217.cms) reported that former press secretary Karoline Leavitt told the administration to be upfront with Americans about ongoing tech outages.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/18/novo-chefe-de-gabinete-de-trump-linha-dura-stephen-miller-cobra-mexico-por-fronteira-zero-mesmo-com-travessias-em-minima-historica.ghtml) reported that White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller pressed Mexico for zero border crossings while illegal border crossings fell to their lowest level in decades.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/i-am-checking-my-bank-account-karoline-leavitt-says-trump-or-any-white-house-official-should-issue-a-statement-on-whats-exactly-going-on/articleshow/135931517.cms) reported that Karoline Leavitt stated that Donald Trump or any White House official should issue a statement on ongoing matters.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-addresses-bessent-lutnick-rift-amid-nvidia-china-chip-row-says-he-won-t-fire-commerce-secretary-101794842790660.html) reported that Donald Trump stated Howard Lutnick delayed restrictions on Singapore-based Megaspeed to avoid escalating tensions with Beijing.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fact-check-posts-falsely-claim-trump-top-white-house-officials-moved-to-bunker-amid-faa-outage-101794679770886.html) reported that officials ruled out cyberattacks or foul play regarding the FAA outage.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914863) reported that new White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller requires prior approval for lobbyist meetings on administration policy.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/inside-stephen-miller-s-frenetic-first-week-as-white-house-chief-of-staff-101794652829659.html) reported that Stephen Miller is moving to reshape the White House policymaking process during his first week as chief of staff.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/who-is-stephen-miller-the-wartime-consigliere-now-running-trump-s-white-house-20261114-p61d1l.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Stephen Miller, the architect of Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, is now serving as his chief of staff.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-considering-firing-white-house-cabinet-secretary-meghan-bauer-amid-post-midterm-reshuffle-report-101794570976572.html) reported that White House Cabinet Secretary Meghan Bauer reportedly faces departure amid a post-midterm reshuffle.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/espns-stephen-a-smith-speaks-out-amid-speculations-over-becoming-trumps-next-white-house-press-secretary-101794573985255.html) reported that Stephen A. Smith dismissed speculation about becoming White House press secretary after meeting with Donald Trump.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/stephen-millers-new-rule-on-white-house-staffers-meeting-lobbyists-work-for-the-people-of-the-nation-like-donald-trump-not-for-lobbyists/articleshow/135803346.cms) reported that Stephen Miller outlined a new rule requiring White House staffers to work for the nation rather than lobbyists.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/politics/stephen-miller-memo-wiles.html) reported that the office of Stephen Miller outlined a new policy seeking to show independence from special interests following influence peddling claims.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/bijela-kuca-uvela-nova-pravila-nakon-skandala-sa-susie-wiles-sastanci-s-lobistima-samo-uz-odobrenje/261113021) reported that White House staff must now obtain prior approval from the legal counsel for meetings with registered lobbyists.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1087581/bijela-kuca-zavodi-red-medju-lobistima-bez-posebnog-odobrenja-nema-sastanaka-nova-pravila-i-za-dodikove-lobiste) reported that the new rules were introduced following the departure of Susie Wiles.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-wike-led-pdp-rejects-opposition-coalition-snubs-november-30-summit/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party rejected claims that it joined the opposition Coalition for Democracy.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-count-us-out-of-opposition-summit-says-pdp/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party disassociated itself from the Summit of Opposition political parties under the Coalition for Democracy.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-were-not-joining-your-opposition-coalition-pdp-tells-lukman/) reported that the PDP stated it is not joining the opposition coalition.
[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wike-led-pdp-disowns-november-30-coalition-summit/) reported that the Wike-led PDP distanced itself from the November 30 coalition summit.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926715-2027-sule-lamido-rejects-rainbow-coalition-says-pdp-will-win-jigawa-in-presidential-poll.html) reported that former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido stated President Bola Tinubu and APC governors have failed across Nigeria.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-pdp-apc-clash-over-dancing-at-campaign-rallies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jigawa PDP chairman Babandi Gumel stated APC leaders' dancing at campaign rallies is insensitive to hardship, while the APC stated it reflects joy and public acceptance.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926451-2027-sule-lamido-berates-vice-president-shettima-as-jigawa-pdp-begins-campaign.html) reported that Sule Lamido criticized Vice President Shettima as the Jigawa PDP began its campaign.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-yayi-realised-his-looming-defeat-the-day-adebutu-returned-to-the-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-yayi-jittery-over-adebutus-return-to-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu claimed that Ogun APC members joined the PDP and stated opponents are jittery over Adebutu's return.

reports.text: [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/babachir-lawal-predicts-peter-obi-victory-in-2027-dismisses-repeat-of-2023-outcome/) reported that former Secretary to the Government of the Federation Babachir Lawal expressed confidence that Peter Obi will win the 2027 presidential election.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-peter-obi-will-defeat-atiku-in-adamawa-babachir-lawal-insists/) reported that former Secretary to the Government of the Federation Babachir Lawal stated that Peter Obi will defeat Atiku in Adamawa.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742545-date-2027-presidential-debate-announced-tinubu-atiku-peter-obi-invitation/) reported that Tinubu, Atiku, Peter Obi, and three other presidential candidates are expected to participate in a three-hour debate in Abuja ahead of the 2027 election.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/opposition-coalition-signs-working-agreement-november-30/) reported that opposition political parties announced they would sign a working agreement for the 2027 general election and firm up collaboration at their second summit.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-atiku-obi-3-others-go-for-presidential-debate-jan-10/) reported that the Political Intelligence Group of Politico.ng announced a presidential debate for January 10 involving Tinubu, Atiku, Obi, and three others.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/ill-nominate-my-son-if-obi-offers-me-ministerial-job-babachir-lawal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Babachir Lawal said he would nominate his 40-year-old son if Peter Obi offered him a ministerial job after the 2027 election, citing his own age of 72.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742428-coalition-involving-atiku-obi-makindes-parties-fixes-date-summit-2027/) reported that the Coalition for Democracy moved its second summit to November 30, 2026.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/shettima-seeks-southeast-support-for-tinubu-promises-region-presidency-in-2039/) reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima appealed to voters in the South-east to support President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid in 2027 and promised the region the presidency in 2039.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926730-peter-obi-cant-win-presidency-without-other-regions-says-shettima.html) reported that Shettima stated Peter Obi cannot win the presidency without other regions.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/middlebelt-forum-rejects-purported-endorsement-of-tinubu-backs-obi-kwankwaso/) reported that the Middle Belt Forum rejected the purported endorsement of President Bola Tinubu for his 2027 re-election bid by some Middle Belt leaders and backed other candidates.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742365-tinubu-orders-lawyers-book-atiku-obi-reason/) reported that President Bola Tinubu disclosed he ordered the book published by his lawyer Wole Olanipekun for Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, and some opposition figures, and stated he would fund it.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-opposition-parties-set-date-to-sign-coalition-agreement/) reported that opposition parties working towards a coalition ahead of the 2027 general election agreed to sign a common agreement on November 30.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-obi-will-defeat-tinubu-spectacularly-in-anambra-momodu/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-obi-will-defeat-apc-in-anambra-despite-soludos-backing-dele-momodu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that African Democratic Congress chieftain Dele Momodu expressed confidence that Peter Obi will defeat President Bola Tinubu in Anambra State in 2027.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/obi-cant-match-buharis-popularity-shettima/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) Punch reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima stated Peter Obi cannot match Muhammadu Buhari's popularity and lacks a strong national base.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/coalition-urges-atiku-obi-others-to-back-consensus-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Big Tent coalition urged Atiku, Obi, and other opposition leaders to unite behind a consensus candidate ahead of the January 16, 2027 presidential election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-i-advised-obi-to-support-atiku-but-he-refused-momodu/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/i-told-peter-obi-to-support-atiku-dele-momodu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ADC chieftain Dele Momodu disclosed that he advised Peter Obi to support Atiku Abubakar ahead of the 2027 election, but Obi refused and insisted on running independently.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742307-2027-presidency-major-candidate-formal-backing-atiku-tinubu-peter-obi-slug-out/) Legit reported that a major presidential candidate received a formal endorsement ahead of the 2027 election.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742333-why-tinubu-defeat-atiku-peter-obi-2027-soludo-explains/) Legit reported that Anambra State Governor Chukwuma Soludo predicted victory for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 election based on his performance.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742286-peter-obi-atiku-tinubu-middle-belt-youth-leader-declares-preferred-2027-presidential-candidate/) reported that a Middle Belt youth leader revealed the presidential candidate he and his associates plan to support in the 2027 elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/no-serious-rift-between-tinubu-makinde-oyo-monarch/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Olugbon of Orile-Igbon, Oba Francis Alao, stated there is no serious rift between President Tinubu and Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde and that differences will be resolved before the 2027 election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/obi-kwankwaso-have-gods-grace-to-dislodge-tinubu-babachir-lawal/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress chieftain Babachir Lawal stated that presidential candidate Peter Obi and running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso have God's grace to dislodge President Bola Tinubu.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndc-will-defeat-tinubus-government-babachir-lawal-declares/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress chieftain Babachir Lawal expressed confidence that the party will defeat President Bola Tinubu's administration in 2027.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741660-why-peter-obi-kwankwaso-defeat-tinubu-2027-babachir-lawal-reveals/) reported that Babachir Lawal stated Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso have grassroots support to defeat President Tinubu.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-atiku-obi-makinde-set-for-second-meeting-in-unified-move-against-apc/) reported that Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, and Seyi Makinde are among opposition leaders expected to meet in a unified move against the APC.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/why-opposition-may-struggle-to-unseat-tinubu-in-2027-fayose/) reported that former Ekiti State Governor Ayodele Fayose stated it will be difficult for opposition parties to defeat President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 general election.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/updated-2027-opposition-parties-move-to-sign-pact-for-democratic-renewal/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/opposition-parties-to-sign-democratic-renewal-pact-nov-23-coalition/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-opposition-leaders-close-ranks-as-atiku-obi-makinde-set-to-sign-democratic-alliance-pact/) reported that opposition political parties under the Coalition for Democracy will sign a Covenant for Democratic Renewal ahead of the 2027 general election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-makinde-backs-opposition-alliance-to-unseat-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde stated he is willing to work with other opposition parties, including Atiku and Obi, to unseat President Tinubu in 2027.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/i-never-owed-salary-since-i-became-oyo-governor-makinde/) reported that Oyo State Governor Makinde stated his administration has never owed salary for a single month out of the more than seven years he has served.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/makinde-scores-tinubu-34-on-performance-backs-state-police/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Governor Makinde cited progress in some areas alongside wider challenges when giving his performance score.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/makinde-accuses-tinubu-of-breaching-2023-political-agreement/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Governor Makinde accused President Bola Tinubu of breaching a written agreement to form a government of national unity after the 2023 elections.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-slobodno-jos-14200-termina/5p87ptf) reported that over 25,000 depositors of bankrupt Alta banka scheduled an appointment through the Banka Poštanska štedionica portal to collect insured deposits.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/banka-postanska-stedionica-raspoloziva-gotovina-na-9872-odsto-bankomata/jb7rzys) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced available cash was confirmed on 98.72 percent of ATMs.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-vise-od-sedam-odsto-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima/6rqnc0h) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica continued the payout of insured deposits to Alta banka clients using funds provided by the Deposit Insurance Agency.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/rusi-cekaju-isplatu-novca-iz-alta-banke-kupili-smo-stanove-a-novac-stoji-na-racunu/5gz25z4) reported that the beginning of insured deposit payouts to bankrupt Alta banka clients brought relief to many savers while creating uncertainty for those with funds on accounts tied to apartments.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-sve-zakazane-klijente-alta-banke-prvog-dana-nastavak-i/6q0l3ml) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced it paid out all scheduled clients of Alta banka on the first day of insured deposit payouts despite a system failure.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/banka-postanska-stedionica-produzen-rad-zbog-isplate-depozita-alta-banke-termin/4mt6466) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica extended working hours for branches handling insured deposit payouts to Alta banka clients, with 16,450 clients having scheduled appointments.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/finansije/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima-alta-banke-u-srbiji/261113085) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica began paying out insured deposits to clients of Alta banka in Serbia after its operating license was revoked.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-u-alta-banci-prijavilo-se-14-419-klijenata/) reported that 14,419 clients applied for payouts up to 50,000 euros per depositor.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/guinea-siguiri-officials-sentenced-gold-mining/) reported that a Conakry court sentenced 22 former Siguiri officials to two years in prison and 202 gold miners to three years, with the defense considering an appeal.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/guinea-s-gold-rush-arrests-deportations-spark-outcry/a-79922842?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170196.html) reported that Guinea banned illegal gold mining over environmental concerns and charged hundreds of suspected local and foreign illegal miners amid arrests and deportations.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222867), a Russian state-media report, stated that Russian air defenses intercepted 464 Ukrainian UAVs over the past day.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQYlNPelhjZnJORzRJbU5hclNnbDFfeTdBNDVhVnQxMTJodlRRazFIdlFlOFRJb0JGZFFlMHZWRmtaNTg4VExVaHBmU2JISGdnQ09EVW1DamJ1WF9zRDNCdUlYbTN5SGR3blFhVHpfZ3VqcF9lOGJVbW0yZVVyNFhUMDFUb1loc0lx?oc=5), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-shoots-down-275-ukrainian-drones/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry announced the interception and destruction of 275 Ukrainian drones overnight.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222839), a Russian state outlet, reported that air defenses destroyed 275 Ukrainian UAVs over 12 regions overnight.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90751) reported that the Council of the EU approved another €1 billion in military assistance for Ukraine covering joint purchases of drones and air defense equipment.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063768/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186737-ukraines-air-defenses-down-82-missiles-380-russian-drones-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defenses intercepted or downed numerous missiles and drones launched by Russian forces overnight.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063559/) reported that Russia launched Oniks anti-ship missiles and 98 attack drones overnight, and Ukrainian forces destroyed 69 drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186118-zelensky-discusses-support-for-ukraines-combat-aviation-with-portuguese-foreign-minister.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky met with Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel to discuss support for Ukraine's combat aviation.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90475) reported that Canada announced a new military package for Ukraine worth hundreds of millions of Canadian dollars, including funding for the Czech ammunition initiative and air defense.

[UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/uk-to-send-ukraine-more-than-a-thousand-air-defence-missiles/) reported that Britain will send Ukraine more than 1,000 short-range air defense missiles from Thales Belfast and over a dozen radars in a £240m winter package.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063455/) reported that Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel stated Portugal cannot supply F-16 fighter jets to Ukraine due to domestic airspace and maritime defence needs.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uk-to-supply-ukraine-with-more-than-1000-short-range-air-defense-missiles-3725721), a local outlet, reported that Defense Secretary Wes Streeting announced a £240 million package of missiles, launchers, and radars for Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063360/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called on Western partners to accelerate air defence deliveries and highlighted ongoing Russian attacks with jet-powered weapons.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063378/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185864-air-defence-neutralises-126-russian-drones-used-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defense forces destroyed or jammed 126 out of 141 drones launched overnight by Russia, with strikes recorded at seven locations.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185832-canada-to-allocate-120m-in-military-aid-to-ukraine.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063366/) reported that the Canadian government announced a new military assistance package for Ukraine including ammunition, specialised air defence sensors, and winter military equipment.

[National Defence (Canada)](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/news/2026/11/minister-mcguinty-announces-new-military-aid-to-ukraine-at-ukraine-defense-contact-group-meeting.html) reported that Canadian National Defence Minister David McGuinty announced new military aid to Ukraine at the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063307/) reported that the UK anticipates a number of announcements on weapons for Ukraine at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063323/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy requested 40 more F-16 fighter jets and proposed an air defence missile exchange at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063305/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185706-over-1000-air-defense-missiles-uk-announces-gbp-240m-military-aid-package-for-ukraine.html) reported that the UK government announced a £240 million military aid package providing over 1,000 short-range air defense missiles for Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063265/) reported that starting the evening of 16 November, Russia launched over 300 UAVs and missiles against Ukraine, with air defences downing 205 drones.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219745) reported that the Russian Defense Ministry claimed its air defenses set a single-day record by shooting down nine Flamingo cruise missiles, a guided air bomb, and 2,256 drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185432-fire-breaks-out-at-a-petrochemical-complex-after-attack-in-russias-bashkortostan-media.html) reported that an attack targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in the Republic of Bashkortostan, causing a fire.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fire-reported-at-major-russian-petrochemical-complex-in-bashkortostan-amid-drone-attack/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Ukrainian drones targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, causing a fire.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Moscow claimed a record 1,441 drones had been downed.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063109/) reported that Ukraine's Defence Ministry stated private businesses have helped expand air defence capabilities since spring 2026 through groups operating under military command.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-defense/4185180-eu-allocates-eur-171b-to-ukraine-for-drones-ammunition-air-defense-systems.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90277) reported that the European Commission allocated 1.71 billion euros to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan program to purchase drones, ammunition, and air defense systems.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062856/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara spoke to UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648834-ukraine-aid-hurts-us-military/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that a Pentagon report stated Ukraine aid has forced US troops in Europe to divert funds.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062918/) reported that Ukrainian air defense shot down or jammed 106 out of 132 Russian drones overnight, with hits recorded at 20 locations.

[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2218213), a state-media outlet, reported that Russian air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 39 Ukrainian unmanned aerial vehicles over several regions during the day.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062833/) reported that Russia launched 96 drones against Ukraine overnight, with Ukrainian air defense destroying 81 drones and strikes recorded at eight locations.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184168-air-defense-downs-80-of-117-russian-drones-launched-overnight.html) reported that Ukraine's air defense neutralized 80 of 117 drones launched by Russian forces, with hits recorded at 24 locations.

reports.text: [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/mexico-arranca-las-votaciones-para-las-elecciones-generales-espanolas-del-29n-33249233), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/elecciones-espana-argentina-mexico-abren-votaciones-29n_1795295988) reported that voting opened in countries including Mexico and Argentina for Spanish citizens ahead of the general elections on November 29.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/montero-y-rufian-sacan-musculo-en-madrid-en-un-acto-con-un-duro-discurso-contra-psoe-y-frente-amplio.html) reported that Podemos gathered 3.5k supporters at its central campaign rally with a sharp speech against PSOE and Frente Amplio.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/echenique-acusa-frente-amplio-pedir-voto-psoe-desata-nuevo-choque-izquierda-tires-voto_202611206b006e94f6da642efef6c249.html) reported that former Podemos leader Pablo Echenique criticized Alberto Garzón's statements on strategic voting.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/abascal-advierte-de-que-sanchez-no-se-ira-de-rositas-si-pierde-las-elecciones.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal warned that Pedro Sánchez will not get off lightly if he loses the elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/que-propone-partido-popular-inmigracion-politica-exterior-elecciones-29n_202611196aff5c5bf6b335433bb604ca.html) reported that Feijóo's election proposals include a more restrictive migration model, quick returns, and a pro-European and pro-Atlanticist foreign policy.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/que-propone-psoe-politica-social-servicios-sociales-29n_202611196aff454b18c34d33accf241e.html) reported that the PSOE aims to reinforce social policies and improve social service benefits with sports and education as axes.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/sanchez-olvida-urda-feijoo-recuerda-que-tiene-70-muertos-alta-velocidad-mundo_202611196aff7201f6b335433bb61048.html), [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/feijoo-recrimina-a-sanchez-los-muertos-en-urda-y-adamuz-y-el-se-disculpa-es-un-dolor-que-llevare-conmigo.html) reported that Feijóo brought up high-speed railway tragedies including Urda and Adamuz during the debate and demanded Sánchez apologize to victims, while Sánchez apologized and stated it is a pain that will accompany him for life.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-18/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Prime Minister Sánchez expressed confidence in forming a government with a broader progressive majority during the sixth day of electoral campaigning.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-29n-directo-ultima-hora-campana-debate-sanchez-feijoo_202611186afd320b21e74551e81db3cc.html) reported that candidates are preparing for a debate while issues include the minimum wage and civil servant salaries.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-17/abascal-advierte-de-que-el-no-pide-el-voto-al-senado-para-el-pp-en-canarias.html) reported that Abascal warned he will not ask for Senate votes for the People's Party in the Canary Islands, while People's Party member Tellado asked to support the ultra party in provinces where it does not present a candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-16/frente-amplio-busca-desmarcarse-del-psoe-con-un-programa-que-blinda-la-vivienda-y-estimula-la-redistribucion-de-la-riqueza.html) reported that Frente Amplio leader Bustinduy challenged Sánchez to approve a universal child-rearing benefit before the elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-cambia-agenda-guipuzcoa-agresion-borrokas-candidato-calle-vuestra_202611156af9d6daea8d89799786925b.html) reported that People's Party leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo changed his campaign schedule to visit Guipuzcoa after an attack on his candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-15/feijoo-hara-campana-en-guipuzcoa-tras-la-agresion-a-jovenes-de-nuevas-generaciones-en-hernani.html) reported that PP leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo reiterated his proposal to exempt first-time job holders from paying income tax during their first year of employment.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/sanchez-encuestas-vende-mayoria-absoluta-pide-frenar-involucion-pero-psoe-invoca-fantasmas-guerra-civil_202611156af9af7103bbf30bb04d23a7.html) reported that Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez claimed an absolute majority and called for efforts to halt regression during a campaign rally.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-15/campana-electoral-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party condemned attacks committed against the People's Party candidate in Hernani, while Alberto Núñez Feijóo campaigns in Gipuzkoa.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/patxi-lopez-confia-triunfo-psoe-frente-involucion-que-proponen-vox_202611146af85d904196933d7edd33dc.html) reported that Patxi Lopez expressed confidence in a PSOE triumph against the opposition.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/cuatros-modelos-dos-bloques-muchos-reproches-pocas-ideas-nuevas_202611136af78eab03bbf30bb04b8a7e.html) reported that the economic representatives of PSOE, PP, Vox, and Frente Amplio held an election debate without a declared winner.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/psoe-y-frente-amplio-cierran-filas-en-el-primer-debate-a-cuatro-ante-la-critica-del-pp-a-la-gestion-del-gobierno-y-un-vox-centrado-en-la-inmigracion.html) reported that the debate covered housing, salaries, and pensions with few new proposals.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-14/sanchez-pide-el-voto-europeista-para-frenar-a-abascal.html) reported that Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez asked for votes to stop Abascal during the election campaign.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/gobierno-activa-subida-pensiones-2027-primer-dia-campana-electoral_202611136af700a8d3bddc0868b05ce0.html), [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/campana-elecciones-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that the Council of Ministers approved the urgent processing of a decree to revalue pensions between 3% and 4%.

reports.text: [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203580/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B9-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B4%D8%A3%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%B5%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85/) reported that International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi stated North Korea expanded a uranium enrichment facility at the Yongbyon nuclear complex.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203107/%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%B5%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9/) reported that the Iranian Foreign Ministry stated it does not expect progress in cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency and rules out uranium enrichment restrictions.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/six-killed-in-suspected-gas-explosion-at-georgia-apartment-building?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/6-dead-including-child-after-suspected-gas-explosion-levels-building-in-georgia/articleshow/136009645.cms) reported that six people, including a child, were killed in a suspected gas explosion that caused a part of an apartment building to collapse in Tbilisi.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375125/3-dead-3-trapped-georgia-building-collapses-after-gas-blast) reported that a suspected natural gas explosion in a residential block in Tbilisi killed three people and left three others trapped.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/counties/nairobi/six-dead-five-rescued-as-building-collapses-along-mombasa-road--5669398) reported that at least six people were killed and five others rescued alive when an eight-storey building collapsed along Mombasa Road.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/kenyan-building-collapse-near-nairobi-kills-six-people?traffic_source=rss), [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/syokimau-building-collapse-mombasa-road-kenya/) reported that a building under construction collapsed in Syokimau near Nairobi, killing at least six people.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/6-dead-after-building-collapses-near-kenyas-capital/articleshow/135801055.cms), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/3374388/6-dead-near-kenyas-capital-after-building-collapses) reported that six people died near Kenya's capital after the top floor of a building under construction collapsed.

reports.text: [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-22/doce-horas-en-campana-con-pedro-sanchez-la-ultima-vez-que-la-ultraderecha-goberno-no-habia-democracia.html) reported on Socialist candidate Pedro Sánchez campaigning and addressing voters.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/seis-gestos-de-sanchez-y-feijoo-que-explican-que-dijeron-los-candidatos-con-su-comunicacion-no-verbal.html) reported that gesture analysis expert José Luis Martín Ovejero evaluated the non-verbal communication of candidates Sánchez and Feijóo.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/ada-colau-la-ultraderecha-ha-sabido-diagnosticar-mejor-que-el-psoe-el-malestar-de-la-ciudadania.html) reported that Frente Amplio candidate Ada Colau defended that the left-wing coalition is the useful vote to stop a far-right government.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/ada-colau-responsabiliza-psoe-sanchez-gestion-vivienda-legislatura-claramente-son-suspenso_202611186afd6dd321e74551e81dece7.html) reported that Frente Amplio candidate Ada Colau criticized the PSOE and Pedro Sánchez's management of housing during the legislature, calling it a "suspenso".

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/misterchip-periodista-reflexiona-entrevistas-jordi-wild-pedro-sanchez-feijoo-ada-colau-importa-poco-que-preguntes-rapidos-que-puedan-llegar-ser-tus_202611146af84645ea8d897997857976.html) reported that journalist MisterChip commented on interviews conducted by Jordi Wild with Pedro Sánchez, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, and Ada Colau.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/politica/ada-colau-pide-jordi-wild-que-use-altavoz-violencia-machista-entrevista-normalicemos-esos-asesinatos-b50m_202611146af85d229a31a65adcdc2903.html) reported that Ada Colau asked Jordi Wild to use his platform against gender-based violence following her interview.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/jordi-wild-pronuncia-publicacion-sus-entrevistas-pedro-sanchez-feijoo-ada-colau-reconoce-sus-errores-supuesto-cometido-fallos-b50m_202611146af804eaea8d897997853fbb.html) reported that content creator Jordi Wild published a message on X acknowledging mistakes he made during his interviews.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/las-seis-horas-de-jordi-wild-con-sanchez-feijoo-colau-y-el-fary-en-su-casa-esto-es-una-vez-en-la-vida.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/mentiras-sanchez-jordi-wild_202611136af77949d3bddc0868b0de81.html) reported on statements and interviews involving Spanish political leaders including Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/el-psoe-presenta-una-denuncia-contra-okdiario-y-el-pp-por-los-pagos-de-la-defensa-de-koldo-garcia.html) reported that the PSOE presented a lawsuit against OkDiario and the PP regarding payments for Koldo García's defense.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/tellado-anuncia-una-denuncia-contra-el-psoe-gallego-por-difundir-sin-verificar-una-imagen-suya-con-koldo-garcia.html) El País reported that Miguel Tellado announced a lawsuit against the Galician PSOE for spreading an unverified image of him with Koldo García.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/sanchez-olvida-koldo-garcia-cloacas-psoe-jordi-wild-sabia-quien-era_202611136af70b0c4196933d7edbfb55.html) La Razón reported that Pedro Sánchez denied meetings with Leire Díez and did not rule out a lawsuit.

reports.text: [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/rarara-attacked-abuja-national-mosque/) reported that singer Rarara, a Tinubu supporter, was attacked by a crowd at Abuja's National Mosque.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-former-lp-presidential-candidate-condemns-attack-on-tinubu-praise-singer/) reported that former Labour Party factional presidential candidate Prince Kennedy Ahanotu strongly condemned the physical attack on Dauda Kahutu.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742579-apc-chieftain-condemns-rararas-attack-abuja-mosque-warns-2027-elections/) reported that former Imo APC senatorial aspirant Belusochukwu Enwere condemned the attack on singer Rarara and urged security agencies to prevent political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/mob-attacks-tinubus-praise-singer-rarara-at-abuja-mosque/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Hausa musician Rarara was attacked by a mob at the National Mosque in Abuja, drawing condemnation from Kennedy Ahanotu and Paul Ibe.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742532-breaking-mob-beats-tinubus-praise-singer-rarara-national-mosque-abuja-video-trends/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's praise singer Dauda Kahutu Rarara was reportedly beaten by a mob at the National Mosque in Abuja.
[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-apc-chieftain-condemns-attack-on-rarara-at-abuja-mosque/) reported that an APC chieftain condemned the attack on Rarara at the Abuja mosque.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190589/%D8%B9%D8%B4%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A2%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A4%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%89) reported that tens of thousands of Palestinians performed Friday prayers at Al-Aqsa Mosque despite military barriers.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925029-tinubu-booed-at-abuja-mosque-after-friday-prayers.html) reported that video clips showed people chanting slogans against President Tinubu as his convoy left an Abuja mosque after Friday prayers.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/conjoncture/un-peu-plus-d-un-milliard-d-euros-le-cout-de-la-hausse-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-devoile-par-le-gouvernement-20261115), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/15/les-revalorisations-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-couteront-un-peu-plus-de-1-milliard-d-euros-aux-finances-publiques-selon-le-gouvernement_6811009_823448.html) reported that Public Accounts Minister David Amiel stated that the revaluation of the minimum wage and civil service low salaries will cost public finances just over 1 billion euros, impacting public service expenditures.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/salaires-des-fonctionnaires-les-mesures-d-urgence-du-gouvernement-jugees-insuffisantes-par-les-syndicats_6809348_823448.html) reported that trade unions deemed the French government's emergency measures regarding civil service salaries to be insufficient.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/mobilisations-sociales-sebastien-lecornu-ouvre-une-discussion-d-un-mois-avec-les-syndicats_6809324_823448.html) reported that Sébastien Lecornu opened a month-long discussion with civil service unions, following which the CFDT announced it will join a public strike and mobilization.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/ne-pas-baisser-la-garde-laurent-nunez-promet-un-gros-dispositif-reactif-et-percutant-pour-un-nouveau-samedi-de-colere-sociale-a-hauts-risques-20261113) reported that Laurent Nuñez promised a large security deployment for a new Saturday of social unrest.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/benedetti-sabia-atentado-miguel-uribe-tarazona-advertencia-exministro-miembro-congreso-MH43886138) reported that Tarazona spoke about whether Benedetti knew of the assassination plot against Miguel Uribe and mentioned a warning given to a member of Congress.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/magnicidio-miguel-uribe-funcionarios-dni-grabacion-escena-del-crimen-denuncia-maria-tarazona-LN43825538) reported that Maria Claudia Tarazona claimed there were people from the National Intelligence Directorate present on the day Miguel Uribe was killed.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/consejo-de-estado-ordena-expresidente-petro-borrar-acusaciones-contra-registrador) reported that the Council of State ordered former president Gustavo Petro to delete 12 publications containing accusations against the registrar.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/unifil-records-2840-israeli-artillery-shells-90-airstrikes-in-southern-lebanon-in-october-alone-3013261) reported that the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon stated Israeli violations continued across southern Lebanon in October, including 2,840 artillery shells and 90 airstrikes.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222611), a state-media outlet, reported that Israeli reconnaissance drones were heard flying over Beirut at medium altitude for several hours.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261119-israeli-airstrikes-hit-eastern-lebanon-target-homes-buildings-in-south/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out five airstrikes on a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon while additional airstrikes, drone attacks, and artillery shelling hit the south.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-israeli-airstrikes-hit-southern-lebanon-as-drones-fly-over-beirut-sidon/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out two airstrikes on a town in southern Lebanon and an Israeli military drone flew at medium altitude over Beirut and Sidon.
