reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-za-pevnicom-u-crkvi-u-raski-povodom-slave-arandjelovdan/qp0bsvm) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić attended a liturgy in Raška and sang church songs with believers.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-sastao-sa-sefom-delegacije-eu-u-srbiji-foto/64zqtng) reported that the EU Delegation's charge d'affaires in Serbia, Julian Vassallo, met with newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kosta-cestitao-cupicu-imenovanje-za-predsednika-skupstine/txwtk3m) reported that European Council President António Costa congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his appointment as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pogledajte-sta-je-aleksandar-cupic-radio-dan-nakon-izbora-za-predsednika-skupstine/4x82b6x) reported that newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić removed graffiti with students the morning after his election.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nesvakidasnja-scena-ispred-skupstine-srbije-cupic-zapevao-sa-poslanicima/ryqtxrj) reported that the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia, Aleksandar Čupić, sang outside the parliament building with gathered citizens and deputies.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/studenti-odgovorili-na-dodikovu-cestitku-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-sreca-pa-ne-zaboravljamo/261120039) reported that students from Serbia responded to Milorad Dodik's congratulatory message to the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089376/izglasano-sest-potpredsjednika-narodne-skupstine-republike-srbije) reported that six vice presidents of the National Assembly of Serbia were elected, with all functions going to deputies of the Student List "Students win".

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/obratili-se-predstavnici-studentske-liste-nakon-sednice-skupstine-medju-njima-i-cupic/86s66k5) reported that Student List representatives held a press conference after the constituent assembly session, where Čupić stated he would be the president of all deputies.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Cupic-objavio-imena-kandidata-za-potpredsjednike-Skupstine-Srbije/993285) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, president of the National Assembly of Serbia, read the names of candidates for six vice presidents during the continued constituent session.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/stevandic-prvi-cestitao-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-pozvao-ga-da-dode-u-nsrs/261119159) reported that Republika Srpska National Assembly President Nenad Stevandic congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia and invited him to visit.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089228/ko-je-aleksandar-cupic-profesor-koji-je-ugostio-studente-u-plasteniku-a-danas-vodi-skupstinu-srbije) reported that Aleksandar Čupić is a faculty assistant professor who was proposed by student representatives.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/zvanicnici-crne-gore-cestitali-cupicu-izbor-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/x5h5s39) reported that officials of Montenegro congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Aleksandar-Cupic-novi-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srbije/993241) reported that Aleksandar Čupić was elected as the new president of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/prvi-govor-aleksandra-cupica-kao-predsednika-skupstine/8d6lsk9), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089225/novi-predsjednik-skupstine-srbije-odrzao-prvi-govor-izvinio-se-pastoru-i-lidiji-vukicevic) reported that newly elected Serbia National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić delivered his first parliamentary speech and apologized to Lidija Vukićević and Bálint Pásztor.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089177/treci-dan-konstitutivne-sjednice-skupstine-srbije-zastupnici-biraju-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that the National Assembly session continued for its third day to choose a parliament president.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sandzacka-demokratska-partija-podrzala-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine/d8q6zev) reported that the Sandžačka demokratska partija announced that its deputy Dženan Palamar will support the candidate Studentski for the president of the Assembly in tomorrow's vote.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/vucic-rekao-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-ja-nisam-od-tih-imate-tu-kolega-drugih-koliko-hocete/261118157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088957/video-vucic-tvrdi-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-nemam-nista-protiv-tih-ljudi-ali-nisam-od-njih) reported that Aleksandar Vučić told Studentska lista deputy Zlatko Kokanović during a session of the National Assembly not to send him kisses, alleging sexual harassment.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-nastavila-sjednicu-Minut-cutanja-za-pilota-Vucic-ponovo-govori/993001), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste-bira-se-predsednik/dv39qz9) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia held a minute of silence for Serbian Air Force pilot Goran Bulajić during its constitutive session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sara-valentik-studentska-lista-ocekujem-efikasniju-skupstinu-nakon-izbora-predsednika/4r7ggv4) reported that Student List youngest MP Sara Valentik stated she expects a more efficient National Assembly of Serbia following the election of a new parliament president.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Ko-je-Jovo-Bakic-novi-sef-poslanicke-grupe-Studentske-liste/992989) reported that Jovo Bakić, a 56-year-old sociology professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade, became the head of the Student List parliamentary group in the new National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-novog-saziva-skupstine-srbije/dv39qz9) reported that members of the 15th parliamentary session of the National Assembly of Serbia continued their constitutive session with discussions on candidates for assembly president.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/jovo-bakic-otkrio-ko-je-kandidat-studentske-liste-za-potpredsednika-skupstine-srbije/lhpd4cq) reported that Jovo Bakić, head of the Student List parliamentary group, held a press conference to reveal the candidate for vice president of the National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/lija-srdanovic-nakon-sednice-sutra-dobijamo-predsednika-skupstine/wd4r421) reported that Ilija Srdanović, the first on the Student List - Students Win list, stated after the National Assembly session that they will get a parliamentary president the next day and criticized Aleksandar Vučić.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ana-brnabic-o-studentskoj-listi-posle-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije-video/zf5qshz) reported that member of parliament Ana Brnabić spoke out after the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia regarding the Student List candidate for the presidency of the assembly.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-o-programu-studentske-liste-republika-srpska-i-srbija-su-jedno-zajedno-smo-jaci/261116356) reported that SNSD general secretary Igor Dodik stated on X that Republika Srpska and Serbia are one and stronger together in reaction to the Studentska lista program.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ovo-je-govor-jugoslava-gasica-aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-predsednika-skupstine/g9e9h7z) reported that Student List member of parliament Jugoslav Gašić nominated Aleksandar Čupić for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/polemika-u-skupstini-o-izvinjenju-lidiji-vukicevic/0dp5872) reported that National Assembly presiding officer Stojan Radenović and parliamentary group leader Aleksandar Vučić called on Student List deputies to oppose all violence during a parliamentary debate.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/od-profesora-do-kandidata-za-celo-parlamenta-ko-je-aleksandar-cupic/) reported profiles of figures discussed for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-vise-od-sat-i-po-govorio-u-Skupstini-Bakic-mu-uzvratio/992887), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-reagovao-na-obracanje-vucica/jzw7gwg) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia was constituted and commenced discussions on parliamentary leadership.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/kcerka-legendarnog-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-polozila-zakletvu-u-skupstini-srbije-ispred-sns-a/261117197), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088724/kcerka-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-ponovo-u-skupstini-srbije-polozila-poslanicku-zakletvu-kao-predstavnica-sns-a) reported that Sanja Džajić took the oath of office as a Member of Parliament in the new convocation of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-bira-predsjednika-U-trci-dva-kandidata/992845) reported that two proposals were submitted for the president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/konstituisanjem-skupstine-poceo-da-tece-rok-od-90-dana-za-izbor-nove-vlade-srbije/4f2sb64) reported that the 90-day legal deadline to form a new government in Serbia began with the constitution of the new National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-se-obraca-u-skupstini-srbije-jovo-bakic-negoduje/j4mp6l7) reported that Aleksandar Vučić addressed the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-novog-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije-preuzet-ce-i-ulogu-vd-predsjednika-drzave/261117138) reported that the Studentska lista nominated Aleksandar Čupić for president of the National Assembly of Serbia, and he stated he was ready to take on the role of acting head of state.

reports.text: [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/court-declares-aiguobarueghian-as-ndc-candidate-for-ovia-federal-constituency/) reported that the Federal High Court in Benin City declared Charity Iguodala Aiguobarueghian as the Nigeria Democratic Congress House of Representatives candidate for Ovia Federal Constituency.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926855-court-orders-removal-of-tukur-ribadu-as-adc-governorship-candidate.html) reported that a court ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC governorship candidate for Adamawa State and restrained him from parading himself as the candidate.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-sacks-ribadu-declares-suleiman-adamawa-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja removed Tukur Ribadu and declared Suleiman the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate for Adamawa State.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742472-breaking-drama-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate-in-adamawa/) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC Adamawa governorship candidate.

reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/ponernos-de-pie-los-vecinos-de-lanus-marchan-para-pedir-justicia-a-una-semana-de-la-tragica-nid21112026/) reported that residents of Lanús marched to demand justice one week after the gas explosion, coinciding with the patronal feast of the Virgin of the Rosary.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/tragica-explosion-remedios-escalada-muertos-victimas-fatales_0_pAhLnCZKXm.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-y-muerte-fallecieron-otras-dos-personas-por-el-escape-de-gas-en-remedios-de-escalada-y-ya-nid21112026/) reported that two outsourced workers who were hospitalized following a gas pipe explosion in Remedios de Escalada died of their injuries, raising the death toll to four.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/entre-escombros-miedo-y-reclamos-asi-se-vive-a-una-semana-de-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-nid19112026/) reported that one week after the explosion in Remedios de Escalada, concerns persist regarding new leaks and suspended works.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/seis-dias-despues-de-la-explosion-el-adn-confirmo-que-la-primera-victima-fatal-es-el-operario-de-nid19112026/) reported that DNA testing confirmed that missing Metrogas worker Marcelo García was the first fatality in the Remedios de Escalada tragedy, alongside the death of another worker.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-murio-otro-operario-de-metrogas-y-ya-son-dos-las-victimas-fatales-nid19112026/) reported that a second Metrogas worker injured in the gas pipeline explosion in Remedios de Escalada died in a Buenos Aires clinic.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/metrogas-respondio-al-enojo-de-los-vecinos-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-y-defendio-el-trabajo-de-los-nid17112026/) reported that Metrogas responded to neighborhood anger following a gas explosion and defended the work of operators.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/vivir-volcan-miedo-vecinos-remedios-escalada-animan-cocinar_0_GjkdF2xw94.html) reported that three days after a gas explosion that left one dead and 30 injured, fears and gas leak alarms persist among residents in Remedios de Escalada.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/es-un-desastre-protesta-y-enojo-de-los-vecinos-de-remedios-de-escalada-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-nid14112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada protested and expressed anger following a gas explosion, denouncing a lack of information and demanding assistance while entry to homes remains restricted.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/un-muerto-y-siete-heridos-graves-tras-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-confirman-que-el-incendio-nid14112026/) reported that Metrogas cut off the gas leak that caused the fire, allowing firefighters to extinguish it while the municipality organized the return of evacuated families.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-ordenaron-trasladar-a-dos-directivos-de-metrogas-nid13112026/) reported that the judiciary ordered the transfer of two Metrogas executives as part of the investigation into the Remedios de Escalada explosion.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/habia-muchisimo-olor-a-gas-el-dramatico-relato-de-los-vecinos-afectados-por-la-explosion-en-remedios-nid13112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada reported a strong smell of gas and feared an explosion hours before fires continued burning above commercial properties.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/explosion-remedios-escalada-obra-haciendo-metrogas-derivo-incendio-20-heridos_0_JOS19K03yU.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/fuerte-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-estaban-trabajando-y-rompieron-un-cano-de-gas-nid13112026/) reported that a gas pipe was damaged during renovation work by Metrogas in Remedios de Escalada, triggering an explosion and fire that left at least 20 people injured.

[Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijski-izbori-Zelenortska-Ostrva-dobijaju-prvu-predsjednicu/992509), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/zelenortska-ostrva-bi-mogla-dobiti-prvu-predsjednicu-od-nezavisnosti-1975/261115164) reported that presidential elections were held in Cape Verde, with former justice minister Joana Rosa running as a candidate to potentially become the first female head of state since independence in 1975.

reports.text: [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/lieberman-says-ousting-netanyahu-remains-his-main-goal-3725826) reported that Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Lieberman stated removing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu remains his priority and ruled out any government that re-elects him.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/benjamin-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-call-for-investigation/107392590) reported that Gadi Eisenkot demanded an investigation into the Israeli Prime Minister's Office over election fraud claims.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-lapid-accuses-netanyahu-of-attempted-coup-through-targeting-arab-parties-in-israel/) reported that Israeli opposition figure Yair Lapid accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of seeking to stage an attempted coup by targeting Arab parties.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/israel-party-chiefs-say-netanyahus-election-fraud-claims-a-coup-attempt/) reported that party chiefs stated Netanyahu's election fraud claims were a coup attempt, while his Likud party denied the claims.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/netanyahu-allies-open-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-3725611), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-netanyahu-allies-open-door-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-report/) reported that associates of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Gadi Eisenkot's team that Likud would accept a unity government without Itamar Ben-Gvir's party.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tibi-seeks-criminal-probe-of-netanyahu-over-alleged-election-interference-3725628) reported that Ahmad Tibi called for an immediate police probe into Netanyahu and his office following a Channel 12 investigation.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/eisenkot-calls-for-inquiry-into-alleged-netanyahu-role-in-election-day-arrests-of-arab-israeli-activists/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-for-probe-into-alleged-netanyahu-election-interference-3725614), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eisenkot-says-netanyahu-threatens-democracy-pledges-probe-into-pms-office-role-in-election/) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot called for an inquiry into Benjamin Netanyahu's alleged role in election-day arrests of Arab Israeli activists.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/la-corrupcion-en-el-ine-morena-y-su-prisa-por-deslindarse-de-taddei/) reported that presidential approval in Mexico has suffered from wear according to Polls MX data.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/oposicion-israeli-pide-investigar-presunta-manipulacion-electoral-por-oficina-de-netanyahu-33152148), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eisenkot-acuso-a-netanyahu-de-amenazar-la-democracia-y-pidio-investigar-una-presunta-maniobra-nid15112026/) reported that Israeli opposition figures, including Eisenkot, called for an investigation into alleged electoral manipulation by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office regarding the arrest of Arab activists during elections.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/pan-exige-investigar-presuntas-irregularidades-en-gestion-de-taddei-pide-un-ine-independiente-de-morena/) reported that the PAN party in Mexico presented a factual complaint to the FGR to investigate potential offenses related to public fund management under Taddei.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/oficina-netanyahu-planeo-detener-miembros-partidos-arabes-acusarlos-falsamente-fraude-electoral_202611166afabd97ea8d89799786fb0c.html) reported that a popular Israeli media outlet published information regarding a plan by Netanyahu's office to arrest Arab party members to falsely accuse them of electoral fraud.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640257/netanyahu-discusses-possible-resumption-of-attacks-on-iran-with-eisenkot-israeli-media), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahu-talks-possible-resumption-of-iran-attacks-with-eisenkot-israeli-media-3725556) reported that Israeli media outlets stated Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the possible resumption of attacks on Iran with Gadi Eisenkot.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640178/mossad-chief-visits-washington-as-israel-presses-trump-to-resume-iran-war-report) reported that Mossad chief Roman Gofman met with CIA Director Ratcliffe in Washington and is expected to hold talks with US envoy Witkoff in Miami.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/mossad-chief-visits-us-fears-grow-netanyahu-could-strike-iran-block-eisenkot) reported that Israeli opposition leaders fear Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could exploit the transition period to reignite the Iran conflict.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217953), a Russian state outlet, reported that Mossad chief Gofman arrived in Washington for consultations on Iran and will meet with CIA Director John Ratcliffe.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/mossad-chief-meets-u-s-officials-to-discuss-iran-as-netanyahu-pushes-for-war/000001a1-d57c-da30-a7fb-ddfd4a810000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914818) reported that Mossad Director Gofman visited Washington, meeting the CIA director while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed to resume fighting against Iran.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eisenkot-netanyahus-campaign-against-arabs-is-racist-he-says/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Netanyahu of running a racist campaign against Arabs.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/israel-gadi-eisenkot-accuse-benyamin-netanyahou-de-mener-une-campagne-raciste-contre-la-minorite-arabe-20261113), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/israel-gadi-eisenkot-denonce-une-campagne-raciste-de-benyamin-netanyahou-contre-la-minorite-arabe_6809358_3210.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against the Arab minority.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/world/middleeast/eisenkot-netanyahu-racism-arabs.html) reported that Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu days after the Israeli leader attacked Arab lawmakers in a speech.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israels-eisenkot-denounces-racist-hostile-campaign-against-arab-citizens-cites-progress-in-coalition-talks/) reported that Eisenkot cited progress in coalition talks while denouncing the campaign.

reports.text: [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/advanu-kosaricu-odreden-jednomjesecni-pritvor-zbog-sumnje-na-iskoristavanje-djeteta-radi-pornografije/261119166) reported that the Cantonal Court in Sarajevo ordered a one-month detention for Advan Košarić due to suspicion of child pornography.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/sarajevo/tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-advana-kosarica-zbog-sumnje-na-djeciju-pornografiju/) reported that the prosecutor's office requested detention for Advan Košarić due to suspicion of child pornography.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/slucaj-ubistva-na-dolac-malti-tuzilastvo-ks-trazi-pritvor-za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca/261115055), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca-zatrazeno-odredivanje-pritvora/), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/hronika/Traze-pritvor-za-sina-i-oca-nakon-ubistva-u-Sarajevu/992464) reported that the Canton Sarajevo Prosecutor's Office requested a one-month detention order from the Canton Court in Sarajevo for Emil Semir Tahirović and his father.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-must-win-all-18-cross-river-lgs-minister/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Minister John Enoh urged Cross River residents to deliver all 18 local government areas for Tinubu in 2027.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bakassi-port-border-modernisation-to-position-cross-river-as-international-trade-gateway-customs-cg/) reported that Comptroller-General of Customs Bashir Adewale Adeniyi stated the proposed Bakassi Deep Sea Port and border modernization will position Cross River as an international trade gateway.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bakassi-deep-seaport-to-boost-criver-blue-economy-attract-investments/) reported that Cross River State Governor Bassey Otu stated the Bakassi Deep Seaport would strengthen the state's position in Nigeria's blue economy and attract investments.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/business-news/925125-tinubu-flags-off-construction-of-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport.html) reported that Governor Otu stated the project faced political, environmental, and legal obstacles before the Tinubu administration supported its realization.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-lagos-port-congestion/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu flagged off the construction of the $3.5 billion Bakassi Deep Seaport in Cross River State to target Lagos port congestion.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bakassi-deep-seaport-will-redefine-nigerias-maritime-economy-tinubu/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu described the groundbreaking of the Bakassi Deep Seaport as a defining milestone in Nigeria's economic diversification.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-iran-targets-us-military-in-bahrain-houthi-strikes-continue?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bahrain condemned Iran's strikes on US military assets in the country while Houthi strikes continue.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328605/Iran-will-take-all-necessary-measures-to-break-US-blockade-Deputy) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister stated the country considers the US economic blockade an act of war and will take all necessary measures to break it.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-dice-que-iran-quiere-un-acuerdo-y-mas-noticias-de-oriente-medio_0_6NgQglcy32.html) reported that President Donald Trump stated Iran wants a real deal while responding with attacks in Kuwait and Bahrain, intensifying regional tension.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explosion-irans-qeshm-island-linked-disposal-unexploded-munitions-tasnim-reports) reported that an explosion and smoke on Iran's Qeshm Island were linked to the disposal of unexploded munitions.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915601) reported that local sources indicated a blast heard over Qeshm Island was possibly caused by air defenses intercepting an enemy aircraft.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2221047) reported that Iranian strikes damaged 15 hangars, warehouses, and at least ten other facilities at a US air base in Kuwait.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw4gn9jeqjq7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Kuwait and Bahrain stated they were attacked by Iran following a US air strike on Qeshm island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gulf-nations-attacked-after-us-strikes-iranian-island), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/iran-allies-hit-gulf-countries-after-us-attack-on-island/) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait said they repelled air attacks launched against them after US strikes on an Iranian island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-fires-kuwait-widening-strikes-after-us-hit-iranian-island) reported that Iran stated it targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/paises-do-golfo-entram-em-alerta-apos-ataques-dos-eua-a-ilha-do-ira.ghtml) reported that Kuwait announced it repelled drone attacks following United States bombings against an island in Iran.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941167) reported that the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after Tehran's Revolutionary Guards launched actions.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/paises-del-golfo-en-alerta-tras-ataques-de-eeuu-en-la-isla-irani-de-qeshm_0_TBK6HJ0Dve.html) reported that Kuwait detained drone attacks after US bombings on a base in Qeshm Island, and Bahrain alerted its population.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/iran-strikes-gulf-neighbors-following-us-attack-on-qeshm-island/) reported that missiles and drones crossed Gulf skies as regional militaries reported interceptions linked to Iran and Houthi allies following a US attack on Qeshm Island.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-strikes-iranian-island-after-tehran-targets-bahrain) reported that the US and Iran exchanged fire, with the US striking an Iranian missile launch site after Iran targeted a US military radar system in Bahrain.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532307/Iran-reports-strikes-on-US-military-assets-in-Kuwait-and-Bahrain), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's military targeted US military assets at a base in Kuwait and shot down an American drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1118/1599631-iran-us/) reported that Gulf countries intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249501/Iran-army-attacks-U-S-Patriot-launch-sites-in-Kuwait), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army stated its combat drones targeted U.S. Patriot defense systems and launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374869/bahrain-and-kuwait-repel-drone-attacks-after-us-strikes-iranian-island) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait stated they repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island.

reports.text: [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/cop31-at-odds-over-fossil-fuels/107414330), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-fossil-fuels-still-missing-from-draft-deal-at-un-climate-summit/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/fossil-fuels-still-missing-latest-cop31-draft-deal.1137485), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-faces-collapse-threat-as-latest-draft-fails-to-mention-fossil-fuels/) reported that the latest COP31 draft text released by Turkey and Australia omits explicit references to fossil fuels as negotiations extend past the deadline.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/no-headway-even-in-overtime-cop-chief-seeks-compromise-101795312540164.html) reported that the second draft of the summit dropped both proposed fossil fuel references and the annual adaptation finance target.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cop31-nouveau-projet-de-decision-finale-toujours-sans-mention-des-energies-fossiles-20261122) reported that a new COP31 final decision draft does not contain an explicit call to phase out coal, oil, or fossil gas.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945059) reported that global climate talks dragged into overtime due to a standoff over fossil fuels.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/cop31-draft-deal-makes-no-mention-of-fossil-fuels-omits-call-to-phase-out-coal-oil-and-gas-101795320791429.html) reported that the proposed COP31 final agreement recalls the UAE Consensus in its entirety but omits the words fossil, oil, coal, or phase out.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/environment/2026/11/22/climate-change/cop31-climate-talks/) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum stated the climate talks are close to a final deal after putting forward a text all parties can agree upon.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-climate-talks-close-final-deal-says-summit-president) reported that climate talks in Antalya approached a final deal with the announcement of a new package.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/la-cop31-prolonga-las-negociaciones-en-plena-pugna-por-los-combustibles-fosiles-que-esta-en-juego-en-la-cumbre-climatica-de-la-onu-3602879) reported that the Turkey climate summit failed to reach consensus after the EU rejected the draft without fossil fuels and Cuba denounced developed countries.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/sociedad/tuvalu-advierte-que-negociaciones-climaticas-siguen-empantanadas-cop31_202611216b0193c95cb1082f89b17380.html) reported that Tuvalu warned that climate negotiations remain stalled at COP31.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/tuvalu-warns-that-climate-negotiations-remain-deadlocked-at-cop31/) reported that the government of Tuvalu stated at COP31 that negotiations to reach an agreement remain deadlocked.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/countries-race-to-secure-cop31-deal) reported that COP31 climate talks have overrun their schedule as countries race to agree on a new global climate deal following criticism of an earlier draft.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-climate-summit-risks-failure-talks-go-deep-overtime) reported that the COP31 climate summit risks failure as talks go deep into overtime.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/environment/2026/11/21/cop31-talks-deadlocked-as-eu-signals-willingness-to-walk-away-if-no-move-on-fossil-fuels/) reported that COP31 talks deadlocked as the EU signaled a willingness to walk away if there is no movement on fossil fuels, with a potential compromise excluding fossil fuel wording while deleting carbon capture support.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-un-climate-summit-runs-into-overtime-as-deal-remains-elusive/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/cop31-talks-enter-overtime-amid-deadlock-over-fossil-fuels-and-climate-finance/) reported that negotiations at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Turkey, extended into Saturday following a deadlock among delegates.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/fossil-fuel-row-sees-cop31-talks-spill-into-overtime) reported that countries including France and Panama released a letter insisting that a deal include a clear transition away from fossil fuels.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/countries-race-to-secure-cop31-deal-after-fossil-fuel-row/) reported that the COP31 climate talks spilled into Saturday as countries raced to secure a deal after a draft text dropped all mention of fossil fuels.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168845) reported that a group of countries from Europe, Africa, Latin America and the Pacific challenged the proposed COP31 agreement, demanding explicit action on fossil fuels.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/environment/2026/1121/1600094-cop31-turkey/) reported that there are fears the COP31 climate talks in Turkey could end without a deal as a serious dispute over whether even to mention fossil fuels in the final agreement continues.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/cop31-deal-stalls-as-nations-struggle-to-agree-on-climate-plan?traffic_source=rss) reported that the COP31 deal stalled as nations struggled to agree on a climate plan.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-20/COP31-talks-face-overrun-as-divisions-over-fossil-fuels-persist-1SdXA01OHZe/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that countries remained divided over fossil fuels, climate finance, and scientific assessments as the COP31 summit neared its conclusion.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/environment/20261120-un-climate-talks-run-into-overtime-as-countries-clash-over-fossil-fuel-cuts-cop31) reported that deep divisions over fossil fuels and financial support for poorer nations pushed the COP31 summit beyond its scheduled closing day.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/global-affairs/cop31-climate-talks-spill-into-overtime-as-nations-quarrel-over-fossil-fuels/) reported that the draft text dropped mention of a $120 billion target for climate finance.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/20/cop31-talks-overtime-fossil-fuels-vanish-from-draft-deal) reported that African ministers stated they did not come to beg while civil society groups called it the worst COP ever.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-warns-against-cop31-becoming-a-fossil-fuel-summit/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that European Union leaders said the current draft decision text discussed in Antalya would represent a substantive step backwards on climate action and warned against COP31 becoming a fossil fuel summit.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/robinson-urges-eu-to-reject-cop31-draft-allowing-fossil-fuel-expansion/) reported that Ireland has thrown its weight behind a push to restore language committing countries to move away from fossil fuels.

[IPS Latin America](https://www.ipsnews.net/2026/11/cop31-nears-close-as-weak-compromised-draft-draws-fierce-backlash/) reported that civil society organisations and delegates from climate-vulnerable countries sharply criticised the latest draft of the Presidency-led cover decision at the COP31 summit.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/news/cop31-turkey-fossil-fuel-transition-b3088614.html) reported that the Cop31 climate talks headed toward overtime due to a dispute over fossil fuels.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-cop31-wrapping-up-in-turkey-climate-deal-elusive-as-fossil-fuels-go-unmentioned) reported that UN COP31 climate talks in Turkey spilled into overtime as countries remained deadlocked over a draft deal making no mention of fossil fuels.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-delivers-deals-host-turkey-climate-diplomacy-stalls) reported that Turkey is set to emerge from COP31 with billions of dollars in investment deals as climate diplomacy stalls.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-outcry-as-fossil-fuels-scrubbed-from-draft-un-climate-deal) reported that UN climate talks co-host Australia unveiled a draft agreement dropping any mention of fossil fuels, sparking an outcry.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1120/1599970-cop31-turkey/) reported that former Irish President Mary Robinson stated the EU should reject a COP31 draft text that removed references to ending fossil fuel use.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-un-climate-summit-enters-final-phase-with-no-deal-in-sight/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that after nearly two weeks of negotiations, countries remain divided on combating global warming as a new draft declaration omits the fossil fuel phaseout.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/environment/20261120-un-climate-talks-enter-crunch-time-with-no-deal-in-sight) reported that UN climate talks entered overtime as countries remained sharply divided over a draft deal lacking any mention of fossil fuels.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/energy-and-environment/cop-31-nations-still-seeking-deeper-fossil-fuel-cuts-as-climate-summit-enters-final-day/article71722951.ece), [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/environment/2026/11/20/climate-change/cop-fossil-fuel-language/) reported that nations are still seeking deeper fossil fuel cuts as the COP31 climate summit enters its final day.
[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168839) reported that explicit references to fossil fuels dropped from the latest COP31 draft deal.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTFBhLXBFcVNfRE9HaGdHTWttOEZJempXcU1GcGF2MzN2N2lCTWNsb1luY2pXS2tFeGxlcGppazJ2a04wLWllampWQzEyVXA5a3E1TV9iSmVDWGtiT2lBV1Q3dldtZERHbnYxb1B2UGFWb01XelV2?oc=5) reported that fossil fuel limits were cut from the latest draft of the UN climate deal.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/no-mention-of-fossil-fuels-in-latest-cop31-draft-deal/a-79992394?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that all mention of fossil fuels has been removed from the latest COP31 draft deal.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/live/2026/nov/19/cop31-climate-turkey-live-news-updates-) reported that a new draft text for the climate summit is due to be published as the conference nears its final weekend.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926351-cop31-carbon-capture-target-raises-fears-of-prolonged-fossil-fuel-dependence.html) reported that advocates stated the proposed carbon capture target at COP31 could provide oil and gas-producing countries with an alternative to reducing fossil fuel production.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/blogs-opinion/blogs/cop31-must-end-the-wait-for-africa-s-adaptation-finance-5675558) reported that African negotiators stated they must leave Antalya with a clear financial floor and delivery timetable for adaptation finance.

reports.text: [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-coalition-launches-operation-houthis-vow-reprisals) reported that the Saudi-led coalition attacked the Red Sea port city of Hodeida and other targets in a special operation.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemens-aden-divided-government-forces-prepare-houthi-assault) reported that inhabitants of Aden face a potential Houthi assault as government forces remain divided.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/conflict-in-yemen-could-stretch-for-months-us-withdraws-an-aircraft-carrier-and-other-mideast-news-101795039320695.html) reported that the conflict in Yemen could stretch for months as the US withdrew an aircraft carrier.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-arabia-appoints-new-yemen-commander-amid-setbacks) reported that Saudi Arabia appointed General Fayyad Al-Ruwaili as the new commander of coalition forces in Yemen amid Houthi advances.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/houthis-advance-on-aden-as-saudi-coalition-targets-military-sites?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Saudi-led coalition conducted precision strikes on 60 Houthi military sites as fierce battles took place in Taiz and Houthis advanced toward Aden.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/saudi-arabia-preparing-for-war-against-houthis-to-stretch-into-next-year-report-101795007702949.html), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/amid-setbacks-saudi-arabia-braces-yemen-war-stretch-2027-report) reported that Saudi Arabia is bracing for the Yemen war to stretch into next year amid Houthi advances.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/saudi-arabia-appoints-gen-ruwaili-oversee-yemen-war-after-setbacks-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia appointed Gen. Fayyad Ruwaili to oversee the Yemen war following battlefield struggles by Saudi-backed forces.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOR2l1bWc4eTF3NXJ2NktEbGZGWnRzeUJyYzBaQmxBdnpnblVHeEVzaDVZR01ndG1UQVAzTkdtVGxaYlRZcEJ6S3BHRTJuVkRXVjFkZkpOb3lYcGlsc25UVW41QjA1QmgxY1hBaUp0ZWYxQjFZYXhyWklaZFdLMEVEcnFoOWRSR1poMEh4ZWN0ZXlETnlJWU5JdXUycEMtdkszeXAxZEtPa2gwS3MwcDQ0eDRFNUQ?oc=5) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen bolstered their defenses near Aden to deter Houthi forces.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Houthi-Advance-Puts-Saudi-Crude-Exports-at-Risk.html) reported that Houthi fighters advanced to within 100 kilometers of Aden after government forces withdrew from positions.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-saudi-king-replaces-coalition-commander-as-houthis-advance-toward-yemens-aden/) reported that Saudi King Salman bin Abdulaziz replaced the commander of the Saudi-led military coalition.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/aden-houthis-iran-strait-of-hormuz-yemen-b3086340.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen deployed additional troops near the port city of Aden to counter a potential Houthi rebel advance.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-saudi-arabia-replaces-military-commander-after-yemen-setbacks) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced its military commander overseeing the coalition against the Houthis following setbacks.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249487/Aramco-is-our-prime-target-in-Saudi-Arabia-Yemeni-military) reported that the Yemeni military warned that Saudi oil giant Aramco and its facilities are prime targets for attacks.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/yemen-army-reports-661-attacks-on-houthis-amid-houthi-push-towards-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yemen's army recorded 661 attacks by Houthi forces and 173 Houthi fighters killed or wounded as government forces repositioned to defend Aden.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthis-advance-toward-aden-us-iran-deadlock-continues) reported that Houthi forces are advancing toward Aden while the US-Iran deadlock continues.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/saudi-arabia-challenged-yemeni-allies-ceding-ground-houthis) reported that Saudi Arabia was challenged by Yemeni allies over ceding ground to Houthis.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/lt-gen-fahd-bin-hamad-replaced-as-saudi-joint-forces-commander-amid-houthi-attacks/), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-replaces-joint-forces-commander-overseeing-fight-with-houthis/) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced Lt. Gen. Fahd bin Hamad as Joint Forces Commander overseeing operations in Yemen.

[Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/houthis-retake-bab-al-mandeb-and-move-toward-aden.php) reported that Yemeni government-aligned forces redeployed from the west coast to focus on defending Aden as Houthi forces seized territory along Bab al Mandeb.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/16/gli-houthi-padroni-a-bab-el-mandeb-dopo-la-ritirata-dei-filo-sauditi_850c3a05-2ef4-46b8-b2ed-b22483a90c37.html) reported that loyalists left the strait as the Saudi-led coalition's counteroffensive ended in a retreat.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemens-saudi-backed-forces-retreat-defend-aden-houthis-advance-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia named a new commander of its military forces as its Yemeni allies cede ground.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/yemen/20261116-saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-anti-houthi-coalition-as-rebels-advance), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-coalition-forces-fighting-houthis?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-anti-houthi-coalition) reported that Saudi Arabia dismissed the commander of the coalition forces fighting the Houthis in Yemen as government forces withdraw from the Red Sea coast.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/houthis-edge-closer-to-aden-as-yemeni-forces-pull-out-of-bab-al-mandeb?traffic_source=rss), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab-as-houthis-take-control/) reported that forces loyal to Yemen's internationally recognised government withdrew from positions near the Bab al-Mandab Strait as Houthis advanced.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqvg2xgyvnjpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to defend the interim capital Aden, leaving Houthis in control of the waterway.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648876-houthis-tighten-grip-key-route/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces withdrew from positions near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as Houthi advances threatened Aden.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/houthis-advance-in-yemen-as-government-forces-move-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that an advance by the Houthi armed group in Yemen threatens one of the government's last strongholds.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/houthis-aden-govt-defences/) reported that Houthi forces advanced on Aden and seized the Red Sea coast in a lightning offensive while Saudi-backed forces bolstered defenses.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249422/Images-of-the-advances-of-the-Yemeni-armed-forces-in-Lahj) reported that the Yemeni Ansar Allah-led government's military released images of the advances of their forces in Lahj province.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/yemeni-government-forces-redeploy-from-bab-al-mandeb-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that a spokesman for the Southern Armed Forces said the group is repositioning from Dhubab airport and areas around Bab al-Mandeb.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/anti-houthi-forces-retreat-yemen-iran-strikes-bahrain) reported that Saudi-backed forces retreated against the Houthis in Yemen while Iran and its allies increased pressure on the US and Gulf states.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemeni-government-force-retreats-strait-major-setback-war-against-houthis) reported that Yemeni government forces announced they were withdrawing from the area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending their main base in Aden.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemen-government-forces-withdraw-area-near-bab-el-mandeb-strait-houthis-control), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/southern-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab/), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-914920) reported that Yemeni forces fighting for the internationally recognized government withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving the Houthis in control.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261115-yemen-houthis-advance-to-within-60-kilometres-of-aden-military-sources-say), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/yemen-bab-al-mandab-conflict/) reported that Houthi forces in Yemen advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden and took the Kharaz base as government and pro-Saudi forces retreated.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/yemeni-government-forces-retreat-from-strait-in-major-setback-in-war-against-houthis/article71705608.ece) reported that Houthi gains in Yemen and attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping have strengthened Iran's position.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/world/middleeast/saudi-houthis-yemen-red-sea.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen retreated from the Red Sea as Houthi forces advanced.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPM1hhZ2pySkp3SHdfNllHQ2VsLUFteHIxRlFGVVR3QXFIbXJZX01HQkZ5Ml96SjBMSkJkOHh6TjNIakZkR3k5ME1WY0RyYTNBQkxvaF9qYTVtNm5GVEFqckVEalRReVdXUFJKZVhlSXEzcnotRFMyVVBMZllhdmJxUFBwRjByVExHbGhnR3luTDVqTlRxOG5TTjFVbmdBRmM?oc=5) reported that Yemen's Houthis stated they fired missiles at Saudi forces in Jazan.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321693/Yemen-s-armed-forces-say-they-struck-Saudi-backed-forces-in-Lahj), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249400/Yemen-military-says-it-struck-Saudi-backed-forces-in-Lahj) reported that Yemen's armed forces targeted gatherings of Saudi-backed forces in Lahj province.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532098/Yemeni-forces-complete-Aden-encirclement), a state outlet, reported that forces loyal to Yemen's Ansarallah movement completed the encirclement of Aden.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044365/yemeni-govt-forces-fortify-defences-in-aden) reported that Yemen's internationally recognized government is fortifying positions on the outskirts of Aden province as Houthi forces advance.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/yemen-govt-forces-fortify-aden-defences-houthis-advance) reported that Yemen's government forces are fortifying defenses around Aden as Houthi forces advance.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-loses-measles-free-status-as-cases-soar) reported that the United States lost its measles elimination status after 26 years due to failing to control rising cases.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/us-measles-elimination-status-experts) reported that doctors and public health leaders condemned damage by the Trump administration and called for RFK Jr. to resign after the U.S. lost its measles elimination status.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649012-us-loses-measles-elimination-status/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that the U.S., Mexico, and Bolivia lost their measles elimination status after 26 years due to prolonged outbreaks.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bo-mx-us-lose-measles-elimination-status/) reported that Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost their measles elimination status after at least 12 months of uninterrupted transmission.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/retroceso-importante-tres-paises-perdieron-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-y-la-ops-advierte-sobre-el-nid17112026/) reported that the Pan American Health Organization noted the re-establishment of endemic measles virus transmission in the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/rfk-jr-measles-democrats.html) reported that incoming senators and prospective presidential candidates blamed the health secretary's history of vaccine skepticism for the rise of measles.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/mexico-bolivia-ee-uu-pierden-estatus-paises-libres-sarampion-registrar-miles-casos-decenas-muertes_1794939654) reported that Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States lost their measles-free status after recording thousands of cases and dozens of deaths.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-pierde-el-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-tras-registrar-diez-muertes_0_kjl8snYN45.html) reported that the Pan American Health Organization revoked the United States status as a measles-free country following 10 deaths in 2026, while the CDC reported 5,412 cases this year.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-perdio-su-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-despues-de-mas-de-20-anos-nid17112026/) reported that the United States lost its measles-free status after more than 20 years, having obtained the condition in 2000, and that the organization also removed Mexico and Bolivia from the list.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/mexico-busca-recuperar-certificacion-como-pais-libre-de-sarampion-en-2028-asi-es-el-plan-de-90-dias-para-alcanzarlo-33174690) reported that Health and Population Wellbeing Policy Undersecretary Rafael Valdéz stated Mexico has a 90-day plan to recover its certification as a measles-free country by 2028.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-y-mexico-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-dicen-funcionarios-internacionales-de-salud_0_7l6dxuGYZx.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/eu-mexico-y-bolivia-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-reporta-la-ops-virus-se-ha-propagado-principalmente-entre-personas-no-vacunadas/) reported that international health authorities stated the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia have lost their measles-free status.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-and-mexico-lose-measles-free-status/a-79973966?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-us-mexico-and-bolivia-lose-measles-free-status-as-deaths-mount) reported that Bolivia and Mexico also lost their measles-free status alongside the United States.
[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years/107397030) reported that the United States reported more than 5,400 measles cases this year.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-vaccine-b3086570.html) reported that Mexico also lost its measles-elimination status following a virus resurgence there.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/life/us-reportedly-loses-measles-elimination-status-3725690) reported that an independent commission of the Pan American Health Organization voted to revoke the U.S. measles-elimination designation after finding continuous circulation.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years-as-virus-spreads-across-country/articleshow/135910807.cms) reported that the United States is no longer recognized as free of measles after witnessing a dramatic surge in cases.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/science-health/us-loses-measles-elimination-status/) reported that the CDC confirmed 5,412 measles cases in 2026, marking the highest number since 1991.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-after-26-years-wsj-reports/a-79946974?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the Pan American Health Organization reportedly stripped the U.S. of its measles-elimination status after 26 years.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/12/cdc-measles-deaths) reported that the CDC recorded six measles deaths in 2026 amidst the worst outbreak in 35 years.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914841) reported that the U.S. measles elimination status was revoked as the outbreak spread through 45 states.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQNmxORmhpLU9PVHl1bVFzT1A5QVhUVU5FWTM5Uzl3WDRJeWFvUXJVNWJxcmp1T3A5T2Z3MmlTMjJLUmVuZVRxa1VFWVFPbFZ2TnFBRlpNU3ZqOUpzczBTTzBkRXVaZ01oZEU5WGM4SzQ1ZTlBeFh0YnlMbzgzNHN4VFpTc3BiYXJMVEdkUHdFWFZKYV9vZzhHMUV4MjV6WGZjRndHSFlUczFvV2FIcFdPeHpYSQ?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-continued-spread-of-the-disease-report/article71700760.ece) reported that the Americas branch of the World Health Organization stated the U.S. lost its measles-free status after continued spread of the disease.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-calls-for-dialogue-to-resolve-issues-during-india-visit/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584860/musadik-malik-urges-evidence-based-solutions-in-delhi/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik called for resolving regional issues through evidence-based solutions rather than mutual accusations during his visit to India.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584347/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-for-sco-dialogue/) reported that Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistani-minister-visits-delhi-for-sco-forum-amid-frozen-ties/live-79999264?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/776aabd4c635) reported that Pakistan Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first high-level visit since 2023.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641334/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-lead-pakistan-delegation-at-sco-forum), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045878/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-attend-sco-dialogue-forum), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-to-lead-pakistans-delegation-at-sco-forum/) reported that Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi to lead a delegation at the SCO forum.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584154/musadik-to-lead-delelgation-for-sco-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead the Pakistan delegation to the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation forum in India.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583771/pakistani-delegation-led-by-musadik-malik-to-attend-sco-civilizations-dialogue-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead a Pakistani delegation to India for the SCO Civilizations Dialogue Forum.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641093/musadik-malik-set-for-delhi-visit) reported that Musadik Malik's visit to Delhi will be the first by a Pakistani federal minister to India since May 2023.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-confirms-first-federal-ministerial-visit-to-india-in-over-three-years-for-sco-moot/) reported that Federal Minister Dr. Musadik Malik will visit New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first ministerial visit in over three years.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640294/musadik-malik-to-represent-pakistan-at-new-delhi-sco-dialogue-fo), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044492/fo-says-climate-minister-musadik-malik-nominated-to-represent-pakistan-at-sco-moot-in-new-delhi) reported that Pakistan's Foreign Office announced that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik has been nominated to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation dialogue in New Delhi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581453/pakistan-to-attend-sco-meeting-in-india/) reported that Pakistan has decided to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in New Delhi.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-climate-minister-sco-summit-india-visit-new-delhi/article71701699.ece) reported that the upcoming visit marks the first high-level visit by a Pakistani minister to India in three years.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNdERQSHBUWVRvbktIZEo4ZDFTS2FKNzZjRUwzamQ5VjkwUE9RQl9KSkoxdmJ2QmNnT2tzNkdKc2dYNjNNQ2Q3RVNERlB3X1NOa3FUTU5XdmNocGtRdWdSSzIyelZhd3Mwc0JEd0t6dXhicEd4TVRPclNPcy1TTkQwcFE5OVV1WFBrUmNEcWFRenA0TGJYMDh2OWMtaV9PZmd1LXJWa0hUMWU1bE5JSjcwTw?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045885/trumps-personalised-diplomacy-hits-its-limits-with-3-way-summit) reported that US President Donald Trump's personalized diplomacy has hit its limits with a 3-way summit.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/xi-jinping-calls-for-total-elimination-of-nuclear-weapons-at-meeting-with-trump-and-putin) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping called for nuclear weapons to be banned and destroyed entirely during a meeting with Trump and Putin.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-xi-putin-peace-declaration-unprecedented-summit/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/trump-xi-putin-hold-historic-3-way-summit-pledge-peaceful-use-of-nuclear-weapons/) reported that China, the U.S., and Russia issued a symbolic peace declaration emphasizing that nuclear war should never be fought.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221925), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Russia did not start the war in Ukraine and is trying to end it.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/u-s-warns-russia-it-should-make-peace-with-ukraine-now-while-trump-still-has-room-to-negotiate-the-kyiv-independent-reports) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner told Russian and Ukrainian negotiators that current talks may be the last chance.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90606) reported that after a trilateral meeting in China, Vladimir Putin claimed Russia did not start the war and accused Kyiv of blocking peace.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186570-kushner-reports-progress-on-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-and-postwar-reconstruction.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner said talks with Ukraine and European partners made progress on future security guarantees and postwar reconstruction.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/zelensky-questions-whether-kyiv-and-washington-mean-the-same-thing-by-nato-style-guarantees-and-reiterates-that-postwar-ukraine-would-need-foreign-troops-on-its-soil) reported that Jared Kushner stated the United States persuaded Russia to accept security guarantees for Ukraine based on Article 5 of NATO.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186578-kushner-confirms-us-considering-nato-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine.html) reported that the United States is prepared to consider providing Ukraine with security guarantees modeled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty if they serve U.S. interests.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063690/) Ukrainska Pravda reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner stated Washington is convincing Russia of the need for Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222081) TASS, a Russian state outlet, reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia was on board with the approach that security guarantees for Ukraine should be part of broader agreements.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/kushner-says-trump-open-to-extend-nato-mutual-defense-type-clause-to-ukraine) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner said President Donald Trump was open to extending a security guarantee similar to NATO's mutual defense clause to Ukraine.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222077) reported that Jared Kushner stated Donald Trump is ready to appeal to the US Congress to ensure security guarantees to Kyiv.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/video-putins-nuclear-briefcase-caught-on-camera-in-china/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin's nuclear briefcase was caught on camera in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC summit, where a Russian officer confirmed it is the Cheget.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/donald-trump-presses-european-leaders-about-ukraine-aid-after-vladimir-putin-summit/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the U.S. president followed up his meeting with Russian and Chinese leaders with a surprise call to Berlin.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/trump-questions-europes-billions-in-ukraine-aid-during-surprise-call) reported that US President Donald Trump questioned Europe's billions in Ukraine aid during an unscheduled call to European allies from Air Force One after talks with Putin and Xi.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90642) reported that US President Donald Trump questioned European allies' continued military aid to Ukraine during an unscheduled telephone call to the Coalition of the Willing summit.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-says-nuclear-powers-need-only-about-10-weapons-before-xi-putin-summit-3725765) reported that US President Donald Trump told Fox News that nuclear powers need only 'about 10' weapons.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-we-are-making-history-says-trump-at-historic-trilateral-with-xi-and-putin) reported that US President Donald Trump stated "We are really making history" at the first meeting in history between US, Chinese and Russian leaders in Shenzhen, China.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/we-are-making-history-what-did-trump-putin-and-xi-discuss-in-china-cpngnxj) reported that Trump, Putin and Xi held trilateral talks in China on Ukraine, nuclear weapons and global security, issuing a joint declaration on international cooperation.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/trump-meets-putin-and-xi-ahead-of-us-russia-china-trilateral-talks?traffic_source=rss), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/china-calls-for-greater-trade-cooperation-as-apec-leaders-gather-in-shenzhen/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to remove investment barriers and strengthen trade ties at the APEC gathering in Shenzhen.
