reports.text: [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/a-decade-after-brexit-vote-uk-strikes-sweeping-deal-to-rebuild-ties-with-eu/) reported that Britain and the European Union reached an agreement to rebuild economic, trade, educational, and security relations ten years after the Brexit vote.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/eu-uk-reach-reset-deal-after-brexit) reported that the UK and the EU signed three agreements in Brussels marking a new effort to reset post-Brexit relations.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/uk-european-union-summit-meeting-on-november-20-2026/article71723782.ece) reported that the U.K. and E.U. are expected to announce a youth mobility scheme for 100,000 individuals aged 18 to 32 to live and work across borders.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/20/uk-and-eu-sign-their-biggest-deal-since-brexit-in-brussels?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and European Council President António Costa signed three agreements in Brussels.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/uk-and-eu-agree-deals-on-trade-and-youth-movement-pledging-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit-20261121-p61g38.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham touted the agreement as a win for the UK's cost of living.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-and-uk-strike-landmark-deal-to-strengthen-ties-after-brexit/a-80001076?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the European Union and the United Kingdom agreed on landmark deals on youth mobility and trade.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-uk-and-eu-strike-landmark-deal-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit) reported that leaders reached the agreement following a summit in Brussels.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/dix-ans-apres-le-brexit-le-royaume-uni-s-enflamme-autour-d-un-hypothetique-retour-vers-l-europe-20261120) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's remarks sparked debate over a hypothetical return to Europe ten years after Brexit.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxPMFZfOXJRS2RFTTlMenB0cXUxNG1mNnVFaThZUGVfM0J0cnY5ckZmRTZDbWZGVWtWSFBhR3lHMF9ZZWVMOHpOSFNMZjNROTc0Z3JFSkJzaUdXYVpQWmg2T1E5ckIyYk82bXpHUzUzTTRkc1dTX2hzYi12RHVVYUxPM0ExbDRNb29tcVhPdEJaZ3RrUQ?oc=5), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1120/1599959-eu-uk-summit/) reported that Downing Street announced that an EU-UK reset deal has been agreed during British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's visit to Brussels.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-burnham-hails-landmark-eu-uk-deal-as-good-day-for-britain-europe) reported that Britain and the European Union agreed deals on trade, carbon emissions, and youth movement at a Brussels summit, with Prime Minister Andy Burnham hailing the agreement as a landmark turning point.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/burnham-drew-a-line-under-brexit-at-the-eu-uk-summit-but-where-does-britain-go-next) reported that Burnham drew a line under Brexit at the EU-UK summit, which exposed the limits of negotiating one deal at a time as Brussels signaled its positions.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOdHA4czl2OVhoMVN6dURzVWJSVFBpRlhNOS1kYllMMm54RkNKTFBpM1ZVaG5jUE1yYzBlT0Q0Nk1YYlBFVFBQWC1MQW15WERjMWpZWEJ5QU1xaVFjbXRodUxuclNHVFNsWnE5WF9uY1pzcEMyRGk2MEVvRnhBUzMxRXpSeHlQV3Z4ZjlQSENjd0MySnFXbkVrZWVpY19XNjZZSklEYjJVOEgxTmZRM0NzbDdXU3A?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/20/burnham-trade-youth-mobility-deals-biggest-step-towards-eu-since-brexit), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375289/uk-eu-seal-food-and-youth-deals-are-stuck-tuition-fees) reported that Britain and the European Union sealed deals on food trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-eu-and-uk-agree-landmark-deal-at-burnham-s-brussels-summit) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU officials sealed deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/20/the-deal-is-done-uk-says-brexit-reset-deal-with-eu-is-agreed/) reported that the EU stated the reset deal will not take effect without an agreement on tuition fees for European students.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-rare-eu-uk-summit-as-andy-burnham-seeks-to-mend-brexit-damage) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU top officials were set to announce deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a Brussels summit.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-eu-and-uk-set-to-sign-deals-on-trade-energy-youth-mobility-at-brussels-summit), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6lymr5x4ye5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UK and the EU are set to agree on new deals concerning trade, energy, and youth mobility at a Brussels summit.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/andy-burnham-brussels-antonio-costa-brexit-ursula-von-der-leyen-b3088477.html), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/20/g-s1-154576/uk-eu-summit) reported that top EU officials met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in a rare summit to strengthen ties and mend Brexit damage a decade after the leave vote.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/royaume-uni-andy-burnham-a-bruxelles-pour-concretiser-son-rapprochement-avec-l-union-europeenne-20261120) reported that London and Brussels reached a common understanding on youth mobility ten years after the Brexit referendum.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/can-andy-burnham-bring-british-brio-back-to-brussels) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is in Brussels for an EU-UK summit.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/au-royaume-uni-andy-burnham-ravive-le-debat-sur-le-brexit-plus-de-cinq-ans-apres-sa-mise-en-uvre-effective_6813589_3210.html) reported that Andy Burnham revived the debate on Brexit in the United Kingdom ahead of discussions between Europeans and the UK.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/podcast/brussels-playbook-podcast/what-does-europe-want-from-andy-burnhams-reconciliation-bid/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that negotiators completed a final squeeze ahead of the EU-UK reset summit.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/as-burnham-heads-to-brussels-are-new-brexit-wars-about-to-begin?traffic_source=rss) reported that the UK premier is heading to Brussels for the second round of EU talks aimed at deepening post-Brexit cooperation.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/19/zombie-nation-burnhams-britain-ponders-its-brexit-woes-as-eu-uk-summit-set-to-begin/) reported that senior EU officials remain unsure whether the UK premier's positive rhetoric is backed by entrenched belief or is a warm-up act ahead of talks.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/19/brejoin-is-andy-burnham-going-to-reverse-brexit-podcast) reported that Jessica Elgot and David McAllister discussed the prospect of the UK rejoining the European Union ahead of a UK-EU summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/andy-burnham-will-sign-a-brexit-reset-deal-tomorrow-the-real-battle-comes-next/) reported that Brussels remains wary of letting Britain cherry-pick the benefits of EU membership from outside the club as Andy Burnham prepares to sign a Brexit reset deal.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/andy-burnham-eu-uk-brexit-reset/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that POLITICO spoke to more than 30 politicians, officials, and campaigners in the UK and Brussels regarding Andy Burnham's grand strategy on Europe.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/18/david-lammy-andy-burnham-campaign-rejoining-eu-election-brexit) reported that former foreign secretary David Lammy urged Prime Minister Andy Burnham to fight the next election on rejoining the EU ahead of a summit in Brussels.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/invest-international-rail-services-boost-uk-eu-reset-andy-burnham) reported that campaigners urged investments in international rail services to boost the UK-EU reset.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ukeu-reset-will-take-time-any-decisions-to-follow-next-elections-says-british-pm-andy-burnham-101794902431647.html) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated any UK-EU relationship changes will take time and follow the next election.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/17/burnham-says-brexit-has-dramatically-diminished-britains-global-standing), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/britain-lost-more-than-it-gained-since-brexit-pm-burnham-says-3725664) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated at the Lord Mayor's Banquet that Britain has lost more than it gained from Brexit and that global standing has diminished.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOZGVhQnh3ZDFYZ0JqbnFKazRlM2RDblBURFRPZ2VLZTJSeUY5RmpreVJ5Sk14Qk5wWDJsaWZ0N3JSVVJvV1pCOXV4YVoxUDM4UFpLY2t1RWYwVmhNUHJuTXdraDNWbDAtN0otbXZXakg2bE5SNHpFRnZKNkUwVFJlVFBHLVd1akIxb2w4YmJ0VXF4dm9FWUdlZmlQSHpVNmxETWJhYTRlRjA?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/uk-leader-andy-burnham-says-brexit-hasnt-worked-ahead-of-reset-summit-with-eu) reported that UK political figure Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not worked and failed to deliver on promises to take back control of borders, laws, and the economy ahead of an EU reset summit.
[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uk/2026/11/17/britain-lost-its-moral-compass-over-gaza-says-burnham/) reported that Andy Burnham stated Britain lost its moral compass over Gaza.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/brexit-leave-burnham-eu-reset/) reported that former Prime Minister Boris Johnson insisted the UK would back Brexit again in another referendum despite polls suggesting otherwise.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374654/uk-pm-andy-burnham-says-brexit-has-not-worked-ahead-reset-summit-eu) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not delivered for the country and that a much closer relationship with the EU is needed.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/brexit-sequel-leave-voices-reorganise-burnham-chases-eu-reset.1137203) reported that Prime Minister Andy Burnham talked with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on the sidelines of a meeting.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/16/brexit-share-your-thoughts-on-andy-burnhams-plan-for-a-new-eu-deal) reported that The Guardian invited public thoughts on Andy Burnham's plan to reopen the Brexit debate and sign a new deal with the EU.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/16/andy-burnham-brexit-has-not-worked-sign-new-deal-with-eu) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated Brexit has not worked and announced plans to sign a new deal with the EU.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/16/uk-lost-more-than-it-gained-from-brexit-andy-burnham-to-say-ahead-of-eu-summit/) reported that Andy Burnham compared the Brexit deal to the emperor's new clothes and stated Britain lost more than it gained.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915021) reported that UK Prime Minister Burnham stated Britain lost more than it gained from Brexit and seeks an EU reset.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/andy-burnham-eu-brexit-labour-b3084959.html), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/andy-burnham-says-uk-lost-more-than-we-gained-brexit) reported that Andy Burnham stated the UK lost more than it gained through Brexit and accused Tories of burning bridges with the EU.

reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/bienvenue-a-phnom-penh-why-cambodias-francophonie-summit-matters/) reported that political divisions overshadowed the 20th Francophonie summit hosted in Cambodia.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261117-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-des-n%C3%A9gociations-tendues-et-des-r%C3%A9formes-en-attente) reported that leaders of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie prolonged discussions and postponed the election of the secretary-general due to a lack of agreement.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/cambodian-sins-overshadow-global-francophonie-summit-in-phnom-penh/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron urged Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet to investigate the assassination of former Cambodian lawmaker Lim Kimya.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-afrique-midi/20261116-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-sur-le-fond-la-position-de-la-rdc-a-gagn%C3%A9) reported that regarding the postponement of the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie, the position of the DR Congo has gained ground.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-francophonie-summit-avoids-major-disaster-after-clash-over-leadership) reported that the Francophonie summit postponed the election of a new chief following a row between DR Congo and Rwanda.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/dr-congo-rwanda-row-derails-francophone-summit-vote-6555176) reported that the DR Congo-Rwanda row derailed the vote for a new secretary general of the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie during talks in Phnom Penh.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/arts-et-culture/francophonie-lelection-du-secretaire-general-reportee-a-novembre-2027/) reported that the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie was postponed to November 2027.

[La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/15/a-phnom-penh-au-royaume-du-cambodge-la-tunisie-au-sommet-de-la-francophonie-aujourdhui/) reported that Dhia Khaled led the Tunisian delegation to the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

[Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/20e-sommet-de-la-francophonie-sur-fond-de-tensions-entre-kigali-et-kinshasa-une-gueguerre-qui-pourrait-couter-a-lafrique-le-poste-de-secretaire-general-de-linstitution/) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened on November 15, 2026, in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261115-tensions-and-economic-turbulence-in-cambodia-as-it-hosts-francophonie-summit) reported that the 20th Francophonie summit opened on November 15 in Phnom Penh amidst rising tensions with Thailand and declining tourism.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-overshadowed-by-tensions-in-africa) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a leadership dispute.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-amid-rwanda-dr-congo-rift?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Francophone summit opened in Cambodia amidst a clash between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda over leadership.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/politics/francophone-summit-congo-rwanda/) reported that the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie summit opened with a Congo-Rwanda clash.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-leadership-as-francophone-summit-opens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a summit of French-speaking nations opened amid a clash between DR Congo and Rwanda over the organization's leadership, with DR Congo threatening to quit.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85895265), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/phnom-penh-accueille-la-48e-conference-ministerielle-de-la-francophonie/) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan will attend the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-vote/) reported that DR Congo stated it will consider dropping its Francophonie candidate while Rwanda refused, and spokesman Patrick Muyaya responded ahead of the leadership vote.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261114-dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-leadership-as-macron-seeks-compromise), [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophone-top-job/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that DR Congo and Rwanda clashed over the leadership of the Francophonie.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010019/tech-outages-attributed-to-rapid-software-patching-us-officials-experts/story/) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated software patching efforts are sometimes creating short-term disruptions.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/surge-software-patches-likely-behind-recent-tech-outages/) reported that bank regulators are on alert as software patches are linked to recent tech outages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-faa-trump.html) reported that current and former officials stated Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's push to rapidly modernize aviation systems during President Trump's second term could have contributed to the ground stop.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/faa-chris-sununu-federal-aviation-administration-dot-bedford-b3087468.html) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy continues to blame a contractor for the events leading to the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/faa-sean-duffy-flight-stoppage) reported that the head of the Federal Aviation Administration urged people to blame him rather than Sean Duffy for the flight stoppage.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/marco-rubio-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-eeuu-no-hay-motivos-para-creer-que-esten-relacionadas-nid18112026/) reported that Marco Rubio stated there are no reasons to believe technological failures in the United States are related to hackers or a foreign state.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/marco-rubio-bomb-plot-tech-outages-b3086955.html) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated some intelligence sources are liars and criminals.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/18/microsoft-flights-banks-and-now-the-nsa-a-week-of-tech-outages-in-the-us?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the classified network used by the US National Security Agency for internal communications went down on Tuesday.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crkgvxxwpwz2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there was zero evidence supporting online theories that recent technical disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks, and flights are connected.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/zero-evidence-recent-tech-outages-linked-marco-rubio), [Punch](https://punchng.com/no-evidence-of-coordinated-cyberattack-behind-us-outages-rubio/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is zero evidence linking the recent technical disruptions and outages to any coordinated cyberattack or malign actor.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/rubio-rules-out-cyberattacks-or-links-between-tech-outages?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no evidence linking technical outages to each other or to cyberattacks.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941144) reported that technology outages shut down email for many companies and grounded thousands of flights over several days before extending to the US government.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/marco-rubio-says-zero-information-that-us-outages-are-linked-or-caused-by-a-malign-actor/article71714357.ece), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/zero-evidence-of-any-malign-actor-marco-rubio-dismisses-link-between-faa-ground-stop-microsoft-and-other-outages-101794969511572.html) reported that Marco Rubio stated there is zero information or evidence linking the U.S. service outages to any malign actor and dismissed connections between the FAA ground stop and Microsoft outages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/faa-routers-ground-stop.html) reported that federal officials stated a router made by Juniper Networks caused a data overload that disrupted communications.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-administration-proposes-50-billion-plan-to-upgrade-faa-infrastructure-after-nationwide-ground-stop-101794956678150.html) reported that the Trump administration proposed a $50 billion plan to upgrade FAA infrastructure.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/faa-suspends-installation-of-routers-blamed-for-nationwide-air-traffic-control-ground-stop-101794957621094.html) reported that the malfunctioned routers are being tested in a lab at the headquarters of L3Harris.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/faa-halts-new-router-installations-nationwide-ground-stop/) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration stopped installing new network routers and disabled a function on 60 similar units following a nationwide ground stop.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-senators-urge-faa-to-halt-router-upgrades-after-nationwide-flight-chaos-demand-probe/articleshow/135934901.cms) reported that US senators urged the FAA to halt router upgrades following nationwide flight chaos.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/faa-halts-installations-of-routers-to-assess-ground-stop-trigger/6247EY54KBCVPJM2M2BUCUX2LE/) reported that the FAA halted installations of routers to assess the ground stop trigger, while officials have yet to pinpoint the cause of the Arkansas router malfunction.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/us-senators-demand-faa-pause-upgrades-linked-to-nationwide-ground-stop?traffic_source=rss) reported that US senators demanded an FAA pause on communications system upgrades linked to the nationwide ground stop.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/16/g-s1-153841/up-first-newsletter-faa-ground-stop-democratic-leaders-congress-trump-asia-trip) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated things could be back to normal at the end of Monday following the FAA ground stop.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/frustrated-flyers-drive-thousands-miles-faa-ground-stop/) reported that frustrated air passengers drove thousands of miles to get around the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/thanksgiving-flights-unlikely-to-be-affected-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupts-over-12-400-us-flights-101794912127516.html) reported that Thanksgiving flights are expected to remain unaffected after the FAA ground stop disrupted 12,400 flights.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-refuses-to-take-responsibility-for-nationwide-faa-ground-stop-blames-biden-and-outdated-equipment-101794853144497.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he takes no responsibility for the nationwide flight ground stop and blamed old equipment and Democrats.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-flight-disruptions-may-continue-until-monday-trump-administration/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/us-aviation-crisis-flight-cancellations-may-continue-until-monday/) reported that the Trump administration stated flight disruptions and cancellations across the United States caused by a system upgrade failure may continue until Monday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-trump-faa.html), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-sean-duffy-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085303.html) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy offered new details on the nationwide ground stop caused by a fix and refused to apologize or guarantee a similar meltdown will not happen again.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/trump-atribui-falha-no-controle-aereo-dos-eua-a-gestao-biden-e-cobra-recursos-do-congresso.ghtml) reported that US President Donald Trump commented on the telecommunications interruption in the air traffic control system.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914962) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced investigators determined a contractor's error or faulty router caused the disruption.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-biden-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085211.html) reported that transportation secretary Sean Duffy blamed a defense contractor for Saturday flight cancellations exceeding 6,000.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-blames-biden-for-us-flight-disruptions/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former US President Donald Trump blamed Joe Biden's administration for the nationwide ground stop that disrupted travel.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-urge-al-congreso-aprobar-mas-fondos-para-modernizar-el-sistema-aereo-de-ee-uu_0_CbBJD7DqKM.html), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322603-trump-cobra-congresso-por-verbas-para-modernizar-sistema-de-aviacao.html) reported that Donald Trump urged Congress to approve urgent funding to modernize the US air traffic control system following massive flight suspensions caused by technical failures.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-culpa-al-gobierno-de-biden-por-paralizacion-de-los-vuelos-reportan-mas-de-16-mil-vuelos-cancelados/) reported that Donald Trump blamed the Biden government for the suspension of flights following cancellation reports.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/se-normalizan-los-vuelos-en-estados-unidos-y-trump-culpa-a-biden-por-la-paralizacion-nid15112026/) reported that flights normalized in the United States after over 18,000 flights were affected across the territory between Friday and Saturday.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/el-fbi-investiga-si-una-actualizacion-de-software-causo-la-falla-que-afecto-al-trafico-aereo-en-estados-unidos-segun-bloomberg-3600982) reported that the FBI is investigating whether a software update caused the failure affecting air traffic in the United States.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/fallo-mantenimiento-rutina-causo-mayor-caos-aereo-estados-unidosun-fallo-sistema-augura-miles-cancelaciones_202611146af8975dd3bddc0868b1d65c.html) reported that the White House stated a system failure occurred during routine maintenance while replacing old copper wiring with fiber optics.

reports.text: [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532383/Iraq-s-government-and-Kataib-Hezbollah-agree-on-middle-ground), a state-media outlet, reported that the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah reached a middle ground and the government backed down from threats to deploy the army and forcibly remove Kataib Hezbollah members from a town near Baghdad.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/21/iraqi-governments-control-of-jurf-al-sakhar-marks-rare-success-but-key-issues-remain/) reported that the Iraqi government's control of Jurf Al Sakhar marks a rare success while key issues remain.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-iraq-reopens-key-road-linking-jurf-al-nasr-to-karbala/) reported that Iraq reopened a key road linking the Latifiya area, Jurf al-Nasr district, and Karbala.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/will-iraqs-return-jurf-al-sakhar-weaken-iran-backed-kataib-hezbollah) reported that the town of Jurf al-Sakhar and surrounding agricultural areas had been under the control of Iran-backed armed factions since 2014.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-iraq-opens-security-command-headquarters-in-jurf-al-nasr-as-troops-redeploy/) reported that Iraq's Federal Police announced the opening of a headquarters for security and army forces in the Jurf al-Nasr area of Babil province.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-with-powerful-pro-iran-militia) reported that three senior security officials stated Iraq reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iraqi-forces-enter-iran-backed-kataeb-hezbollah-stronghold-3725803) reported that Iraqi government forces moved into Jurf al-Sakher, the main base of Kataeb Hezbollah.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261120-iraqi-security-forces-to-deploy-in-hezbollah-stronghold-under-compromise-deal), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/iraqi-security-forces-move-into-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-of-jurf-al-sakhar/) reported that Iraqi security forces deployed in the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar under a compromise deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-security-forces-deploy-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-security-officials) reported that Iraqi security forces will deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/world/middleeast/iraq-militia-iran-kataib-hezbollah.html) reported that Iraqi army and police units were deployed into territory controlled by Kataib Hezbollah for the first time in over a decade.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-powerful-pro-iran-militia-security-officials-say) reported that Iraq has reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah according to security officials.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-forces-enter-militia-stronghold-jurf-al-sakhr-friday) reported that Iraqi forces will begin deploying on Friday in the main stronghold of Kataeb Hezbollah as Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi steps up efforts to rein in the faction.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-jurf-al-sakhr-standoff) reported that Iraq's prime minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff over Kataib Hezbollah vacating Jurf al-Sakhr.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6043167/iraq-environmentalist-marshes-iran-backed-militia-kidnapped) reported that an Iraqi environmentalist was kidnapped and tortured by Iran-backed militias while working to save the marshes.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-standoff-with-iran-backed-militia/) reported that Iraq's Prime Minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff with an Iran-backed militia.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-rejects-government-ultimatum-to-withdraw-from-jurf-al-sakhr/) reported that Iraq's Kata'ib Hezbollah stated it would not withdraw from its stronghold in Jurf al-Sakhr despite a government ultimatum.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648958-iraq-militia-oil-smuggling/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Iraq ordered troops into a militia-controlled area over alleged oil smuggling.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraq-moves-reclaim-jurf-al-sakhr-militias-after-12-years) reported that Iraq deployed tanks and troops ahead of a planned operation to retake Jurf Al-Sakhr from Kataib Hezbollah.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-iraq-establishes-special-security-force-to-combat-oil-smuggling-protect-pipelines/) reported that Iraq established a specialized security force to combat oil smuggling and protect its pipeline network.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iraq-pm-sacks-officials-over-oil-smuggling-in-pro-iran-group-bastion-3011926) reported that the Iraqi Prime Minister dismissed nine officials following an investigation into oil smuggling linked to Kataeb Hezbollah.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/niger-bandits-kill-village-head-wife-worshippers-in-fresh-attacks/) reported that armed men killed a village head, his wife, and several worshippers in separate attacks on two communities in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/horror-in-niger-as-bandits-invade-community-behead-village-head-burn-his-household/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-behead-niger-village-head-kill-five-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that suspected bandits invaded a community in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State, beheading the village head, killing five other residents, and burning houses.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-abduct-six-rustle-livestock-in-sokoto/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that bandits abducted six people and rustled livestock in Dukkuma, Sabon Birni, Sokoto.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bandits-kill-zamfara-govs-aide-abduct-worshippers/) reported that suspected bandits killed Nasiru Sani Kaura during an attack in Kaura Namoda, Zamfara State.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925368-shehu-sani-calls-zamfara-mosque-attack-genocide-decries-public-silence.html) reported that Shehu Sani called the Zamfara mosque attack genocide and expressed outrage over public silence.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/zamfara-mosque-attack-kaura-namoda-party-official/) reported that a dawn raid on a mosque in Kaura Namoda killed a ruling-party registration supervisor and left worshippers abducted.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925372-three-killed-many-abducted-in-sokoto-attack-police.html) reported that the police confirmed three deaths from the attack in Sokoto State, while residents reported four fatalities.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925270-bandits-attack-zamfara-mosque-kill-apc-e-registration-supervisor-abduct-worshippers.html) reported that attackers stormed the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda town, killing an APC e-registration supervisor and abducting worshippers.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/over-40-killed-as-vigilantes-clash-with-bandits-in-zamfara/) reported that over 40 people, including suspected bandits and local vigilantes, were killed in a gun battle in Zamfara.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/over-50-killed-in-clashes-between-bandits-vigilantes-in-nigeria) reported that at least 53 people were killed in clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes in Zamfara state.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-zamfara-report/), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-northern-nigeria-residents-3011866) reported that clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes left more than 50 people dead in northwestern Nigeria's Zamfara state.

reports.text: [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/india-bulgaria-discuss-bilateral-ties-imec-black-sea-situation/article71729472.ece) reported that India and Bulgaria discussed bilateral ties, IMEC, and the Black Sea situation.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/20/4982175_poslednite_dva_udareni_koraba_v_bulgarskata/?ref=rss) reported that the last two ships struck in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea have not yet sunk, according to specialized publication Maritime.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23958440) reported that Bulgarian President Rumen Radev stated the Black Sea must become a zone of shared security, noting its importance as a transport, energy, and digital corridor.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/lpg-tanker-that-sank-off-bulgaria-was-hit-by-projectiles-official/article71715541.ece) reported that an official stated the LPG tanker Gas Husky that sank off Bulgaria was hit by projectiles.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOU1RDM185endranZkZ1d1eF83NmxqSnNad2RzWGlrZU9UazRUaE83TlNpUjZ1SHowbURaWkpUSGJKeWhZQTFUV3c1NnNYSjNPaDlaaFFUaWdMN1BiOEpoMk5pYWtoN3ZhNTlnZzlpWmFpLXMtdDFlaWJFakRURVV4RFIta01EeWtMVDB2MHZEN3ljVWVWdUtEdVFZc3oyREFXMmZEWERUblo1VDg?oc=5) reported that a merchant ship sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast for a second consecutive day.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/19-people-rescued-after-gas-carrier-struck-in-black-sea) reported that 19 people were rescued after a gas carrier was struck in the Black Sea in an incident linked to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/drones-have-hit-15-ships-in-natos-black-sea-waters-since-october/) reported that Russian drones have struck 15 merchant ships in the Black Sea off NATO members Romania and Bulgaria since October 5 according to a tally by The Defence Blog.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90372) reported that the cargo ship BETUL 8 sank in the Black Sea off Bulgaria after an attack by two naval drones, according to a Bulgarian maritime outlet.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009860/lpg-tanker-reported-to-have-sunk-off-bulgaria-s-black-sea-coast/story/) reported that a liquefied petroleum gas tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast a few dozen miles from a previous incident, according to the country's defense ministry.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/17/4980766_gazovoz_potuna_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska_zona_na/?ref=rss) reported that the tanker Gas Husky sank following a drone attack in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/leinster/2026/1117/1599491-vessel-wexford/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/17/six-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-vessel-ran-aground-off-coast-of-wexford/) reported that six crew members were rescued after an 88-metre cargo vessel ran aground off Roney Point on the Wexford coast.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast?traffic_source=rss) reported that all 12 crew members of a cargo ship that capsized off Bulgaria were rescued.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/cargo-ship-sinks-in-bulgarias-black-sea-after-reported-drone-attack-all-12-crew-rescued/) reported that authorities suspected a drone strike caused the vessel to capsize.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/) reported that the ship was carrying 3,000 metric tons of wheat.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/16/4980351_turgovski_korab_potuva_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska/?ref=rss) reported that a merchant ship was sinking in the Bulgarian economic zone in the Black Sea near Kaliakra, according to the Ministry of Transport.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/15/4980175_dronove_udariha_tri_koraba_v_rumunski_vodi_v_cherno/?ref=rss) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial vessels in Romanian waters in the Black Sea near the Sulina canal.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90153) reported that an unidentified drone attacked the Palau-flagged commercial vessel Larissa 1 inside Romanian territorial waters.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90181) reported that Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu condemned the drone attack on three commercial vessels near the Danube Delta.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/three-commercial-vessels-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-pm-says) reported that Romania's Prime Minister called the drone strikes on three commercial vessels near Romania's Black Sea unacceptable and a violation of international law.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009606/3-ships-struck-by-drones-in-black-sea-near-romanian-shipping-canal/story/) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial ships in the Black Sea near Romania's Sulina canal and armed forces scrambled aircraft.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/romanian-pm-condemns-unacceptable-drone-strikes-black-sea-ships/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/three-commercial-ships-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-coast-over-two-days/) reported that Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the strikes on three commercial vessels near Constanța.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/russia-complains-of-new-iron-curtain-as-estonia-shuts-its-borders?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russia complained of a new Iron Curtain after Estonia shut road border crossings following an attack on a drone manufacturer.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/estonia-to-close-all-road-crossings-with-russia) reported that Estonia's government decided to temporarily close its road border crossings with Russia starting December 1 citing national security.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/estonia-to-shut-border-with-russia-over-gru-linked-sabotage-attack) reported that Estonia will close five checkpoints on the border with Russia from 1 December with a possible review in six months after an attempted arson at a defence facility near Tallinn.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-moscow-decries-new-iron-curtain/article71725791.ece) reported that Estonia accused Russian security services of staging an attempted arson attack on an Estonian defense company prior to closing its border.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/narva-mayor-calls-for-humanitarian-corridors-for-emergency-trips-to-russia-as-estonia-prepares-to-close-the-border-december-1) reported that Narva's mayor called for humanitarian corridors for emergency trips to Russia as Estonia prepares to close the border.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915583) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova accused Estonia of planning to erect a new Iron Curtain and stated Moscow would respond.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/estonia/estonia-to-close-all-land-border-crossings-with-russia-epak7xr) reported that Estonia will close all land border crossings with Russia from December 1, citing security threats and Russian-linked sabotage attacks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-estonia-iron-curtain-border-closure-b3088663.html) reported that Moscow accused Estonia of erecting a new Iron Curtain after Tallinn announced plans to close road crossings with Russia.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375264/estonia-close-border-russia-least-6-months-over-foiled-sabotage) reported that Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds from December 1.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222377), a Russian state outlet, reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal noted the government will be able to reassess the situation and decide on further actions regarding the border closure in six months.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185798-moldova-temporarily-closes-six-border-crossing-points-with-ukraine-following-russian-drone-attack.html) reported that Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine following a Russian drone attack.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/estonia-s-president-urges-government-to-weigh-consequences-of-closing-russian-border) reported that Estonian President Ülle Madise urged the government to weigh the consequences of closing the border with Russia and avoid letting emotions drive the decision.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-estonia-closes-its-border-with-russia-but-can-it-keep-moscow-out), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87486196) reported that Estonia will close border crossing points with Russia starting December 1 for national security reasons.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/estonia-to-close-russia-border-after-sabotage-bid-on-drone-maker-foreign-minister-says), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90202) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated the GRU ordered a sabotage attempt at defense company Threod Systems.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063038/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha praised Estonian security services for thwarting the attack.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4184944-eight-people-detained-in-estonia-over-attempted-arson-attack-on-defense-industry-plant-allegedly-commissioned-by-russia.html) reported that the Estonian Prosecutor General's Office stated eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on a Threod defense industry building in Viimsi commissioned by Russia.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218361) reported that Interior Minister Igor Taro stated Estonia will decide on closing its border with Russia next week on a temporary or permanent basis.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-accuses-russia-of-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia after Tallinn's Internal Security Service stated an attempted arson attack on a defense firm was commissioned by Russia's GRU military intelligence agency.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90184) reported that Estonian security authorities thwarted an attempted explosion and arson attack against drone manufacturer Threod Systems and detained suspects.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218363), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of December 1.

[Le Figaro](https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/actu-tele/nous-avons-reellement-craint-pour-nos-vies-l-une-des-journalistes-de-bfmtv-agressee-a-lyon-brise-le-silence-20261115) reported that a BFMTV journalist stated that their team feared for their lives during the violent assault by individuals in Lyon.

reports.text: [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/3358955/ties-with-myanmar-stay-despite-icj-ruling-pm) reported that Thailand's Prime Minister stated relations with Myanmar will be maintained despite the ICJ ruling.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915642) reported that France stated it would seek UN Security Council action after Myanmar refused to accept an ICJ ruling finding that its military committed atrocities against the Rohingya.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/azhar-welcomes-historic-international-court-of-justice-ruling-on-genocide-against-rohingya-muslims/) reported that Al-Azhar welcomed the historic International Court of Justice ruling regarding Myanmar's genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/suljagic-nakon-presude-mijanmaru-sud-u-hagu-ne-bi-dosudio-u-korist-bih-ni-da-su-nas-sve-pobili/261121059) reported that Srebrenica Memorial Center Director Emir Suljagic stated the International Court of Justice would not have ruled in favor of Bosnia and Herzegovina against Serbia.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sta-bi-icj-danas-odlucio-o-genocidu-i-predmetu-bi-h-protiv-srbije/), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/slucaj-mijanmar-otvorio-pitanje-drukcijeg-ishoda-tuzbe-bih-protiv-srbije-mozda-bi-genocid-bio-utvrden-i-u-prijedoru/261121040) reported that the International Court of Justice ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya raised questions about a different potential outcome in Bosnia's lawsuit against Serbia.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/rohingya-who-escaped-myanmars-genocide-tell-their-stories) reported that Rohingya survivors who escaped Myanmar's genocide recounted rivers red with blood and burning nearby villages.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/analysis-myanmar-genocide-judgment-may-bolster-gaza-case-against-israel) reported that the International Court of Justice's ruling that Myanmar committed genocide may bolster the Gaza case against Israel.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/asia-and-australia/2026-11-20/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-icj-has-found-a-country-guilty-of-genocide-israel-should-be-worried/000001a1-f85f-d5b4-a3bd-f97f72a30000) reported that the International Court of Justice has found a state responsible for genocide for the first time in history, worsening Israel's legal standing.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly58ndgd0no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the BBC's international editor wrote that the Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/myanmar-rohingya-genocide-un-icj-6568711), [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168853) reported that UN General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman told Rohingya refugees that a judgment on paper must be given effect.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/what-does-the-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-mean-for-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ICJ Rohingya genocide case sets a precedent for establishing a state's intent to commit genocide beyond explicitly written orders.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a9cd79db6b18) reported that Dhaka stated Rohingyas must be able to return safely and demanded reparations from Myanmar.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-genocide-ruling-rohingya-say-struggle-for-justice-not-over/a-80003365?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the ICJ held Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya and ordered restitution and reparations.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/turkiye-welcomes-landmark-icj-ruling-on-myanmars-rohingya-genocide/news), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkiye-welcomes-icj-ruling-holding-myanmar-responsible-for-genocide-3725800) reported that Türkiye's Foreign Ministry welcomed the ICJ ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQLTNLWmdYdncxbDRfcFZhVlRFeVRfN3Jic2JSb252SkQ4djE0ckRoaGpqcnZKWDU5Wm4tUXdjTHdPZVNtWkVRWVNSN29EcFNQQkhVeVF6WWQ5NFB2WUFURVFyWjI3dmRGeEJNSDJrMk1HYTdMMXVTMkZqZl9ZVjlJMVlhSWRTR0Nha0NJZ3J0TVBpVndia25nVXNDZi1GcnVxYTFtdklydElZQy1FMHo5TGhJcUpjcG5rWDZJaQ?oc=5) reported that rights groups urged sanctions after the top UN court found Myanmar committed genocide.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/83475e748a6f) reported that Israeli legal scholars stated the International Court of Justice's approach to assessing genocidal intent in the Rohingya ruling could influence proceedings concerning Israel's war in Gaza.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200105.html) reported that a rights group called for a criminal probe into South Africa's arms sales to Myanmar between 2017 and 2021 following the International Court of Justice ruling.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641224/inside-icjs-historic-rohingya-genocide-ruling-against-myanmar) reported that the UN court ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/20/asia-pacific/politics/rohingya-crisis-icj-myanmar/) reported that more than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced across South and Southeast Asia, including 1.2 million in refugee camps in Bangladesh.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641226/un-officials-world-leaders-welcome-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-against-myanmar) reported that world leaders and UN officials welcomed the ruling.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/19/g-s1-154340/un-court-myanmar-genocide-rohingya) reported that the International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces acted with genocidal intent during 2017 military operations.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/myanmar-genocide-case-rohingya-international-court-justice-icj-un-6564571) reported that the seven-year case centers on a 2017 military crackdown in Rakhine state that drove over 700,000 Rohingya into Bangladesh.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/que-podria-pasar-tras-el-fallo-de-la-corte-sobre-las-cuotas-de-las-prepagas-y-como-reacciono-el-nid19112026/) reported that healthcare entities expressed concern and stated their prices remain delayed following a Supreme Court ruling on prepaid healthcare quotas impacting a specific case.

[The Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/terror-and-security/myanmars-junta-guilty-of-genocide-says-worlds-highest-court/) reported that the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar's junta forces violently killed 10,000 members of the Rohingya Muslim minority, committing genocide.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-committed-genocide-against-rohingya-top-un-court-rules/a-79987898?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the International Court of Justice upheld large parts of a genocide case against Myanmar linked to the 2017 conflict with its Rohingya minority.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/un-court-set-rule-if-myanmar-committed-genocide-rohingya) reported that Gambia launched the proceedings at the International Court of Justice in 2019.

[Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/varlden/historisk-dom-myanmar-begick-folkmord-mot-rohingyer/) reported that the ICJ in The Hague ruled on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against its Muslim minority.
[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/Pv9mjp/myanmar-begikk-folkemord?utm_medium=rss) reported that around 10,000 civilians were killed and the UN's highest court demands safe return and compensation.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijska-presuda-u-Hagu-Mjanmar-pocinio-genocid/993249) reported that the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya Muslim minority during military operations.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5m2l90ez144o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that no state has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court prior to the verdict.

[IPS Latin America](https://www.ipsnews.net/2026/11/genocide-ruling-against-myanmar-sparks-rohingya-celebrations/) reported that cheers and celebrations erupted in refugee camps across the border from Myanmar following the ruling.

[Sabah](https://www.sabah.com.tr/dunya/uluslararasi-adalet-divanindan-bir-ilk-arakanli-muslumanlara-yonelik-katliam-tescillendi-7705188) reported that the court confirmed the Myanmar army massacred thousands of Rohingya Muslims, committed sexual assault, and burned villages.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/sud-u-hagu-prvi-put-u-historiji-presudio-da-je-drzava-kriva-za-genocid-mijanmar-odgovoran-za-stravicne-zlocine/261119146), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/donesena-presuda-u-hagu-mijanmar-kriv-za-genocid-nad-muslimanima-rohinjama/) reported that the UN court in The Hague ruled with nine votes that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims in northern Rakhine state.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261119-myanmar-guilty-of-genocide-against-rohingya-says-top-un-court) reported that the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority and ordered that refugees be given protection.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/myanmar-guilty-of-genocide-against-rohingya-un-court-rules) reported that the court ruled by nine votes to six.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/19/world/myanmar-icj-ruling-genocide/myanmar-icj-genocide-case-rohingya-refugees) reported that Rohingya refugees far from The Hague know nothing of a genocide trial.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/icj-verdict-on-rohingya-crackdown-killings-in-myanmar/article71719604.ece) reported that the UN World Court found Myanmar forces killed and raped thousands of Rohingya, committed violence against children, and destroyed settlements.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/international-court-of-justice-to-deliver-landmark-judgment-in-myanmar-rohingya-genocide-case-101795068955617.html) reported that the judgment from the International Court of Justice comes seven years after Gambia filed the case against Myanmar.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/icj-to-rule-on-rohingya-genocide-case-against-myanmar?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ICJ is set to rule on the Rohingya genocide case brought by The Gambia against Myanmar.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5m2l90ez144o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOUGtSVDRwdUtMc3lyTmxTN1FCam5Fai1UaTdDZ1E3YXM4M3lfZk5yQXduaF9Uc3VjSVJuSzRwOG0wVFY0LURKWnVlR1gtNWZHaHlWaXBmazZlVzh4TGZHb0VfM3NTSHFZS29QMTlZV3Y3dm1GVmJzcHRQaW5yaTJacmV0ZnQ2Z0JrYWxIT3l4UUdTSDlDTnlLaTNERlF0NVF2U3lHR29tdWdabGc?oc=5) reported that the top UN court is set to rule on the alleged genocide of Myanmar's Rohingya.

reports.text: [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461932/) reported that the director of the Ministry of Migration and Displaced branch in Anbar Governorate stated that 1430 displaced families from Jurf al-Sakhor are currently residing in informal settlements in the Bzeebiz camp.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203816/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1/), [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461886/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces announced the establishment of a controlling headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhor north of Babylon province, subordinate to the Federal Police forces command.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461856/) reported that energy police commenced procedures to secure oil pipeline bundles in the Jurf al-Nasr area. [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203815/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zeidi asked security forces entering Jurf al-Sakhor to exercise self-restraint.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kataib-hezbollah-faces-deadline-to-leave-iraqi-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kataib Hezbollah faces a deadline to leave an Iraqi stronghold.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461787/), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203784/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities opened a controlling headquarters in the Jurf al-Sakhr area north of Babylon province.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461830/) reported that security forces began implementing a plan to reorganize the security file in Jurf al-Sakhr.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461835/) reported that energy police commenced duties to secure the oil pipeline in Jurf al-Nasr.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203610/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B6%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities initiated security procedures to reorganize military deployment in Jurf al-Sakhr north of Babylon province, with the Popular Mobilization Forces starting a troop rotation process.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iraq-s-risky-standoff-the-state-vs-iran-allied-militias/a-79995757?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia in what onlookers described as a dangerous confrontation.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461820/) reported that a spokesperson for Kataib Hezbollah confirmed the group's refusal to surrender its weapons or leave the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461813/) reported that Iraq's Ministry of Interior announced the participation of its security formations in redeployment arrangements in the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190634/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine held the Israeli occupation government directly and fully responsible for the ongoing humanitarian catastrophe in the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203866/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Hamas called on the Peace Council to stop overlooking Israeli violations and hold Israel responsible for obstructing the Gaza ceasefire agreement.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188394) reported that Jens Laerke, spokesperson for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, stated that humanitarian convoy trips and distribution in the Gaza Strip face numerous procedures.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190549/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that the Gaza Strip Union of Municipalities, the Engineers Syndicate, and the Ministry of Public Works and Housing called for opening crossings, breaking the siege, and allowing humanitarian aid.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190531/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%B6%D9%84%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%81%D8%B1-%D8%BA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%B9) reported that Hamas accused the Peace Council's report to the UN Security Council of distorting facts and providing cover for continued aggression.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203178/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Canada, Britain, Italy, and Australia called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into Gaza.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/19/politica/004n2pol?partner=rss) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved the creation of the General Law on Animal Welfare, Care, and Protection.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/congreso-aprueba-historica-ley-de-bienestar-animal/) reported that Congress approved an animal protection law to regulate animal welfare and homogenize concepts of welfare, mistreatment, and cruelty nationwide.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-sanciones-y-medidas-de-proteccion-implica-esta-iniciativa/) reported that the animal welfare regulation represents an important tool in advancing fauna protection.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/proponen-inmobiliarias-ley-de-rentas-justas-solo-para-rentas-menores-a-15-mil-pesos-33183439) reported that ADI and Canadevi proposed that rents below 15,000 pesos cannot rise above inflation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-iniactiva-privada-propone-diferenciar-aumentos-en-arrendamientos-buscan-proteger-a-las-familias-aseguran/) reported that business organizations suggested rents higher than 15,000 pesos be adjusted with each change of tenant or every three years.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/16/capital/035n2cap?partner=rss) reported that Morena in the Mexico City Congress will correct the fair rent initiative sent by the head of government to maintain certain rights.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/reconoce-morena-retrocesos-en-ley-de-rentas-justas-proponen-cambios-33149913), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/grupo-parlamentario-de-morena-realizara-ajustes-a-la-ley-de-rentas-justas-buscan-proteger-a-las-y-los-inquilinos-cumplidos/) reported that Morena's parliamentary group acknowledged retrogressive measures in the Fair Rent Law initiative and proposed changes to protect compliant tenants and preserve their right to extend contracts for a year.

reports.text: [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649190-lugansk-strike-civilians-dead/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that local authorities stated a Ukrainian strike killed six civilians on the outskirts of Lugansk.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-russian-national-guard-facility-in-krasnodar/) reported that Ukrainian drones reportedly struck a Russian National Guard facility in Krasnodar.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/ukrainian-drones-target-smolensk-region-fertilizer-plant-a94325) reported that Ukrainian drones targeted the Dorogobuzh chemical plant in the Smolensk region, a facility accounting for about 11% of Russia's ammonium nitrate production.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186683-drones-attack-chemical-plant-producing-components-for-explosives-in-russias-smolensk-region-media.html) reported that drones attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant producing explosive components in Russia's Smolensk region.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2222287) reported that air defenses shot down 32 drones over the Smolensk region and damage occurred to an energy facility.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-russian-chemical-plant/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/ukrainian-drones-hit-russian-fertilizer-plant-that-also-makes-components-for-explosives) reported that Ukrainian drones struck a chemical plant in Dorogobuzh in Russia's Smolensk region.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222021), a Russian state outlet, reported that the number of people injured in a Ukrainian attack on Kursk rose to 13 after three individuals were hospitalized with moderate injuries.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/19/damaged-buildings-and-debris-after-ukrainian-attack-on-russias-kursk) reported that at least 11 people were injured after a Ukrainian attack damaged residential buildings and public facilities in Kursk.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPUXY4SS1DQy01LTV4VDEwYTVCV2hCeThSemNINHhHNFk2Zk1ZNGpIWVk1MFlyMUJwWGFlS1otZGRYSHpYYUlqQlZOMjRrQURxU29GNlhkTmJVU1l3VE1TTkR1dWhCM2dJT2QyUnRkR0dlRVE5eHhiUHBVSUVaa0ppOFJDb0I1M081eHhNQUd4WXhlWnJ6d0RYTVhWamRONXVFZmpjVGFuYmtTeG5FYXVkcXRFaVY1RnhobzYzZjNB?oc=5) reported that local authorities said Russia repelled a Ukrainian drone attack on an oil facility in the Tatarstan region.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649093-ukraine-kursk-drone-attack/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that 11 people, including a child, have been injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Kursk.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/19/kursk-daytime-ukrainian-attack-injures-11-in-kursk-a94309), [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221505) reported that a daytime Ukrainian drone attack in Kursk injured 11 people, including a 12-year-old child.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2221325) reported that Kursk regional governor stated eleven people including a child were injured in a Ukrainian attack.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drone-attack-on-russia-s-kursk-injures-11-people) reported that Kursk Governor Alexander Khinshtein stated a Ukrainian drone attack on Kursk injured 11 people.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-target-oil-hub-in-russias-tatarstan/), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063575/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90575), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drones-attack-oil-storage-tanks-in-russia-s-tatarstan), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186277-drone-attack-reported-on-kaleykino-oil-pumping-station-in-russias-tatarstan.html) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station and oil storage tanks in Russia's Tatarstan Republic.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-strikes-cut-russian-oil-refinery-processing-by-45-reuters-reports/) reported that Ukrainian attacks over the past 20 days disrupted or stopped operations at 15 of Russia's 35 major refineries.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drone-attacks-have-cut-the-amount-of-oil-russia-refines-by-45-since-late-october-reuters-reports) reported that according to two industry sources, Ukrainian drone attacks have cut the amount of oil Russian refineries process by 45% since late October.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062991/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184999-ukraine-disables-over-55-of-russias-oil-refining-capacity-zelensky.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that long-range strikes have halted or disabled more than 55 percent of Russia's oil refining capacity.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648864-six-injured-ukrainian-drone-attack-russia-tatarstan/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that local authorities stated six people were injured in a Ukrainian drone raid on Nizhnekamsk in Russia's Tatarstan.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drone-attacks-neutralized-55-of-russias-oil-refining-capacity-zelensky-says/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky cited a report by Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi stating that Ukrainian drone attacks have neutralized more than 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity.
