reports.text: [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

[The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.
[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-to-announce-first-ever-return-hub-for-migrants-in-rwanda), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261116-eu-nations-to-unveil-rwanda-deal-for-migrant-return-hub) reported that Denmark, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece are set to announce a deal to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seeker-deportation-eu-scheme-b3085455.html) reported that two lawmakers were shown facilities earmarked for Britain's abandoned Rwanda scheme.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187081-russian-forces-strike-civilian-and-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region-two-people-injured.html) reported that Russian attacks on the Zhytomyr region injured two people and damaged civilian and energy infrastructure.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187056-russian-attacks-in-sumy-region-leaves-three-injured-over-past-day.html) reported that Russian attacks in the Sumy region injured three civilians over the past 24 hours.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187053-russian-forces-attack-dnipropetrovsk-region-nearly-10-times-since-evening-two-killed-55-injured.html) reported that Russian forces attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles, resulting in two deaths and 55 injuries.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063889/) reported that Russian forces targeted a civilian business in Rivne Oblast, injuring one person.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063895/) reported that a Russian strike on the Sarny district disrupted electricity supply to around 50 settlements in Rivne Oblast.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186323-russian-forces-attack-industrial-facility-in-mykolaiv-region-one-injured.html) reported that a Russian attack on an industrial facility in Voznesensk in the Mykolaiv region injured one person and damaged a warehouse.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185876-more-than-80-settlements-without-electricity-in-rivne-region-following-russian-attack.html) reported that more than 80 settlements in Ukraine's Rivne region were left without electricity following a Russian attack.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185878-russian-forces-attack-industrial-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region.html) reported that Russian forces launched an overnight strike on industrial infrastructure in the Zhytomyr community.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063399/) reported that Russian attacks on November 17-18 caused power cuts in Rivne Oblast and a fire at an industrial facility in Zhytomyr Oblast.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4185915-russian-attacks-cause-new-power-outages-in-eight-ukrainian-regions.html) reported that Russian attacks caused new power outages in eight Ukrainian regions as of Wednesday.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185482-russian-strike-cuts-power-to-more-than-300-settlements-in-rivne-region.html) reported that a Russian strike cut power to more than 300 settlements in the Rivne region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063253/) reported that Russian attacks on November 17 caused power outages across nine Ukrainian oblasts with emergency cuts imposed in three others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185477-emergency-power-outages-affect-four-regions-following-russian-attacks.html) reported that emergency power outages were introduced in the Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, and Kharkiv regions due to equipment damage and voltage drops.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185289-dnipro-left-completely-without-power-after-russian-attack.html) reported that an attack on energy facilities in the region left the city of Dnipro completely without electricity.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062963/) reported that Russian strikes damaged grid equipment, cutting power in parts of Dnipro and Kamianske.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185015-russian-attacks-hit-energy-facilities-in-cherkasy-region-causing-power-outages.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063031/) reported that Russian attacks hit energy facilities in the Cherkasy region, disrupting electricity supplies.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063051/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185106-russian-forces-strike-energy-facilities-in-odesa-region-leaving-thousands-without-power.html) reported that Russian shelling targeted an energy facility in northern Odesa Oblast, leaving 52,200 households without power.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186809-general-staff-confirms-three-oil-tanks-hit-at-pumping-station-in-russias-tatarstan.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-strikes-key-druzhba-oil-pipeline-station-in-russias-tatarstan-general-staff-confirms/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff confirmed Ukrainian defense forces struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk in Russia's Republic of Tatarstan, hitting three oil tanks on the Druzhba pipeline more than 1,000 kilometers from the front line.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063746/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186678-two-killed-four-injured-in-russian-attack-on-railway-station-in-lviv.html) reported that two people were killed and at least four others were injured in a Russian attack on a railway station in Lviv.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063598/) reported that a Russian strike hit an apartment building in Izium, injuring 14 people including children.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063495/) reported that a Russian attack damaged the Museum of Modern Art in Odesa.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/four-killed-as-russian-strikes-hit-ukraines-odesa?traffic_source=rss) reported that at least four people were killed and thirteen injured after Russian strikes hit Ukraine's port city of Odesa.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186044-general-staff-confirms-strikes-on-ilsky-and-afipsky-oil-refineries.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces attacked and hit the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90455) reported that Ukraine struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory for the second time this month.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-strike-two-oil-refineries-in-southern-russia), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185869-drones-attack-afipsky-and-ilsky-oil-refineries-in-russia-media-reports.html), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583328/ukrainian-drone-strikes-spark-fires-at-two-russian-oil-refineries/) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar region, sparking fires and injuring four people in the Seversky district.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-target-krasnodar-region-refineries-a94294) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted 183 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions overnight.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-kyiv-targets-krasnodar-refineries-after-felling-kerch-bridge/live-79976877?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian strikes targeted two industrial facilities overnight in Krasnodar following action against the Kerch bridge.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/why-ukraine-keeps-targeting-the-kerch-bridge/article71714957.ece) reported that Ukraine has targeted the Kerch Bridge multiple times, most recently on November 17, 2026.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90463), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063406/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-strikes-central-odesa-kills-3-injures-7/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a residential building in central Odesa killed three people and injured seven others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185794-part-of-kyivs-livoberezhnyi-district-to-temporarily-lose-heating.html) reported that buildings in Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi residential district will temporarily lose heating due to repair work.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-crimea-bridge-trump-putin-zelensky-b3086877.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/2-russian-oil-refineries-reportedly-targeted-in-overnight-drone-attack-on-krasnodar-krai/) reported that two Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai were targeted in overnight drone attacks.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063375/) reported that explosions and air defense responses occurred near the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063333/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185762-russian-strike-on-central-vinnytsia-injures-four.html) reported that four people were injured in a Russian attack on central Vinnytsia on Tuesday evening.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185409-317-buildings-in-kyivs-darnytskyi-district-left-without-heating-after-russian-attack.html) reported that 317 residential buildings in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district were left without heating after a Russian attack.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90385) reported that Kyiv switched consumers in the Darnytskyi, Obolonskyi, and Podilskyi districts to backup heating after strikes damaged heating mains.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063233/) reported that seven people were injured in Russian strikes on a confectionery factory and a residential area in Dnipro.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063226/) reported that a combined Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's industrial and energy infrastructure left two people dead and 18 injured.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185451-russian-attack-on-kyiv-kills-two-injures-one.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90324), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063228/) reported that a Russian attack on Kyiv's Obolonskyi district killed two people and injured another, damaging residential and non-residential buildings.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185465-russian-drone-strikes-parking-lot-in-vinnytsia-killing-one-woman-and-injuring-another.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063235/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a car park in Vinnytsia killed one woman and injured another.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063182/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185381-car-driver-killed-in-drone-attack-on-zaporizhzhia.html) reported that a driver was killed when an FPV drone hit a car in Zaporizhzhia during a Russian evening attack.
[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185324-russian-forces-attack-zaporizhzhia-woman-injured.html) reported that a woman was injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90301) reported that Ukrainian rescuers freed a 51-year-old woman trapped beneath rubble after a Russian strike on an industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063085/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185147-russian-forces-strike-balakliia-in-kharkiv-region-killing-one-injuring-four.html) reported that a Russian strike on central Balakliia in Kharkiv Oblast killed one person, injured four others, and damaged a postal facility.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063149/) reported that Russian attacks on Dnipro have killed two people and injured eight others, causing the sixth blackout in two weeks and leaving almost half of the city without power.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/knesset-set-to-elect-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-new-speaker/000001a1-e5dc-d381-ade5-effd223b0000) reported that Religious Zionism offered to back Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker if he pledged not to appoint deputies from parties that do not define Hamas as a terror group, a demand Kahana rejected.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/lieberman-elected-chair-of-knesset-defense-panel-vows-to-summon-security-chiefs/000001a1-e387-da8e-abfd-e7978f200000) reported that Lieberman was elected chair of the Knesset defense panel and vowed to summon all security chiefs.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915057) reported that Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich sent a letter offering Knesset speaker support in exchange for the exclusion of Arabs.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/ahmed-tibi-appointed-as-deputy-speaker-of-israels-knesset?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ahmed-tibi-elected-deputy-speaker-of-israel-s-knesset-avigdor-lieberman-named-parliament-chairman-101794820638761.html) reported that Ahmed Tibi was appointed deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset and Avigdor Lieberman was named parliament chairman.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203838/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D8%B2%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%AA-%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A/) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the Nvidia issue was not raised in talks between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461904/) reported that US President Donald Trump announced his intention to ban American tech companies from establishing specialized artificial intelligence data centers outside the United States.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%b1%d9%82%d8%a7%d8%a6%d9%82-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b0%d9%83%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b5%d8%b7%d9%86%d8%a7%d8%b9%d9%8a-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d9%81%d8%b9-%d8%b5%d8%a7%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d9%83%d9%88) reported that South Korea's annual exports surpassed one trillion US dollars on Thursday due to the AI chip boom.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203703/%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B7%D9%84-%D8%A3%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%85%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9/) Asharq News reported that the European Commission suffered a cyberattack utilizing artificial intelligence tools.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186596-zelensky-meets-with-witkoff-kushner-and-european-national-security-advisers.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with U.S. presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, along with European national security advisers.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/los-aliados-de-ucrania-se-reunen-en-berlin-francia-propone-reabrir-la-union-de-kiev-a-la-otan-y-alemania-pide-la-paz-en-europa-3602434) El Tiempo reported that following the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin, French President Emmanuel Macron opened the debate on NATO accession for Kyiv while Friedrich Merz rejected a Yalta 2.0 peace.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/merz-rechaza-paz-negociada-trump-putin-ucrania-europa_202611196aff481121e74551e81f9358.html) La Razón reported that Friedrich Merz rejected any peace negotiated by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping without Ukraine and Europe.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186503-zelensky-outlines-key-topics-for-coalition-of-the-willing-meeting-in-berlin.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky outlined covering budget needs as a key topic for the meeting.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/wadephul-coalition-of-the-willing-talks-in-berlin-send-strong-signal-to-moscow/a-79990664?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German Foreign Minister Wadephul stated the talks send a strong signal to Moscow.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/zelensky-lands-in-berlin-for-key-summit-with-ukraines-allied-partners/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Berlin for a summit of allied nations.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063612/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing talks.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1119/1599769-coalition-of-willing-berlin-meeting/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin joined other European leaders for a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/19/taoiseach-in-berlin-for-ukraine-talks-as-triple-lock-row-rumbles-on/) reported that Micheál Martin joined Coalition of the Willing leaders in Berlin while Fianna Fáil rebels proposed Defence Bill amendments at home.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/zelenskyy-says-he-expects-debrief-from-us-envoys-on-trumps-talks-with-xi-and-putin) reported that US envoys told Kyiv they would give a debrief on Donald Trump's talks in China during meetings in Berlin.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-s-allies-gather-in-berlin-for-coalition-of-the-willing-summit/live-79986520?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's European backers are convening in Berlin for a 'Coalition of the Willing' summit with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner attending.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/european-allies-say-more-support-crucial-for-ukraine-to-withstand-long-winter/) reported that a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin pledged continued aid to Ukraine as Trump and Putin sat down in Shenzhen.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNWHBhRURfZmJHUzhfMW53YjcxYUNlVE1rbFZtTmV2S2Jfcm5hYXFweEJaQlZHbmE0U2Q5Y2IzM29LUExzUUx0UlIyVTNMamhzT3NPS25rbmp3bzZuZDhId1B4YzZXYWZXRkU0clRpUm9scVV5ZXRvMnBSTUlTZlVtTDJlSnFlREg3YTZpM0xVOXl2cV9xaWZpcnF2M01zdw?oc=5), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261119-european-leaders-to-meet-in-berlin-to-support-for-ukraine-after-trump-putin-xi-talks) reported that Ukraine's European allies met in Berlin to rally support for Kyiv following the trilateral talks in China.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/eu-plans-a-new-45bn-loan-to-ukraine-how-much-will-it-cost-and-will-it-be-repaid) reported that the European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro support loan to Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063472/) reported that French officials outlined post-war security guarantees and reviewed an 11-nation military deployment ahead of the Berlin summit.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186174-witkoff-kushner-to-attend-coalition-of-the-willing-summit-in-berlin.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90536) reported that US President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will attend the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/witkoff-kushner-participaran-cumbre-berlin-reunion-trump-putin_202611186afe094da6f8072789ee1638.html) reported that White House emissaries will inform Ukrainian and European allies about conversations in China.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063511/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv will coordinate next steps in negotiations with Russia alongside European leaders and receive briefings from US delegates.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220767), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet with Ukrainian and European delegates in Berlin on November 19 to discuss multilateral talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063498/) reported that Donald Trump's special envoys are scheduled to discuss post-war security guarantees, economic rebuilding, and multilateral negotiations with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649038-european-commission-new-loan-kiev/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state media outlet, reported that the European Commission formally presented a plan to borrow 45 billion euros guaranteed by the bloc's budget to fund Kyiv.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063467/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen expressed confidence that Hungary, Slovakia, Bulgaria, and Czechia will join the new Ukraine loan.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063467/) reported that the European Commission hopes to secure unanimous support at the 26-27 November summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, and Bulgaria stated they do not intend to take part in the bloc's latest round of funding for Kyiv.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261118-eu-proposes-new-%E2%82%AC45-billion-ukraine-loan-to-be-repaid-by-russia), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-proposes-45bn-loan-to-ukraine-backed-by-joint-debt) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed a €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/18/europe-ukraine-russia-eu-germany-serbia-latest-news-updates) reported that EU leaders will vote on the measure in two weeks and that the commission president stated Ukraine has a €70 billion funding gap for next year.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063426/) reported that the €45 billion loan is split between €25 billion for military aid and €20 billion in reform-linked funds.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185725-axios-witkoff-kushner-to-meet-ukrainian-eu-officials-to-discuss-peace-plan.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials to discuss a peace plan.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-announces-berlin-talks-with-us-european-allies-to-shape-next-phase-of-russia-negotiations/) reported that a Ukrainian official stated the meeting in Berlin could take place on November 19.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063195/), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219295) reported that US Special Presidential Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin on November 19 to discuss security guarantees and economic recovery plans.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/eu-disburses-1-7-billion-euros-for-ukraines-military-needs/), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/european-commission-disburses-e1-71-billion-to-ukraine-for-military-equipment/) reported that the European Commission disbursed 1.71 billion euros to Ukraine for military needs including drones, ammunition, and air defenses.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/telcel-asegura-que-servicio-se-recupera-paulatinamente-sufrio-degradacion-en-localidades-de-la-region-9-informa/) reported that Telcel stated its network service is recovering gradually following user complaints about service failures.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045368/apple-works-to-restore-services-after-outage-caused-by-internal-update) reported that Apple stated it was working to restore its systems after an internal update caused an outage affecting customer services including iCloud and Apple.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/apple-outage-hits-app-store-becoming-the-latest-casualty-of-major-cyber-breakdowns) reported that an Apple update malfunction caused an outage hitting the App Store following recent major disruptions affecting the Federal Aviation Administration and United Airlines.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/apple-services-face-massive-outage-as-users-report-icloud-login-app-store-problems/) reported that Apple users across multiple countries faced widespread technical problems affecting services including iCloud login and the App Store.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/apple-sufre-una-interrupcion-en-algunos-de-sus-servicios-y-problemas-de-acceso-a-icloud-esto-se-sabe-3601729) reported that DownDetector registered more than 2,300 incident reports regarding Apple services.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/chase-jp-morgan-bank-america-among-multiple-banks-facing-outages/), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-bank-outages-hit-chase-bank-of-america-and-wells-fargo-disrupting-online-services-and-payments-101794920280599.html) reported that multiple U.S. banks including Bank of America and Wells Fargo faced online service and payment outages alongside Chase.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/business-news/925767-customers-affected-as-jpmorgan-chase-united-airlines-others-report-widespread-outages.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed transaction disruptions to a software bug affecting on-premises hardware systems, ruling out cyberattack evidence.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/us-bank-outage-what-caused-chase-problems-and-zelle-payment-delays?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Chase software bug disrupted U.S. banking transactions and delayed some Zelle payments.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jpmorgan-resolves-technical-issue-after-online-services-of-several-us-banks-hit-101794883910821.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase resolved a technical issue that caused customer transactions to take longer to process.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641331/iran-rejects-trumps-bioweapons-claims-warns-against-repeat-of-disproved-allegations), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/4002c3287429) reported that Iran rejected US bioweapons claims and warned against repeating allegations similar to those made prior to the 2003 Iraq invasion.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915545) reported that Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman asked whether the world had learned from 2003 or was about to let them deceive the public on a grand scale all over again.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220799), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Markwayne Mullin stated during House of Representatives committee hearings that the US sees no threat of a dirty bomb attack by Iran.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326096/Iran-Embassy-in-Athens-rejects-allegations-against-Tehran-as), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249528/Iranian-embassy-in-Athens-denies-terror-plot-allegations) reported that Iran's Embassy in Greece categorically rejected allegations regarding an alleged terrorist operation as entirely baseless Israeli propaganda.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915256) reported that Rubio condemned intelligence leaks regarding the matter.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/iran-denies-dirty-bomb-plan_n_6afc87a1e4b0e902c23afc30) reported that an Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson denied allegations regarding a potential plan to detonate a dirty bomb in Washington, calling them baseless.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249497/Israeli-lobbyists-repackaging-Iraq-war-lies-to-target-Iran), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219943), a state outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi refuted allegations about Iran's plans to use chemical weapons in the United States, calling the reports rubbish and Iraq War-style propaganda.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/southeast-asia/trump-philippines-china-visit-live-updates-b3086099.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-issues-stark-warning-to-iran-over-alleged-dc-dirty-bomb-plot-we-take-it-very-seriously-101794920834305.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/iran-will-pay-a-price-if-dirty-bomb-is-detonated-in-us/) reported that US President Donald Trump warned Iran it would pay an unprecedented price if a dirty bomb is detonated in Washington, DC.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-iran-rejects-reports-of-chemical-weapons-plot-in-washington/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf denied reports that Tehran was plotting to use chemical weapons in Washington, DC.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq808vzd3nnpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-trump-says-us-taking-possible-iranian-plot-targeting-washington-very-seriously/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated Washington is taking potential Iranian threats against Washington very seriously while Tehran rejected the claims as baseless.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQc2ZYTGtvM0g3WWZBNzJJcEd5bElCMm4zUXR5NUczWnNQZWdEMGZWNklWaFQ1cWdjYlNVM0otemo1bjBXVmdENUNaUWVQeThvXzN2Zi1hekFzVG5ic2tvY256UjRZU1o3VFBGV2p3eFJqZTlvRHBReHo3MUFEZ1NqYmpGWnR2Xzg0bGJIQQ?oc=5), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532258/Iran-strikes-US-radar-system-in-Bahrain-as-Iran-downs-more-drones) reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps stated it fired drones and struck a US radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iran-dismisses-report-of-alleged-dirty-bomb-attack-on-washington/a-79970741?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iran stated CNN's claim about a dirty bomb attack on Washington was an attempt to manufacture legitimacy to continue the war.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-trump-says-he-takes-possible-iran-bomb-threat-to-washington-very-seriously) reported that US President Donald Trump stated US authorities take any possible threats to Washington very seriously.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203448/%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%82-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%82%D9%86%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B0%D8%B1%D8%A9/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is verifying reports regarding a potential Iranian plot to carry out an attack on Washington using a dirty bomb.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640780/us-intelligence-warns-of-iranian-dirty-bomb-or-chemical-attack-plot-targeting-trump-officials-cnn), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/exclusive-us-intel-indicates-iran-developing-plans-to-potentially-detonate-a-dirty-bomb-in-washington-sources-say/) reported that US intelligence sources indicated Iran is developing plans to target senior Trump administration officials with a dirty bomb or chemical weapon.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-17/ty-article/iran-developing-plans-for-dirty-bomb-or-chemical-attack-in-d-c-report-says/000001a1-e8c8-d848-abeb-fac893430000) reported that according to CNN, US officials stated there was no evidence Tehran had decided to carry out an attack.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iran-allegedly-plotting-to-target-trump-officials-in-washington-with-dirty-bomb/QMOGIIJGTJGGVCEOCJGKH4PW2E/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/iran-developing-plans-for-possible-dirty-bomb-attack-in-washington-says-us-intelligence/) reported that United States intelligence agencies uncovered information that Iran is developing plans to potentially attack senior Trump administration officials in Washington with a dirty bomb.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-says-iran-explored-dirty-bomb-chemical-attack-scenarios-targeting-trump-officials-report-101794873460122.html) reported that new US intelligence prompted contingency planning in Washington, though the White House stated there are currently no credible threats to the US homeland.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915109) reported that sources familiar with the intelligence described the planning to CNN as an effort to give Iran additional options rather than evidence of an imminent attack.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/documentos-filtrados-revelan-como-deutsche-bank-dio-la-espalda-a-sus-promesas-climaticas/) reported that leaked documents revealed Deutsche Bank turned its back on climate promises regarding emissions reduction.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/epstein-and-deutsche-bank-the-filings-identfied-payments-made-to-women-a-e8f529f6-c583-4c99-a432-d0684c6697d7#ref=rss) reported that documents from Deutsche Bank show the financial institution processed many more payments for Jeffrey Epstein than previously known.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88667080) reported that Deutsche Bank is at the center of a scandal following an investigation based on millions of internal documents leaked to the press involving Russian oligarchs, Epstein, and Trump.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-bank-and-the-oligarchs-how-deutsche-bank-continued-expanding-in-russia-despite-the-warning-signs-a-668c08a5-0383-4d66-86b5-671b3c348774#ref=rss) reported that Deutsche Bank decided to continue expanding operations in Russia despite Putin's aggression following the Donbas, Crimea, and European attacks.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-autorizou-transacoes-potencialmente-ilicitas-na-colombia-mostram-documentos.shtml) reported that documents show Deutsche Bank authorized thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/deutsche-bank-chair-backs-ceo-after-reports-expose-past-lapses-trump-calls-tax-leak-illegal/article71715150.ece) reported that the Deutsche Bank chair backed the CEO after leaked records exposed past financial lapses, and the German Finance Minister called for an investigation.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/los-papeles-del-deutsche-bank-exponen-operaciones-que-vinculan-a-trump-con-rusia-y-us5819-millones-nid18112026/) reported that the leaked Deutsche Bank papers exposed operations linking Donald Trump to Russia and millions related to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-banco-aleman-deutsche-bank-es-senalado-de-procesar-transacciones-sospechosas-por-casi-600-millones-de-dolares-vinculadas-a-epstein-y-donald-trump-3601659) reported that Deutsche Bank faces accusations of allowing corruption and ignoring internal controls after being signaled for processing nearly $600 million in suspicious transactions linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/deutsche-bank-acusada-de-permitir-corrupcion-vinculada-a-epstein-trump-y-oligarcas-rusos-33175792) reported that an international investigation led by CLIP and Barracuda Media documented Deutsche Bank links with high-risk clients and suspicious transactions based on a leak of 15 million files.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-falhou-em-controle-e-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-mostram-documentos-vazados.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-falhou-na-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-apesar-de-alertas-internos-revela-investigacao.ghtml) reported that an investigation based on more than 15 million leaked documents revealed that Deutsche Bank maintained serious flaws in its anti-money laundering controls and compliance.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-on-mass-data-leak) reported that Deutsche Bank shares plunged after international media published reports based on millions of leaked emails and documents.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-shares-fall-as-leak-reveals-trump-tax-document-error) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after reports based on 15 million leaked records shed light on dealings with clients including Donald Trump and revealed a tax document error.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim) reported that an international investigation using leaked internal data claimed the German bank overlooked compliance concerns regarding risky clients to safeguard profits.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-exposing-epstein-payments-russia-dealings) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% following media reports detailing dealings with Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532266/Deutsche-Bank-processed-582-million-for-Epstein-despite-explicit), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648963-whistleblowers-expose-deutsche-bank-dealings-epstein/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that leaked internal documents indicate Deutsche Bank processed nearly $600 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-leaks-german-lender-s-dealings-with-russian-oligarchs-under-scrutiny) reported that Germany's finance minister urged full transparency from Deutsche Bank following the leaked records.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/deutsche-bank-russia-oligarchs-leaked-documents.html) reported that leaked records showed Deutsche Bank courting wealthy Russian clients while bracing for sanctions.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-moved-wealthy-russian-clients-to-switzerland-and-luxembourg-before-the-full-scale-war-helping-shield-their-financial-records-from-the-doj) reported that Deutsche Bank moved wealthy Russian clients to Switzerland and Luxembourg after 2014 to protect banking secrecy and avoid disclosing information to the Department of Justice.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/deutsche-bank-under-fire-after-internal-documents-made-public/a-79974543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-documents-secrets-qui-lient-donald-trump-a-l-argent-sale-azerbaidjanais_6812989_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation published internal records detailing Deutsche Bank's dealings with Jeffrey Epstein, Donald Trump, and Azerbaijani and Russian figures.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044722/inside-deutsche-bank-leak-of-15-million-files-exposes-secrets-scandals-and-double-standards-of-global-financial-giant), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-secrets-inavouables-du-geant-bancaire-reveles-par-15-millions-de-documents-confidentiels_6812911_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation leaked over 15 million internal files from Deutsche Bank detailing scandals, suspicious transactions, sanctioned Russian oligarchs, and Jeffrey Epstein links.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-deepens-as-jimmy-sues-sister-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life senior pastor Jimmy Odukoya took his sister Tolu and seven trustees to a Federal High Court in Lagos.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-fountain-of-life-trustees-over-church-dispute/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-odukoya-drags-sister-others-to-court-over-removal-as-senior-pastor/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya instituted a court action against his sister and Fountain of Life Church trustees over his removal as senior pastor.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742636-breaking-jimmy-odukoya-drags-sister-pastors-court-1-demand/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya dragged his sister and pastors to court making one demand.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-pastors-asks-court-to-declare-removal-illegal/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos to challenge his removal from office and ask the court to declare his removal illegal.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/nsa-down-network-outage-nsanet.html) reported that a classified National Security Agency network went down, causing work disruptions, with no current signs that the outage is the result of a cyberattack.

reports.text: [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/after-relentless-ukraine-strikes-russia-to-take-at-least-a-few-months-to-clear-crimea-bridge/articleshow/136069125.cms) reported that Ukraine's defense minister stated clearing debris from the Kerch Strait Bridge will span several months following damage from Ukrainian drone attacks.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/22/world/ukraine-russia-logistics-crimean-bridge-strikes/) reported that Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean bridge piled pressure on an already strained Russian logistics network.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wy0qj7w5zqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.
[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2222879), a state-media outlet, reported that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Andrey Nikitin stated train traffic across the Crimean Bridge has been fully restored.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90789) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky warned during an NBC News interview that the Crimean Bridge will not stay.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187063-crimean-bridge-which-putin-uses-to-transport-weapons-to-not-remain-standing-zelensky-says.html) reported that Russian leader Vladimir Putin uses the Kerch Bridge to transport large quantities of military equipment.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187033-russia-unlikely-to-increase-traffic-on-kerch-bridge-even-after-repairs-pletenchuk.html) reported that Dmytro Pletenchuk stated Russia is unlikely to risk increasing traffic on the Kerch Bridge even after repairs.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222801), a state-media outlet, reported that a military expert stated the UK and France helped coordinate the Ukrainian army's strike on the Crimean Bridge, calling it a purely terrorist act.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/russia-has-no-timeline-for-crimean-bridge-repairs-deputy-pm-says-a94332) reported that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin stated both the steel arch and main beam supporting the roadway were damaged in the Ukrainian strikes.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186858-russia-lacks-technical-capacity-to-repair-crimean-bridge-pletenchuk.html) reported that Pletenchuk stated Russia currently lacks the technical capacity needed to repair the Kerch Strait Bridge.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-says-putin-must-understand-crimean-bridge-will-not-stay-warns-russia-increasing-double-tap-strikes/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is increasing double-tap and triple-tap strikes to kill as many people as possible, while stating Russian President Vladimir Putin must understand the Crimean Bridge will not stay.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraines-crimean-bridge-blasts-put-russian-logistics-under-pressure) reported that Ukraine's partial destruction of the Crimean bridge put Russian logistics under pressure and strengthened Kyiv's supply route disruption campaign.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063984/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated it will take Russia several months to lift and tow away the damaged section of the Crimean Bridge.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063973/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before the strike on the Crimean Bridge.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187204-strikes-on-kerch-bridge-can-force-kremlin-to-reconsider-its-position-on-negotiations-ukraine-at-osce.html) reported that Ukraine stated at the OSCE that damage to the Kerch Bridge could force the Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187121-dm-khmara-says-russia-will-need-several-months-to-raise-damaged-section-of-kerch-bridge.html) reported that Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated Russia will need several months to raise the damaged section of the Kerch Bridge.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-could-take-a-year-to-clear-collapsed-crimean-bridge-section-ukraines-defense-minister-says/) reported that the president rejected Vladimir Putin's claims that the Crimean Bridge was not used for military logistics.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063937/) reported that Ukraine's defence forces struck an ammunition depot in Russian-occupied Crimea and two Russian command posts in Zaporizhzhia and Donetsk oblasts.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/russian-projectiles-hit-poland-as-nato-tensions-rise) reported that three Russian projectiles landed in Poland, prompting NATO to condemn a violation of Polish airspace.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/20/we-do-whatever-we-want-with-what-s-ours-a-look-back-at-ukraine-s-attacks-on-the-crimean-bridge) reported that the Crimean Bridge links the Russian-annexed peninsula to Russia’s Krasnodar region.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/onitsha-stands-still-for-obi-kwankwaso/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi received a welcome from supporters in Onitsha, Anambra State.
[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/tinubu-takes-re-election-campaign-to-south-west/) reported that President Bola Tinubu took his 2027 re-election campaign to the South-west zone.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/obi-shuts-down-onitsha-visits-his-alma-mater-ckc/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi visited his alma mater, CKC, in Onitsha.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-why-billboard-featuring-peter-obi-was-removed-anambra-govt/) reported that the Anambra State Government explained the removal of a campaign billboard belonging to Senator Victor Umeh featuring Peter Obi.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-we-pulled-down-umehs-billboard-anambra-govt/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/why-billboard-featuring-peter-obi-was-removed-anambra-govt/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra State Government stated that Senator Victor Umeh's billboard featuring Peter Obi was removed for violating the Signage Act of 2010.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/videos-obi-takes-campaign-road-show-to-onitsha-ahead-of-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi led a road show in Onitsha ahead of a town hall meeting.
[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/video-anambra-agog-as-peter-obi-visits-alma-mater/) reported that Peter Obi visited his alma mater in Anambra.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-obi-draws-massive-crowd-in-onitsha-visits-alma-mater/) reported that Peter Obi, presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, drew a massive crowd during his visit to Onitsha.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/926714-soludo-hands-tinubu-apgas-flag.html) reported that APGA national leader Soludo handed over the party's presidential flag to Tinubu on Thursday in Awka.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/shun-sentiments-be-strategic-for-tinubus-re-election-soludo-advises-seast/) reported that Anambra State Governor Chukwuma Soludo urged voters and stakeholders in the Southeast to avoid sentimental decisions and be strategic for Tinubu's re-election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/soludo-presents-apga-flag-to-tinubu-as-presidential-flagbearer-at-awka-mega-rally/) reported that Anambra State Governor Chukwuma Charles Soludo formally presented the All Progressives Grand Alliance party flag to President Bola Tinubu as presidential flagbearer at an Awka rally.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926414-anambra-govt-explains-removal-of-billboard-featuring-peter-obi.html), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/anambra-govt-denies-pulling-down-umehs-billboard-over-obi/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742315-peter-obi-billboard-anambra-government-reveals-ordered-removal/) reported that the Anambra State Government explained that a billboard featuring Peter Obi was removed due to an unpaid presidential campaign signage fee.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-shettima-soludo-lead-tinubus-2027-campaign-rally-in-anambra/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima and Governor Chukwuma Soludo led the APC-APGA SoluTinubu 2027 campaign rally for Tinubu's re-election at Alex Ekwueme Square in Awka.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/anambra-home-to-political-icons-like-zik-ekwueme-soludo-shettima/) reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima described Anambra State as a home of accomplished political leaders, citing Nigeria's first President.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-soludo-presents-apga-flag-to-shettima-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Anambra Governor Chukwuma Soludo handed the APGA flag to Vice-President Shettima in Awka as APGA adopted Tinubu for the 2027 presidential election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/police-tighten-security-ahead-of-tinubu-rally-obis-anambra-visit/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra State Police Command intensified security operations across the state ahead of a campaign rally for President Bola Tinubu and Peter Obi's visit.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/soludo-to-hold-mega-rally-in-anambra-for-tinubus-re-election-thursday/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-anambra-set-for-tinubu-campaign-rally/) reported that Anambra State is preparing to host a mega campaign rally supporting President Bola Tinubu's re-election bid, led by Governor Charles Soludo.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-court-sentences-nikhil-gupta-to-235-months-in-pannun-murder-for-hire-plot-101795223985520.html) reported that a US court sentenced Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in the Pannun murder-for-hire plot after he pleaded guilty to three charges.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pannun-murder-plot-us-court-sentences-nikhil-gupta-to-over-19-year-prison-term-for-bid-to-kill-sikh-extremist-101795192152550.html) reported that Indian national Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to 235 months in prison in a murder-for-hire plot against Sikh extremist Pannun.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOX3JOVy03eEI4NG1USFRxZkwtd0FLc0tfWk1zMWJSX0xDeHR1Rmwwd0hoQ2RXMG15ejRzWEJJZFh5WU5la2tvWE9kNjJQOG9rVEh4MUlUQl9Cam5KR1FKNnl4UWhLRmVBMGVfT3Q1dXlsZ2lfUHlXLUV3a0ZjaE16ZzJTMFBSbW9RRHc?oc=5) reported that the FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a key criminal justice information database according to an AP source.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-us-agriculture-department-fbi-hit-by-cyberattacks-media-report) reported that hackers breached systems at the US Agriculture Department and the FBI.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ef34d53c5e48) reported that the cyber intrusions reportedly target a farmer payment system and a nationwide law enforcement database.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010305/fbi-s-criminal-information-database-hacked-report/story/) reported that the FBI is investigating a suspected breach of a nationwide database used by federal, state and local law enforcement agencies to share criminal justice information.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/fbi-breach-criminal-information-database/) reported that the National Crime Information Center holds sensitive law enforcement records nationwide.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fbi-database-hacked-for-second-time-in-months-breach-targets-us-crime-records-101795228753873.html) reported that the FBI database was hacked for the second time in months, following a September targeting of an FBI recruitment website by ShinyHunters.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/fbis-criminal-information-database-hacked-reports-say/article71727198.ece) reported that the apparent compromise involved the National Crime Information Center database.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fbi-investiga-nuevo-ciberataque-contra-base-de-datos-nacional-segun-cnn-en-septiembre-indago-otro-caso/) reported that the FBI is investigating a new cyberattack against a national database according to CNN.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324490-fbi-e-departamento-de-agricultura-dos-eua-sao-alvos-de-ataques-hackers.html) reported that the FBI and the US Department of Agriculture were targets of hacker attacks that also affected a payment system.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/hackers-atacan-el-departamento-de-agricultura-de-eeuu-y-el-fbi-segun-medios_0_nZL5j9nd2U.html) reported that hackers breached the United States Department of Agriculture and the FBI.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/hackers-vulneran-al-departamento-de-agricultura-y-al-fbi-en-estados-unidos-en-medio-de-crecientes-alertas-por-la-seguridad-informatica-3602960) reported that recent weeks of disruptions also affected transport, communications, and electronic commerce across United States territory.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/inclusao-de-mendonca-em-relatorio-sobre-master-integra-estrategia-da-pf-de-questionar-volta-de-ministro-a-relatoria-avaliam-investigadores.ghtml) reported that allies of Minister André Mendonça in the Supreme Federal Court view his inclusion in the Federal Police report regarding the Master case as an attempt to wear him down.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/fachin-deu-nova-orientacao-a-pf-para-avaliar-relevancia-de-citacoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master-diz-documento.ghtml) reported that STF President Edson Fachin gave new guidance to the Federal Police to evaluate the relevance of information regarding Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mendonca-reune-mensagens-de-terceiros-sobre-terno-jantar-e-reuniao-com-vorcaro-e-nao-aponta-beneficio-a-ministro.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report on Minister André Mendonça gathered third-party messages about clothing, a dinner, and a meeting with Vorcaro, without pointing to any benefit for the minister.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/caso-master-fachin-determina-que-concierge-de-vorcaro-apresenta-despesas-de-banqueiro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin accepted a request from the Federal Police and ordered a concierge company contracted by former banker D. Vorcaro to present the banker's expenses.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/investigacao-novas-diligencias-ou-arquivamento-o-que-a-pgr-pode-fazer-com-os-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor-General's Office will have to individually analyze reports produced by the Federal Police concerning the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/andrei-stf-fachin-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues delivered investigation reports mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case to STF President Edson Fachin, who then forwarded them to the PGR.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/pf-investiga-vazamento-de-informacoes-sobre-relatorio-com-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues stated in a Senate hearing that an investigation is underway into information leaks concerning a report mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323452-chefe-da-pf-explica-saida-de-delegados-do-caso-master.html) reported that Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues met with Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva regarding the departure of delegates from the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/oposicao-vai-pedir-esclarecimentos-de-ministro-sobre-delegados-da-pf-afastados-no-caso-master-em-audiencia-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the opposition will ask the minister for clarifications in a Senate hearing following the removal of Federal Police delegates.

reports.text: [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gazans-return-battered-camp-after-israel-says-it-concluded-tank-raid) reported that Palestinians started returning to their Gaza camp after Israel's military concluded a tank raid.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israel-ends-largest-gaza-ground-incursion-since-october-2025-truce), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israel-army-says-it-completed-ground-operation-in-central-gaza/article71721554.ece) reported that the Israeli military concluded a tank raid in central Gaza, which was its first major ground incursion since the October 2025 cease-fire.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gazans-return-after-israel-army-ends-rare-ground-operation) reported that Palestinians returned to check belongings and assess damage in central Gaza.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915501) reported that the IDF targeted illegal Palestinian construction and land seizures in Area C during a West Bank operation.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-blows-up-palestinian-homes-in-central-gaza-strip-3725762) reported that Israeli forces demolished homes and facilities north of the Nuseirat refugee camp and east of the Maghazi refugee camp.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/israel-army-says-completed-central-gaza-ground-operation/) reported that Israel's military stated a ground operation involving tanks in central Gaza that began the previous day had come to an end.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israels-central-gaza-offensive-coordinated-with-us-army-radio-says-3725756) reported that Israeli Army Radio stated the military offensive in the central Gaza Strip was coordinated with the US and could last several days.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-war-ground-operation.html) reported that the Israeli military stated it conducted a limited raid across the Gaza cease-line into territory controlled by Hamas to address a threat.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/israeli-troops-launch-ground-operation-in-central-gaza-13613724) reported that dozens of displaced Palestinians fled their tents and shelters in central Gaza following the ground operation.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/what-does-israels-new-ground-offensive-mean-for-palestinians-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line, causing Palestinians to flee in Gaza.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-un-warns-over-18000-palestinians-at-risk-of-displacement-amid-israeli-offensive-in-gaza/) reported that the UN warned that the military offensive in central Gaza could displace over 18,000 Palestinians and disrupt humanitarian services.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261118-gazans-flee-shelters-as-israeli-army-launches-ground-operation-beyond-yellow-line) reported that Palestinians fled their shelters in central Gaza after Israel launched a ground operation beyond the Yellow Line.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/israeli-occupation-army-crosses-the-yellow-line-again/) reported that the Israeli occupation army launched a military operation in the central Gaza Strip aiming to neutralize alleged Hamas infrastructure.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220803) reported that the IDF stated the operation is targeting Hamas facilities and a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461650/) reported that the Israeli army announced a military operation in central Gaza in the first such move since the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190493/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1-6-%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9) reported that the Ministry of Social Development in the Gaza Strip warned of severe risks threatening thousands of displaced people in the central governorate due to ongoing Israeli military operations.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/hamas-condemns-israeli-army-offensive-in-central-gaza-as-flagrant-violation-3725746) reported that Hamas condemned the Israeli army's announced offensive in central Gaza as a flagrant violation.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-israeli-army-launches-military-offensive-in-central-gaza-despite-ceasefire/) reported that the Israeli army announced it launched a military offensive in three blocks of the central Gaza Strip and closed sections of the Salah al-Din road.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-israel-begins-new-military-operation-in-gaza), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israeli-military-begins-new-thrust-gaza-witnesses-say) reported that Israeli tanks advanced in an area of the central Gaza Strip and military forces are targeting Hamas infrastructure.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326151/Palestinian-groups-say-Israeli-military-operation-in-central), a state-media outlet, reported that Palestinian Islamic Jihad and the Mujahideen Movement condemned the operation as a ceasefire violation.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israel-army-launches-ground-operation-hamas-controlled-area-gaza) reported that an AFP journalist saw Israeli tanks positioned in a Hamas-controlled area of central Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190471/%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%A3-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203564/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B0-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%A3-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that the Israeli military began a military operation targeting residential squares in central Gaza near the yellow line.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-presento-diploma-bachiller-congreso-colegio-es-falso-HG43890502) reported that Representative Luz Verónica Estrada presented another high school diploma to Congress, but the school stated it is false.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-antes-del-escandalo-por-sus-titulos-falsos-PI43874920) reported that Pacto Histórico requested Representative Luz Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat amidst a scandal regarding false academic titles.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-fiscalia-cito-dos-veces-por-investigacion-titulo-falso-y-no-asistio-NM43836597) reported that the Prosecutor's Office summoned Pacto Histórico Representative Verónica Estrada twice in an investigation over a false academic degree, but she did not attend.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/pacto-historico-pidio-renuncia-de-veronica-estrada-su-curul) reported that Pacto Histórico asked Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat following allegations of falsified academic documents.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/luis-eduardo-llinas-pidio-oferta-veronica-estrada-contrato-dian-78-millones-KO43811319) reported that Luis Eduardo Llinás asked Luz Verónica Estrada to present an offer to sign a contract with DIAN in 2025.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/universidad-nacional-detecto-inconsistencias-titulo-veronica-estrada-fiscalia-PO43813639) reported that the National University received a request to verify Luz Verónica Estrada's university degree in October 2025.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/caso-luz-veronica-estrada-delitos-podria-enfrentar-falsificar-titulos-academicos-abogado-penalista-responde-DO43812100) reported that the case of Pacto Histórico Representative Luz Verónica Estrada reached judicial authorities following questions over her academic titles.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/consejo-ingenieria-denuncia-veronica-estrada-diploma-falso-KI43788174) reported that the National Council of Professional Engineering decided in February 2026 not to grant professional registration to Verónica Estrada and reported her to the Prosecutor's Office.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congresista-luz-estrada-habria-falsificado-diploma-de-la-u-nacional) reported that Representative Luz Estrada allegedly falsified a diploma from the National University.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-acta-grado-diploma-bachiller-antioquia-CJ43791074) El Colombiano reported that new documents raised questions regarding the high school diploma of Representative Luz Verónica Estrada.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congresista-veronica-estrada-suma-dudas-sobre-su-diploma-de-bachiller) El Nuevo Siglo reported that further doubts emerged concerning the academic credentials of the congressional representative from the Pacto Histórico coalition.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-pacto-historico-titulo-falso-canciller-GH43773324) reported that the National University confirmed that the university degree of congresswoman Juliana Guerrero was false.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-denuncia-corte-suprema-representante-pacto-historico-titulo-falso-MH43776912) reported that congresswoman Verónica Estrada was denounced before the Supreme Court over a false university degree.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/como-habria-falsificado-titulo-universitario-congresista-del-pacto-historico) reported that former dean Verónica Botero ruled out internal complicity regarding the falsification of a university degree by a Pacto Histórico congresswoman.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/luz-veronica-estrada-titulo-falso-pacto-historico-investigara-caso-comite-etica-DI43785204) reported that the Pacto Histórico party asked its Ethics Committee to investigate the false university degree of Representative Verónica Estrada.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/texas-witness-botched-execution-reinaldo-dennes) reported that witness Reverend Jeff Hood described terror and pain during the execution of Reinaldo Dennes in Texas.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxOci1rWlZoWm9abDd3SElxd2xiYVpPR293LXpwZVN3NG1MejRPOUpqeE1kbmduS1lfQWpqcENvY21UZmo3Tm9sWkl3Z0s3dFZTc1BsWmtJT09RRkdLOFhVU3Mtai1pY0FpNGN0aVV3Z3prY3NtVTR1NkM2cjdGWEJzZFJLX2RXc0RvZWR4a09pOWVQRXZCaEE?oc=5) reported that Texas stated an execution went as planned, while a witness stated screams showed tremendous distress.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649175-texas-accused-botching-execution/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a witness accused Texas prison officials of botching Reinaldo Dennes' execution by lethal injection.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/botched-execution-texas) reported that inmate Reinaldo Dennes screamed in pain and took over an hour to die during a botched execution in Texas.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-inmate-takes-over-an-hour-to-die-by-lethal-injection/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/20/texas-inmates-execution-lethal-injection-takes-one-hour/) reported that the execution of Texas inmate Reinaldo Dennes took over an hour.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-inmate-takes-over-an-hour-to-die-by-lethal-injection/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Reinaldo Dennes cried out in pain during the lethal injection, while prison officials denied it was botched.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/20/texas-inmates-execution-lethal-injection-takes-one-hour/) reported that prison staff struggled to find a suitable vein during the execution.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/19/record-executions-florida-texas) reported that Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year while Texas also put a man to death.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/reinaldo-dennes-texas-execution-lethal-injection-botched) reported that observers stated Reinaldo Dennes' execution took more than an hour as prison workers struggled to find suitable veins.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/us/texas-execution-lethal-injection-reinaldo-dennes.html), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1120/1600057-texas-execution/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/witnesses-say-us-inmate-reported-severe-pain-during-execution/) reported that witnesses stated a Texas execution took over an hour and the inmate moaned and complained of intense pain while staff struggled with needles.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ck20vl1dd8qzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a Texas death-row inmate screamed as his execution took more than one hour.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOZzBMNXJaWHlSeU84UUxiSWtmS0Q4ellHTGdzbzRieUdlR1NjcmQtMVJTM3BMaFFwT1R1MkF3cVZzZGd3Z2NZM1V4b3pMMXFvQ0IxSnpiQnF2UHNkdEhYWU04THZRR1VGRmo2LW9DQmI4RTRIOE1reWRZY1Y3U2ZpbDFWUHlCdw?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/texas-execution-reinaldo-dennes-huntsville-b3088492.html) reported that the execution of Reinaldo Dennes in Texas took over an hour, with the inmate complaining of pain.

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/michelle-visita-bolsonaro-no-hospital-apos-voltar-de-viagem-ao-exterior.ghtml) reported that former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro arrived at the DF Star hospital in Brasília to visit former president Jair Bolsonaro, who was hospitalized in the ICU.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324608-moraes-autoriza-filhos-visitarem-bolsonaro-em-internacao.html) reported that Moraes authorized Carlos, Jair Renan, Laura, and the stepdaughter of former president Jair Bolsonaro to visit him in the hospital without mobile devices or other electronic equipment.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-enviado-a-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-que-se-sabe-3603041) reported that treating doctors initiated clinical hydration, oral fasting with nutritional support, and placed a gastric tube for Jair Bolsonaro.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/21/lex-presidente-del-brasile-jair-bolsonaro-ricoverato-in-terapia-intensiva_839ca9c3-f07e-4473-a141-0031f216f432.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the intensive care unit and is clinically stable, conscious, alert, and breathing spontaneously.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-esta-internado-en-terapia-intensiva-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-y-podria-ser-nid21112026/) reported that a tomography scan detected an almost total small bowel obstruction and doctors are evaluating a possible new surgery.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/bolsonaro-esta-internado-na-uti-com-abdomen-obstruido-em-estado-estavel-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-hospital.ghtml) reported that DF Star hospital stated former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro is in the intensive care unit with an obstructed abdomen in stable condition without a discharge date.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/moraes-autoriza-visita-de-filhos-de-bolsonaro-em-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized daily hospital visits for Jair Bolsonaro's children but prohibited the use of mobile phones and other electronic devices during the visits.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-en-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-33247549) reported that Jair Bolsonaro is in intensive care due to an intestinal obstruction.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-internado-cuidados-intensivos-obstruccion-intestinal-dice-primer-parte-medico_0_IMGmDv1K84.html) reported that the former Brazilian president entered the hospital on Friday and there is no prediction for medical discharge.
